notes.title: Autumn Fair
notes.notes:
[p]Hurry up to stock up on overseas curiosities from the fair throughout the week![/p][p][/p][p]This time Yar Marko has delighted the citizens of Elinor with the following goods: packs of Mihrutkas and Protectresses at a discount, one-time portals and landing teleports, Grimwood Chests and Ghost Boxes, magic and aura transformers, items for summoning Elinor’s bosses, bundles with patterns of fate sketches, and more.[/p][p]
The Magic Transformer has been endowed with new power: hostile-race spells that replace your own now take into account the medals you have unlocked that enhance your spells.[/p][p]For example: for humans, the Magic Transformer replaces Blood Ritual with Boiling Blood. If a human character has unlocked the “Blood Mage I” medal, which increases the effect of Blood Ritual, then Boiling Blood spells will also benefit from a medal that boosts their effect.[/p][p]And until September 16th inclusive, by defeating valiant opponents, you have a chance to obtain a Lucky Ticket with valuable rewards. Lucky Tickets can also be purchased in the Rarity Store for gold coins.[/p][p]We wish you successful shopping![/p][p]
[/p]

notes.title: Hearts of the Mines
notes.notes:
[p]Hardly had the citizens of Elinor rested from gathering fruit baskets when new commotion arose: the time has come to search for the Hearts of the Mines, and everyone must hurry to collect as many as possible to exchange them for rare inlaid stones for their equipment![/p][p]
[/p][p]In the quest log you’ll find a list of assignments for the “Hearts of the Mines” event, along with their descriptions and rewards: the Hearts of the Mines, Chests with the Hearts of the Mines, or simply their shards![/p][p]— For the “Grimwood Hunter” quest (available from level 7, one-time), the daily quests “Crystal Fever”, “Successful Investment” (crystal spending), and the one-time “League Tournament Winner” (available from level 6), you will receive the Hearts of the Mines.[/p][p]— For the daily quests “Tournament Participant”, “Successful Investment” (gold spending), “Dungeon Warrior”, and “Fearless Hunter” (available from level 6), you will receive Chests with the Hearts of the Mines.[/p][p]— For the quest “Free Hunter” (available from level 6), you will receive shards of a Heart of the Mines. Note: the number of dungeon monster victories required for this quest has been significantly reduced.[/p][p]
[/p][p]Attention![/p][p]When completing the “Successful Investment” quest, make sure the expenses you make are listed in the quest requirements, or confirm that your planned spendings will count toward the quest.[/p][p]
[/p][p]For participation in the League Tournament, you’ll receive 10 passes daily upon logging into the game. Additional passes and tournament elixirs can be purchased in the Rarity Store. To join the battles, head to the Academy Square and leave a note in the book in the center of the square.[/p][p]By winning, you’ll earn points toward the personal “Fighter” ranking and the clan “Triumph” ranking, as well as a Heart shard, one of the tournament elixirs, or a League Tournament pass.[/p][p]
[/p][p]Hearts of the Mines can also be obtained by dismantling any stones from Yar Marko using the Jeweler’s Toolset from the Supply Center, or by spinning the Lucky Reel for a chance to get the Chest with the Hearts of the Mines.[/p][p][/p][p]Opening chests with the Hearts of the Mines gives you a chance to find a whole Heart or several shards. With the help of magical glue or magical superglue, 100 shards can be combined into a complete Heart.[/p][p][/p][p]At the Supply Center, the Hearts of the Mines can be exchanged for inlaid stones.[/p][p]A new item has been added to the assortment — an Excellent Adamas of Power, which enhances the effect of the Scroll of Power by 10%.[/p][p]The inlaid stones arBrillmagr and opalion have been adjusted to the standard stone grading system:[/p][p]— durable stones of level 5 now appear as gray;[/p][p]— high-quality stones arBrillmagr and opalion of level 7 have been added;[/p][p]— epic stones have been renamed to excellent ones (blue color).[/p][p]Exchange with an extra payment is available: you can exchange durable arBrillmagrs and opalions to the high-quality ones and the high-quality for the excellent ones.[/p][p][/p][p]Quests can be completed until the end of September 28th, and shards can be combined into the Hearts of the Mines and exchanged at the Supply Center until the end of September 29th.[/p][p][/p][p]Become a true collector of the Hearts of the Mines![/p]

notes.title: Fruit Time
notes.notes:
[p]The end of summer is the time for harvesting and, of course, preparing stocks of juicy fruits for the winter! For two weeks, the diligent citizens of Elinor will be collecting fruit baskets and receiving gifts from the Master Gardener.[/p][p][/p][p]To claim rewards, you will need to collect 20 Fruit Baskets by September 7th inclusive, which can be obtained as follows:[/p][p]Apples — for defeating level-appropriate bosses, excluding Grimwood (2 per day).[/p][p]Pears — for winning fair battles against valiant opponents (2 per day).[/p][p]Grapes — with a chance from slaying experienced monsters (2 per day).[/p][p]Plums — with a chance from opening any C.H.E.S.T.s (unlimited).[/p][p]Fruits with daily collection limits will once again become available after removing a special alarm.[/p][p]Once you’ve filled baskets with fruits, you can choose one of the following rewards:[/p][p]— 20 [u][url="https://tmgame.ru/info/artinfo.php?id=23670"]Enchanted Ink Barrels[/url][/u];[/p][p]— 2,000 [u][url="https://tmgame.ru/info/artinfo.php?id=23545"]Observatory Gold Lenses[/url][/u];[/p][p]— 2 [u][url="https://tmgame.ru/info/artinfo.php?id=28972"]Personal Card Boxes[/url][/u] (can only be received once);[/p][p]— one of the inlaid stones ([u][url="https://tmgame.ru/info/artinfo.php?id=22848"]Crystal Apple[/url][/u], [u][url="https://tmgame.ru/info/artinfo.php?id=22849"]Crystal Pear[/url][/u], [u][url="https://tmgame.ru/info/artinfo.php?id=22851"]Crystal Plum[/url][/u], [u][url="https://tmgame.ru/info/artinfo.php?id=22850"]Crystal Grape[/url][/u]) or a [u][url="https://tmgame.ru/info/artinfo.php?id=22852"]Fragile Gardener’s Rune[/url][/u], 3 [u][url="https://tmgame.ru/info/artinfo.php?id=22680"]Leader’s Chests[/url][/u], 15 [u][url="https://tmgame.ru/info/artinfo.php?id=24450"]Life-giving Ichor[/url][/u], and 2 [u][url="https://tmgame.ru/info/artinfo.php?id=22126"]Fragile Cornucopia[/url][/u].[/p][p]After receiving a reward, the “Fruit Time” quest will close, and to continue gathering fruits you will need to purchase a Harvesting Permit in the Rarity Store.[/p][p]A new reward has been added for this summer season — the inlaid stone “Crystal Grape” with a “Fruit Power” aura.[/p][p][/p][p]To help speed up fruit gathering, the Elinor Bank is gifting fruit baskets to its depositors! For every 100 crystals purchased in a single transaction before the end of August 28th, you will receive 1 Fruit Basket![/p][p][/p][p]Don’t forget to purchase a Harvesting Permit to keep claiming rewards for completing the quest![/p][p][/p][p]A new season of the [u][url="https://info.tmgame.ru/library/world/Observatory/"]Observatory [/url][/u] and the “[u][url="https://info.tmgame.ru/library/world/rating/stone_rep/"]Technomagic competition[/url][/u]” ranking has also begun. These events will last until the end of the week and conclude as follows:[/p][p]— Observatory battles will end on August 31st, while access to the base camp, purchasing, and opening Lens Crates will remain available until September 3rd;[/p][p]— The collection of gemstones, merging them into collections, and the final ranking results will take place on September 1st at 05:30 MSK.[/p][p][/p][p]We wish you success in harvesting the juiciest fruits of Elinor![/p][p]
[/p]

notes.title: Mechanisms of the Ancients
notes.notes:
[p]Brave and fearless warriors! Are you ready to embark on a quest for ancient mechanisms? Then hurry to take on tasks and gather as many Ancient Tokens and Grimbold Coins as possible to obtain all the desired items for unlocking medals and achievements for your character![/p][p]
[/p][p]Hilgor and Virkli await all technomages of level 5 and above to begin the search for the Mechanisms of the Ancients. Each day, you can complete one random quest from a set of five. By removing the quest alarm clock for a certain fee, you can take on new random quests an unlimited number of times. The cost of removing the alarm increases with each use and resets daily at midnight. If the quest you received doesn’t suit you, you can use a “Note about the Ancients” to exchange it for one of the remaining four.[/p][p][/p][p]Collected Ancient Tokens and Grimbold Coins can be exchanged at the Supply Center for various items that add points to medals and achievements. This is the last opportunity to earn the “17th Anniversary Cup” achievement![/p][p]The highlight of this season is the Golden Weapon, which now grants points toward the “Weapon Path” medal — previously an achievement. With its new medal status, the Weapon Path grants enhanced stats, boosting your character’s power even further![/p][p][/p][p]To aid in your search, the Elinor Bank is offering gifts! For every 300 crystals in a single payment, you’ll receive one Chest of the Ancients, containing an Annihilator to remove a quest alarm clock and 15 random Ancient Mechanisms to help complete assignments more efficiently![/p][p][/p][p]You can receive quests and Chests of the Ancients until the end of August 24th, and all quests must be completed and tokens and coins spent no later than August 25th![/p][p][/p][p]Hurry up to uncover all the lost mechanisms of the Ancients![/p][p]
[/p]

notes.title: Elinor Friday
notes.notes: [p]Brave warriors never sit idle! Set aside all distractions and seize this chance to enhance your Talismans of Power and claim the treasures from the Grobft's safes.[/p][p][/p][p]Elinorians of level 7 and above who have completed the quest “[u][url="https://info.tmgame.ru/library/items/talisman_of_power/"]Talismans of Power[/url][/u]” can now receive Magic storages and Chests with storages for completing simple daily tasks.[/p][p][/p][p]By battling experienced monsters and valiant opponents, you have a chance to acquire Iron, Gold, or Onyx Safes, each containing various [u][url="https://info.tmgame.ru/action/seif/"]treasures from the Grobft's family[/url][/u].[/p][p][/p][p]These events are available until the end of August 4th.[/p][p][/p][p]Stay active, and fortune will surely find you![/p]

notes.title: Calligraphy News
notes.notes:
[p]Glorious technomages and technomagesses! The Cryptographers Zales and Melchor are ready to share new developments in calligraphy, and the Gods of Elinor have prepared an updated Adventurer’s Box![/p][p]
Technomages of level 5 and above who have learned about the long-forgotten art from the Cryptographer and mastered the inscription of symbols that enhance character stats, will be introduced by Zales or Melchor to the possibilities of replicating learned symbols in the Calligraphy News dialogue. They will also perform the first replication of one normal symbol you have already inscribed.[/p][p]After speaking with the Cryptographer, you’ll discover that each symbol can be replicated — that is, a new symbol can be formed based on an existing one. Replication results in a slightly different symbol, but it can also only be inscribed once. Each symbol can be replicated up to 4 times, one for each level beyond the level required for inscribing the original symbol.[/p][p]Example: the normal symbol of health can be inscribed at character level 5, granting +20 health. At level 6, you can perform the first replication of this symbol, increasing health by 25, which requires 2 normal symbols of health. At level 7, the second replication becomes available, providing +30 health but requiring 3 normal symbols. At level 8, the third replication is available, requiring 4 symbols and giving +35 health. The final replication is available at level 9, requiring 5 symbols and increasing health by 40.[/p][p]You will see information about stat increases from symbol replication and your replication progress in the quest log after speaking with the Cryptographer.[/p][p]
And tomorrow, on July 24th, the "Calligraphic Symbols" event begins, allowing you to obtain Ink Barrels and normal Ink for completing regular game actions. Also starting tomorrow, the Cryptographer will offer a 50% discount on normal and enchanted Ink Barrels.[/p][p][/p][p]The updated Adventurer’s Box will now be issued at every level. The contents of the Worn, Old, and Normal Adventurer’s Boxes have been updated, and their descriptions now include a complete list of contents. All characters missing one of the listed boxes types have been issued a new Adventurer’s Box V, while older (Enchanted–Legendary) boxes, if present, have been removed.[/p][p]Each box starting from V contains a Cryptographer's Golden Feather, allowing you to inscribe one random symbol you have not yet inscribed or replicate a random symbol.[/p][p][/p][p]By players request, copying messages with the sender’s nickname has been restored in all chat channels except the trade channel.[/p][p][/p][p]We wish you a joyful summer mood![/p][p]
[/p]

notes.title: Treasure Cave
notes.notes:
[p]Glorious Elinorians! Remembering once-hidden goblin treasures, Masta-Gob has forged even sturdier pickaxes for true treasure seekers. And for those eager to test their luck, a Wheel of Fortune filled with valuable prizes awaits.[/p][p][/p][p]The new treasure excavation pickaxe from Masta-Gob will transport you to a cave where five goblin treasure chests are hidden within the walls.[/p][p]In the very first, normal chest, you will find luscious apples, which will either rejuvenate by 100 experience points accumulated at your current level, or grant a one-time 20% boost of life and health in battle, along with +2 to base damage and weakening until the end of the battle.[/p][p]In the Enchanted Chest, you will discover a boss summoning item of your choice, and after opening a certain number of chests, you’ll be able to select a reward card of the Dark Lord or Scrubb.[/p][p]From the Magical Goblin Chest, you’ll obtain 2 small boxes of keys, and from the Heroic Chest — 4,000 legendary magic storages.[/p][p]The Epic Chest contains a durable Stone of Calm Vulnerability for an earring. This gem combines the effects of two runes - a level-appropriate Tranquility Rune and a new unique Vulnerability Rune, which has a 6% chance, when receiving damage, to reduce your opponent's base damage by 2–7% (depending on your level) for 5 turns.[/p][p]A recipe for this rune will be introduced in the future, but for now, don’t miss your chance to obtain it from the Epic Goblin Chest![/p][p]Getting goblin pickaxes is easy! A limited batch is available in the City Store for universal coins, while an unlimited supply will be gifted by the Bank of Elinor for your deposits — 1 goblin pickaxe for every 50 crystals purchased in a single payment![/p][p][/p][p]And don’t forget to spin the Wheel of Fortune to win Berry Collection chests, Ghostly Boxes, and other valuable rewards.[/p][p][/p][p]Hurry to test your luck and claim your prizes before the end of July 20, 2025![/p][p]Treasure Cave[/p][p][/p][p]Glorious Elinorians! Remembering once-hidden goblin treasures, Masta-Gob has forged even sturdier pickaxes for true treasure seekers. And for those eager to test their luck, a Wheel of Fortune filled with valuable prizes awaits.[/p][p][/p][p]The new treasure excavation pickaxe from Masta-Gob will transport you to a cave where five goblin treasure chests are hidden within the walls.[/p][p]In the very first, normal chest, you will find luscious apples, which will either rejuvenate by 100 experience points accumulated at your current level, or grant a one-time 20% boost of life and health in battle, along with +2 to base damage and weakening until the end of the battle.[/p][p]In the Enchanted Chest, you will discover a boss summoning item of your choice, and after opening a certain number of chests, you’ll be able to select a reward card of the Dark Lord or Scrubb.[/p][p]From the Magical Goblin Chest, you’ll obtain 2 small boxes of keys, and from the Heroic Chest — 4,000 legendary magic storages.[/p][p]The Epic Chest contains a durable Stone of Calm Vulnerability for an earring. This gem combines the effects of two runes - a level-appropriate Tranquility Rune and a new unique Vulnerability Rune, which has a 6% chance, when receiving damage, to reduce your opponent's base damage for 5 turns. Up to level 11 inclusive, the base damage reduction effect is 2%, from level 12 to 14 - 3%, from 15 to 17 - 4%, from 18 to 20 - 5%, from 21 to 23 - 6% and from level 24 - 7%. The number of rune effects does not exceed 3.[/p][p]A recipe for this rune will be introduced in the future, but for now, don’t miss your chance to obtain it from the Epic Goblin Chest![/p][p]Getting goblin pickaxes is easy! A limited batch is available in the City Store for universal coins, while an unlimited supply will be gifted by the Bank of Elinor for your deposits — 1 goblin pickaxe for every 50 crystals purchased in a single payment![/p][p][/p][p]And don’t forget to spin the Wheel of Fortune to win Berry Collection chests, Ghostly Boxes, and other valuable rewards.[/p][p][/p][p]Hurry to test your luck and claim your prizes before the end of July 20, 2025![/p][p]
[/p]

notes.title: Treasure Hunt
notes.notes:
[p]A new week has begun, and as you take a break from your daily routine across the Technomagic realms, the coming days will take you on a quest for pirate treasure and a chance to test your luck by opening Lucky Tickets![/p][p][/p][p]To begin your treasure hunt, you'll need to obtain Pirate's Pouches, each containing one of ten map fragments — and find the special fragment marked with a red cross, indicating the location of a buried chest with 2 fruitful leaves of the money tree.[/p][p]Pirate's Pouches with map fragments are issued as follows:[/p][p]— 2 pcs. for every 250 crystals purchased in a single transaction;[/p][p]— 1 pc. daily upon login for characters of level 5 and above, provided there are no Pouches in the character's backpack;[/p][p]— available in limited quantities in the Crystal Store for crystals.[/p][p]Once you find the treasure-marked fragment, you won't be able to open more pouches until you dig up the chest at the indicated coordinates.[/p][p][/p][p]Attention! If you still have Pirate's Pouches from previous years, you must use them and then relog into the game in order to receive the daily login pouch.[/p][p]
Lucky Tickets with valuable rewards can be obtained:[/p][p]— with a chance by defeating valiant opponents;[/p][p]— in the Rarity Store for gold coins.[/p][p][/p][p]Pirate's Pouches will be available until the end of July 16th, and Lucky Tickets until the end of July 20th.[/p][p][/p][p]We wish you success in claiming all the treasures of Elinor![/p]

notes.title: Fair Week
notes.notes:
[p]The arrival of Yar Marko has brought new life to the city squares of Longholm and Khatog. Summoning the townsfolk, the overseas merchants offer a Certificate of Luck as a gift, the opportunity to purchase rare festive medals, and a magical novelty from distant lands — a Cap of Invisibility!
[/p][p]This time, Yar Marko has brought you: Heroic Memories and Pro Tools, Alchemical Cauldrons of Life, Magic, and Hate, Magic and Aura Transformators, Ghost Boxes and Fair Bags, Solar Prisms and Copying Sheets, as well as Hatred Charges with a 20% discount, skins of the First Humans or Dwarves, and new items — the Cap of Invisibility (which allows your character to remain hidden from others on the location for a whole hour) and Magical Infusion (used to enhance your battle companion’s equipment).
[/p][p]Until the 13th inclusive, the Fountain of Fortune will delight you in the city squares. Toss in a gold coin to receive one of the items listed in the fountain's description.
[/p][p]Before the fair ends, you’ll also be able to purchase medals from the following series: Pumpkin Madness, Egg Champion, Farewell to Winter, and Love Charm.[/p][p][/p][p]We wish you invisible shopping![/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Berry Basket Preparation
notes.notes:
[p]What could be better than enjoying a handful of juicy berries on a summer day? But to do so, you'll need to put in some effort — gather ripe berries, collect them into baskets, and only then savor the rewards that await you![/p][p][/p][p]For two weeks, you will be able to collect 5 types of berries, combine them into collections of different sizes, and receive valuable rewards — including a berry basket! Eating a whole bunch of berry baskets will not only allow you to participate in the "Berry Fever" ranking (which unlocks achievements of the same name), but also grant you berry cups (100 baskets earn you [u][url="https://tmgame.ru/info/artinfo.php?id=22652"]Berry Cup III[/url][/u], 300 for [u][url="https://tmgame.ru/info/artinfo.php?id=22653"]Cup II[/url][/u], and 500 for [u][url="https://tmgame.ru/info/artinfo.php?id=22654"]Berry Cup I[/url][/u]), which provide daily gifts for three weeks! You can collect berries in the following ways:[/p][p]— produce goods using the Weaver’s recipes to obtain strawberries; [/p][p]— defeat valiant opponents in all areas of Elinor (excluding the Tower of Despair and Grimbolde Fortress) to collect blueberries;[/p][p]— open Burglar's Chests to obtain cloudberries with a chance;[/p][p]— defeat bosses (under reward conditions) to find blackberries; [/p][p]— win duels in the Tower of Despair and Grimbolde Fortress to get gooseberries.[/p][p]If you prefer not to gather berries using different methods, you can purchase a Berry Gathering Permit from the Crystal Store. This permit allows you for one hour to randomly collect one of the berries while defeating Elinor's monsters.[/p][p][/p][p]Please note! The number of different types of berries combined (2–5) affects the rewards you receive. Berries are non-transferable but can be sold via the auction and the exchange.[/p][p][/p][p]The “Berry Fever” ranking is not included in the “Race Participant” medal lines. Ranking results will be announced on July 14th and July 21st at 5:30 MSK. The event will end with the final ranking results.[/p][p][/p][p]The Elinor Bank is gifting berries to everyone! Until July 13th inclusive, for every 100 crystals in a single payment, you will receive 3 chests containing items from the berry collection![/p][p][/p][p]At the Seasons Store, you can purchase a skin of a Guardian of the Emerald Thickets or Malachite Wilds. Applying the skin will turn your character into a summer fairy and allow you to enhance skin stats: counterattack and maximum damage.[/p][p][/p][p]In addition, the City Clan Store now offers pouches with fragments of Rage Platums for Tauri. With 200 fragments and magical glue, you can craft a full platum that increases rage by 10, 15, 20, 25, 30, or 40 points depending on the platum’s color. Players of level 17 and above who collect the full set can craft a Golden Platum granting +60 rage.[/p][p][/p][p]We wish you a delicious berry feast![/p][p]
[/p]

notes.title: Time to Conquer Fire
notes.notes:
[p]Valiant Technomages! As you seek shelter from the scorching sun, you are called to master the power of fire, cool off in the icy lands of the Observatory, search for pouches filled with gemstones to complete collections, and receive a gift from the Elinor Bank — tickets for Lottery Draw No. 11![/p][p][/p][p]To complete the “Conqueror of Fire” quest, you’ll need to: reach level 6 or higher, visit the town headman or the elder, fulfill daily tasks from the citizens, and collect 20 of: Camping Flasks, mason's trowels, fire crystals, fire keys, and crowns. Fire attributes can also be purchased in the Crystal Store.[/p][p]As a reward, you’ll receive the Conqueror of Fire Chest and the corresponding achievement, which will permanently increase your “Weakness of Darkness” stat by 1%.[/p][p]Players who completed the quest last year and have reached level 9 will be eligible to receive the Conqueror of Fire II Chest with more generous rewards, along with an achievement that grants a chance to find Suns in trophies dropped by experienced monsters (excluding those on Snow Island).[/p][p]You can complete the quest until July 31st inclusive, and the reward must be claimed no later than August 1st.[/p][p][/p][p]During the week, the portal to the [u][url="https://info.tmgame.ru/library/world/Observatory/"]Observatory[/url][/u] territory is opened, so you can participate in the "[u][url="https://info.tmgame.ru/library/world/rating/stone_rep/"]Technomagic competition[/url][/u]" ranking.[/p][p]Participation in the Observatory rounds will end on June 29th at 23:30, while the possibility of moving to the base camp ends on July 2nd. The ratings results will be calculated on June 30th at 5:30.[/p][p][/p][p]And of course, a gift from the Elinor Bank! Until the end of June 25th, when you top up your account for every 500 crystals from a single transaction, you will receive one lottery ticket for Draw No.11! By opening the ticket, you can get: legendary aquamarine, diamond spraying armor for 1 year (repeated receiving of such an item is prohibited), metamorphosis of normal runes, key to the C.H.E.S.T. or a crystal chest I![/p][p][/p][p]We wish you to become a fire conqueror![/p][p]
[/p]

notes.title: Summer Fair and More
notes.notes: [p]On this hot summer day, Yar Marko calls everyone to the city squares to shop for exotic wonders for the upcoming month![/p][p]By visiting the fair merchants, you’ll be able to purchase: bundles of keys, lockpicks and locks, water totems (at a 25% discount) and earth totems, alembics and purification elixirs, a resource encyclopedia, onyx safes, and much more, including a new item - a single-use portal to the Landing.[/p][p][/p][p]Throughout the week, once per day, you’ll be able to receive miner’s tools from the city blacksmiths. You can also purchase them in unlimited quantities from Yar Marko’s speculator.[/p][p][/p][p]Until June 15th inclusive, you can test your strength in the Tournament of Equals! To participate, you’ll need to acquire a special ticket, submit an application in the journal on the Academy Square, and wait for your opponent to appear! [/p][p]Upon logging into the game, you’ll receive 10 tickets for the Tournament of Equals daily, and additional tickets and ammunition can be purchased at the Rarity Store.[/p][p][/p][p]More in-game promotions await you![/p][p]Until the end of today, your armor will not lose durability upon defeat in battle. [/p][p]On June 12th, you will receive 50% more money per battle. [/p][p]On June 13th, by visiting the headman or the elder, you’ll be able to choose the effect of Denial or Omniscience for the day. [/p][p]On June 14th, by battling level-appropriate bosses, valiant warriors, and experienced monsters, you’ll have a chance to receive Seals of the Keepers of Knowledge. [/p][p]On June 15th, by defeating opponents in the Colosseum, you’ll have a chance to obtain a key to the C.H.E.S.T.[/p][p][/p][p]Hurry up to buy before the end of the week: a ribbon for a simple bouquet for gold with a 40% discount from the Sales Representative near the Colosseum, and vases in the Crystal Store. You can also exchange or create items with the "exchange" option in the Blacksmith’s store with a 30% discount and reforge the equipment with 80% discount![/p][p][/p][p]We wish you worthy victories among equals![/p]

notes.title: Summer for the Brave
notes.notes:
[p]Glorious Elinorians! Summer is a time of warmth and sunshine, but don't forget about the technomagical duties![/p][p][/p][p]The Village Elder and the Headman have daily quests for the brave! Complete their assignments to earn a Sage's potion, which grants effect of Denial or Omniscience for 2 hours.[/p][p][/p][p]Elinor Bank is giving out gifts! For every 500 crystals in a single transaction, you will receive 1 Lottery Ticket – Draw #4.[/p][p]Opening a ticket may grant you one of the following: enchanted or normal Seal of submission (for 6 months or 1 month), Summoning Seal, 50 lumps of silver, gold, platinum, or palladium clay, magical Scroll of Luck, or 100 Personalized Coins![/p][p][/p][p]A rare item has arrived at the Crystal Store — the Barrel of Denial, which allows you to stop gaining battle experience for a full week![/p][p][/p][p]All offers are available until the end of June 8th![/p][p]
Don’t miss your chance![/p]

notes.title: Malachite Beetles
notes.notes:
A dazzling invasion of Malachite Beetles has blinded Elinor’s citizens with its brilliance, and brought rewards for all bug collectors!

To assemble a Malachite Beetle, you’ll need to get its parts in the following ways:
- 10 coils of gold wire, which is dropped with a chance when defeating experienced monsters
- 10 golden beads – multiple beads can drop at once when defeating a valiant opponent
- ornamental malachite can be found among the rewards from bosses dwelling in dangerous territories
- Master’s Pliers are available in the city stores

Once you’ve assembled beetles, you can exchange them for rewards of your choice, including new additions:
- Normal Participant Token, which grants +1 point to the "Technomagic Competition" ranking or +2 to the Assistant ranking. Normal Token can be upgraded to a Legendary Token for even more ranking points!
- Normal Warrior Cube, which grants Rubidium Plates. Upgrading the Cube to the Enchanted one will bring you a choice between a low-capacity battery and the Rubidium Plates. Magical Cube will let you choose Order of Glory, Heroic Cube – Clot of the battle rage, Epic Cube – Threads of Fate. Each upgrade increases the quantity of resources received.
Low-capacity batteries can be combined to form medium-capacity batteries, and then into high-capacity ones.

Every time you receive a reward from a Malachite Beetle, you also get a chance to receive a rare inlay stone - Adamas of Power  as a bonus reward!

Elinor Bank is enchanted by the charm of Malachite Beetles and will gift you 4 Malachite Beetles for every 100 crystals in a single payment!

You can collect beetle parts and assemble full Malachite Beetles until the end of May 25th. Exchanges for rewards will remain available until the beetles’ lifespan ends.

New Feature: Communicating with the Administration about bugs and issues is now easier. 
The “Problems” section in the Other Functions window has been updated — now you can see your submitted messages and the Admin’s replies directly in the window.

Hurry up to become a proud Malachite Collector!

notes.title: May Fair
notes.notes:
The arrival of Yar Marko has brought enthusiasm to Elinor's squares and calls on everyone to stock up on rare and useful goods!

Don’t miss your chance to purchase these items during the week: Elixirs of Corruption and Grimwood Chests, Gold Tablets and Artisan's Experience, boxes of Light and Darkness, Magic and Aura Transformers, Ancient Human or Dwarf skins, Packs of Mihrutkas and Protectresses with a 20% discount. And much more!

Master blacksmiths have changed how their forges and workshops operate. Now, finished products must be collected manually — as soon as at least one production cycle (one batch) finishes, the "Collect" button will appear. You can either take what’s ready right away or wait for all batches of the current recipe to finish and collect the full set.

Happy shopping!

notes.title: Victory Day is Coming Soon
notes.notes:
The residents of Elinor have begun preparations for the celebration, offering you themed quests and gifts, the rescue of imprisoned souls in the Dark Vaults, in-game events, discounts, rare item sales, and new pouches with fragments of Platums of Resistance and Evil Eye!

Sh'aktayn is calling upon all warriors to help free the imprisoned souls. He will be giving you 3 Shadow Dust daily for liberating 1 to 5 souls upon victory in the Dark Vaults. You can purchase unlimited Shadow Dust from the Sales Representative on the Island of Initiation. For detailed information, check the Quest log.
Soul rescue is available until the end of May 20th, and you can claim rewards until May 21st inclusive.

Until May 11th, be sure to:
- Visit the Headman or the Elder to complete the quests “Great Warriors of the Past” and “Preparations for Victory Day”.
- Buy charming bouquets and themed gifts from the city Florists.
- Enjoy 30% discounts on: Aura Translators at the Artifact Store, Crystal Skin Amplifiers in the Artifact Hall, Enchanted Ink Barrels in the Crystal Store, Sleeping Mihrutkas and Peaceful Protectresses in the Artifact Store and Supply Center.
- Stock up on Skin Artifact workpieces and Blue Crystals at the Rarity Store.
- Purchase Life-giving Ichor, Level Change Certificates, and a limited batch of Boss Summoning Items in the Crystal Store.

In the coming days festive promotions await you!
From the moment this news is published until the end of the day, possessing Crystal Balls will grant triple Hate Charges.
On May 8th, every victory in the Dark Vaults brings an extra Box of Light or Darkness, depending on your chosen path.
On May 9th, (Victory Day) two special bonuses await you during the day! Defeat will not reduce your armor durability. Victories in the Dark Vaults will free twice as many souls, provided you have the necessary amount of Shadow Dust.
On May 10th, killing an equal enemy will grant triple points toward medals for killing with a spell, using a spell or triggering a passive effect.
On May 11th, defeating valiant opponents will award double the amount of "Skills" collection elements.

A new item has appeared on the City Store shelves — pouches with fragments of Platums of Resistance and Evil Eye, plus the option to exchange lower-color fragments for higher ones.

Happy upcoming Victory Day!

notes.title: Elinor Collections
notes.notes:
The time has come once again for the Elinor Collections! Hurry up to gather as many collections as possible to earn Elinor Symbols and spend them on useful items!

Until the end of May 18th, your goal is to assemble collections out of collections, earn Elinor Symbols, and spend them on useful items until the end of May 19th at the Elinor Store.
The final collection "Symbols" is assembled out of the golden elements of five collections and can be exchanged for 25 Elinor Symbols. To obtain these collections' golden elements, you will need to complete various in-game tasks and gather the collections: "Standards", "Tools", "Monsters", "Skills", and "Patrons".
Details on each collection are available on the infoportal.
Please note! The reward for the "Tools" collection has been changed!
You can track your current spending and obtain elements of the "Standards" collection in the quest log.
You can spend your earned Symbols at the Elinor Store on the Trading Square.
Pay attention to those items at the store:
The Geographical Atlas becomes non-transferable upon purchase.
A new feature item of the season: the inlaid multistone arBrilal for armor and weakening effect on outerwear. When using Primordial Resin, this stone boosts the Armor stat. 
As a seasonal exception, normal Primordial Resin is available for Symbols at the Elinor Store, and can be exchanged for a high-quality version at the Jeweler’s Store.

By getting collections, you also participate in the ranking, which contributes to the "Race Participant" medal line. Rankings will be finalized twice: on Monday, May 12th and May 19th at 5:30 AM.

Until May 18th inclusive, the Elinor Bank will give you a gift depending on the amount of crystals purchased. The gift is a Collector’s Chest with a different number of collection elements.

For a payment of 100 to 449 crystals – you will receive an Enchanted Collector’s Chest. For 450 to 899 crystals – a Magical Chest. For every 900 crystals in a single payment – a Heroic Collector’s Chest.

We wish you the best of luck in collecting every single Elinor Collection!

notes.title: Spring Labor Day
notes.notes:
The first days of May are full of festive weekends and promotions, but the elder and the headman believe that true technomages need to put in a bit of effort—and you are the one who can help in the coming days!

Zlatovan and Koragor need your help collecting and handing out brooms to locals for the Great Cleanup, while the local farmer will need assistance growing seedlings. Of course, pleasant rewards are promised for your efforts!

At the stalls of the city's Florists, you can find festive gifts - a perfect way to remind your fellow technomagic friends of your care.

By defeating valiant warriors and experienced monsters, you might find Grobft's safes among your trophies. The first opening of an Iron Safe is completely free. For further openings, as well as for Gold and Onyx Safes, you’ll need to pay in crystals. Inside you will find valuable treasures, including the grand prize: a Certificate for an Individual Seal!  
You can find the full prize list on the infoportal.

Among the list of promotions, you’ll also find the Wheel of Fortune. For a small payment in Personalized Coins, spin the wheel to receive one of the types of Magic Storages or a Chest with Magic Storages.

All festive events and gifts from the Florists are available until the end of May 4th.

And of course the festive promotions!  
Until the end of today: by defeating valiant warriors, you get a chance to receive a Fortune Cookie.  
On May 1st: Experienced monsters and opponents of the hostile race with a chance will drop normal Magic Storages.  
On May 2nd: by defeating experienced monsters in dangerous territories with enchanted flasks, you can receive 2 Water Substances.
On May 3rd: The elder and the headman will grant you a full-day effect of Omniscience or Denial.
On May 4th: all money earned in duels will be increased by 50%.

And already on Monday, the Elinor Collections event begins!

Wishing you an exciting and joyful holiday weekend!

notes.title: Weekend Promotions
notes.notes:
Glorious Elinorians! The upcoming weekend brings exciting in-game promotions and platinum tokens as a gift from the Elinor Bank.

Until the end of the current day, you are guaranteed to receive a Gray Pouch of Gems from every Elinor stash.
On Saturday, April 26th, you will earn double the amount of Jubilee Thalers as rewards for winning at the "Elinoria" theme park attractions.
On Sunday, April 27th, you will gain twice the points in the Observatory ranking for defeating opponents from the enemy team and delivering the sphere.

Elinor Bank is giving out gifts! Until the end of April 27th, for every 100 crystals in a single payment, you’ll receive 10 platinum tokens for participating in the theme park attractions.

Newly, you can get a chance to obtain a Ghostly Card of Variability from a Ghostly Box.

We wish you a wonderful weekend!

notes.title: Easter Weekend
notes.notes:
Elinor is known for its traditions and Grand Celebrations! This upcoming weekend, you can take on Easter quests, battle Evil Geese, and find painted eggs at the stalls of the charming Florists.

Upon logging into the game, you’ll gain access to daily quests to earn Golden Technomagic Eggs, while Barfos and Nagor will ask for your help in the “Atonement for Sins” quest. Additionally, you will receive several Evil Goose Feathers, which summon a terrifying monster that somehow managed to copy your stats for battle! If you are victorious, you will receive a Nest containing one of the following: a colorful painted egg, a golden egg, or golden egg shells. By gluing together 10 shells with Magic Superglue, you can create a whole Golden Egg!
You can find Evil Goose Feathers among trophies from Evil Geese. They are also available in the Rariry Store for universal Coins. Defeat 200 Evil Geese to earn a special achievement with a reward of 200 Golden Eggs!

Crack Open a Golden Technomagic Egg for Rewards! Each Golden Egg may contain one of the following valuable items: Gladiator Coin, Sun, Tauri, Expedition insignia, Silver Hunter Coin, Golden Coins, Painted, Armor-Piercing, or Rotten Egg, Golden Egg, Fullerite shard, Shimmering shard, or shard of a Special Stone, Level-based Elixirs of Purification, Magnecharge, or a gift to the character’s info.
Golden Eggs can be exchanged for festive, rare, and unique ammunition in the Rarity Store.

Quest completion and Evil Goose Battles are available until the end of April 20th, while Spending Golden Eggs is available until April 21st inclusive.

You can also purchase souvenir eggs made of precious stones from the Florists to gift your friends.

Wishing you a joyful grand celebration!

notes.title: The Seventeenth Technomagiversary!
Back to the Skies Tomorrow
notes.notes:
Tomorrow you will have a chance to relive how the heroes of Elinor dared to conquer the heights of the sky. But today, set out in search of a strange "thing" and receive a gift from the Bank of Elinor!

Starting today, Torador or Donovan are ready to send any willing technomage of level 5 and above on a quest to find parts for restoring an ancient flying machine capable of soaring through the skies. Once that is complete, you will embark on a new mission - to search for the Talker Bird.
The search is time-limited, and you must complete everything before the end of April 15th.

By topping up your character’s crystal account, you will receive gifts from the Elinor Bank! For every 500 crystals in a single transaction, you will be awarded 1 Rune of Contentment. By opening each rune, you have a chance to receive a stone of weakening, a fragile stone of weakening, or 5,000 crystals.
The fragile (90-day duration) and normal stones of weakening can be exchanged for a one- or two-handed rune of weakening with additional effects: Hunter, Master, Shion, and a new effect - Projectile thrower.

Wishing you successful skyward adventures!

notes.title: Fair Week
notes.notes:
The arrival of Yar Marko promises lively cheers across the city squares in the coming days, as all Elinorians hurry to experience a beautiful soul gust, acquire valuable goods from distant lands, and toss a few coins into the Fountain of Fortune for a chance to receive one of its newly updated lucky gifts.

By speaking with Yar Marko, you’ll receive several lottery tickets as a gift and have the chance to purchase a level-limited batch of Money Tree Leaves.
Visiting Togrob, who has arrived alongside the fair entourage, allows you to buy various resources and inlaid stones for earrings.
Tossing a coin into the Fountain of Fortune at the city squares will grant you ingredients for creating Adaliants and ArAdaliants, as well as new gifts for friends and foes alike, which cannot be purchased from the charming Florists!
Yar Marko’s Speculator will offer you the chance to stock up on Leader's Chests and Heroic Search Devices, Ghostly and Empty Valor Tokens, Yar Marko’s own inlaid stones, and many other useful items!
The foreign merchant’s assistant has stocked his stalls with Pandora’s boxes and Paratrooper Gloves, Fair Bags (Champion Warrior Runes replaced with Silver Runes), and more surprises!
Additionally, throughout Fair Week, you’ll find barrels with Elixirs of Purification, Memories of Heroes, crystal and gold Piggy banks, and Fusion Catalyst sets. For Elinor’s fashion enthusiasts, a variety of Exotic Monster Avatars are available for purchase, along with stylish and trendy avatars celebrating the 17th anniversary of Technomagic!

In anticipation of Technomagic’s anniversary, the gods of Elinor are holding a special poll about desired gifts!
By using the promotion icon on the right side of the screen, you can select three of your most desired gifts from the provided list. After April 14th, you’ll be able to claim one of your chosen gifts in the city square, but make sure to do so before April 20th, 2025!

Happy shopping and enjoy the fair!

notes.title: Elinor’s Entertainments
notes.notes:
The start of a new week in Elinor brings the chance to obtain Personalized Chests, hunt for Goblin Treasures using Cobalt Picks, and receive a lottery gift from Elinor Bank!

Both Normal and Heroic Personalized Chests are available in Elinor once again! By defeating monsters and valiant opponents, you can obtain Normal or Heroic Personalized Chests. Chests from unexperienced monsters are limited, but Heroic Chests are available in unlimited quantities at the Rarity Store.
Normal chests can be opened with a simple hand movement, however, Heroic chests require several Personalized Coins to unlock.
The most valuable treasures inside the chests include a Certificate for Character Level Change and an Individual Seal!

The Goblin Mines are open for treasure hunting! Using Cobalt Picks, you’ll enter mystery-filled mines and test your luck in search of untold treasures. A limited number of picks can be obtained at the City Store in exchange for Universal Coins, while an unlimited number of Cobalt Picks is available at the Crystal Store.
More details about the excavation can be found here.

The opportunity to obtain Personalized Chests and search for treasures ends on April 10th, 2025.

Elinor Bank is giving away gifts! Until April 9th, for every 1,000 crystals in a single transaction, you’ll receive 1 lottery ticket for Draw #1.

Wishing you amazing discoveries and generous rewards!

notes.title: First April Events
notes.notes:
Glorious Technomages! Until the end of the weekend, you can take part in the “Talisman Magic” and “Tournament of Equals” events!

Complete daily quests to earn Magic storages, essential for enhancing Power Talismans. The "Talisman Magic" event is available to Elinorians level 7 and above, and more details can be found in the Quest Log upon logging in.

Every day when you log in, you’ll receive 10 tickets for the Tournament of Equals. To participate, simply register in the special journal at the Academy Square. In the tournament battles, all participants have equal spells and stats, and only two types of ammunition — Power and Gem Concentrates — are available. Tournament ammunition and additional tickets can be purchased at the Rarity Store.
Winning a tournament battle grants 1 point in the "Fighter" and "Triumph" rankings and a Blue Jester Mask for the Carnival collection

The "Talisman Magic" and "Tournament of Equals" events will end by the end of April 6th.

We wish you a fantastic weekend!

notes.title: Spring Enchantment
notes.notes:
The last week of the month has arrived in Elinor, which means the Technomagic competition and the portal to the snowy lands of the Observatory are back!

You can find the full description of the Observatory and the "Technomagic competition" ranking on our info portal.
Take part in the in-game events, and remember that Observatory duels will end on March 30th at 23:30, access to the base camp, as well as purchasing and opening boxes lenses, will be unavailable after April 2nd, and the "Technomagic competition" rankings will be finalized on March 31st at 05:30 Moscow time.

Additionally, Julian's Shop now offers new skins - Guardian of the Protected Forest and Guardian of the Everlasting Forest! Enhancing them will enhance your character’s Block and Maximum Damage stats.

We wish you a successful week!

notes.title: Elinorian News
notes.notes:
Glorious warriors! We hurry to inform you about the Colorful Week, new card decks, and other game changes.

The "Colorful Week" has begun! By making a small payment of at least 70 crystals, you will receive a magical Petal of a certain color as a gift. You can sell it or exchange it with fellow players for a different colored petal and collect seven-colored flowers to earn rewards!

Starting today, new scouts - the Undergrounders can be encountered in the Level 1 Mines and Soli-Dor Mines. You can fight up to 5 Undergrounders per day. If you lose, you have 2 hours to return and challenge them again. After the time expires or if you defeat them, they will reappear the next day. By defeating the new warriors, you will receive Soli-Dor Mine Trophies and, with some chance, one of the following cards:  
Fierce Miner, Treacherous Slaughterer, Black Prospector, Harsh Miner, and Dangerous Coal Digger.
A full set of these cards can be combined into a Normal Undergrounder Joker, allowing you to summon such a warrior once every 2 days. Two Normal Jokers can be combined using a Card Box into an Enchanted Joker, which allows summoning once per day. By collecting a Legendary Joker, you will be able to summon a warrior up to 5 times per day.

Please note, that to summon an Undergrounder, you must be equipped with the MK Set and have at least 100 Aggressive Environment Immunity.

The second new deck is the Dark Lord Cards!
By defeating one of the Lords of Oblivion, Terror, Madness, or Chaos, you have a chance to obtain a rare card from this deck.
A full collection of these cards can be combined into a Normal Gron-Norg Joker, allowing you to summon one of the Dark Lords once every 30 days. Gron-Norg joker can be upgraded to Enchanted and Magical, reducing the boss summoning waiting time to 15 and 5 days, respectively.

Remember that three identical cards can be exchanged for one random different card from this deck. There is also a small chance to obtain these cards from Ghostly Boss Card or Undergrounder Card. Ghostly Undergrounder Card is now available from the Ghostly Box.

And now, a few gameplay updates:
— The Burnt Cheesecake ammunition will now function like all other ammunition, applying only one effect at a time instead of stacking multiple effects.
— Inlay Drills of the same color will now take up only one inventory slot.
— The Counterattack  Magic of shadow-binders will now last for 2 turns instead of 3 and will return 120% damage instead of 150%.

Enjoy the game!

notes.title: Collect the Hearts of the Mines
notes.notes:
It’s time to hurry and complete as many quests as possible because the Heart of the Mines event has begun in Elinor! This means you have the chance to obtain rare inlaid gems and strengthen your character’s equipment!  

The quest log contains a list of available quests for the *Heart of the Mines* event, their descriptions, and the rewards you can earn: Hearts of the Mines, boxes with Hearts of the Mines, or simply their shards!
For the *Grimwood Hunter* quest, available from level 7 and completed once, as well as the daily quests *Crystal Fever*, *Successful Investment* (spending crystals), and the one-time *League Tournament Winner* quest, available from level 6, you will receive Hearts of the Mines.
For the daily quests *Tournament Participant*, *Successful Investment* (spending gold), *Dungeon Warrior*, and *Fearless Hunter*, available from level 6, you will receive boxes with Hearts of the Mines.
For the *Freelance Hunter* quest, available from level 6, you will receive shards of Heart of the Mines.
Attention!
To complete the *Grimwood Hunter* quest, you will need to open the chest left at the death site of Drent Turned.  
When completing the *Successful Investment* quest, make sure that your expenses are listed in the quest description, or check whether your planned expenses will be counted.
To complete the *Dungeon Warrior* quest, you now need to defeat shadow binders in the Catacombs and the Soli-Dor Dungeons.

Upon logging into the game, you will receive 10 passes daily to participate in the League Tournament. Additional passes and tournament elixirs can be purchased in the *Rarity Store*, and to enter the tournament, you need to register in the book on the Academy Square.
Winning in the tournament grants points toward the personal *Fighter* ranking and the clan *Triumph* ranking, as well as a Heart of the Mines shard, one of the tournament elixirs, or a League Tournament pass.

Hearts of the Mines can also be obtained by dismantling any gems with Yar Marco using a *Jeweler’s Toolkit* from the *Supply Center*, or by spinning the *Wheel of Fortune* to win a box with a Heart of the Mines.
When opening boxes with Hearts of the Mines, you have a chance to obtain a whole Heart or several of its shards. 100 shards can be combined into a whole Heart using *Magic Glue* or *Magic Superglue*.

Whole Hearts of the Mines can be exchanged at the *Supply Center* for inlaid gems of your choice.
A new item has been added to the store’s assortment: the *Taming Adamas of the Ancients*, which combines the effects of the Taming Rune and the Rune of the Ancients. It is also possible to exchange a *Durable Taming Adamas* for a *Taming Adamas of the Ancients* with an additional cost in Hearts of the Mines.
Please note! Only one *Taming Adamas* (Temporary, Durable, or of the Ancients) can be equipped on a character at a time.

Quest completion is available until the end of March 30th, and the combination of shards into Hearts of the Mines and their exchange at the *Supply Center* will be available until the end of March 31st.

We wish you thrilling adventures!  

P.S.  
The effect of the *Rune of the Ancients* has been clarified - it now fully matches its description: it reduces not only the enemy’s life but also their health every three turns by the specified amount.

notes.title: Congratulations on the First Spring Holiday!
notes.notes:
Already tomorrow, the wonderful half of the world will be showered with gifts and well-wishes, while today, brave and courageous warriors are searching for the most original surprises for their beloved Ladies. But for now, take a moment to join the celebration in the world of Elinor!

Horsefly and Hilgor need your help preparing a gift for a Lady of the heart, while the Headman and the Elder are worried that the holiday is approaching too fast. Friend Martius is concerned about the arrival of spring, and the glorious Bruno is searching for the perfect gift for his beloved Juno and her charming grandmother! These quests will be available until the end of March 10th.

Gathering bouquets of tulips, lilies of the valley, and snowdrops will make you a participant in the "Flower Week" ranking!
Bouquets of lilies of the valley and tulips can be grown by purchasing tulip bulbs or lily of the valley seeds, a pot of magical soil, and a watering can with magical water from the Sales Representative near the Colosseum. Bouquets of snowdrops can be obtained by defeating Elinor’s monsters and valiant opponents.
Each bouquet collected or obtained grants 1 point toward the "Flower Week" ranking. The winning places of the "Flower Week" also contribute to the "Race Participant" medal line. The ranking results will be announced on March 10th at 5:30 AM.

And, of course, the "Knights’ Tournament"!
Upon entering the game, each Knight will receive a brooch for their beloved Lady, which they must gift to their chosen one, willing to share their victories in the tournament and earning Charm points for her.
Ladies can return the gesture by gifting the Knight their handkerchief, ribbon, or glove, increasing both the knight’s Glory and their own Charm.
Daily, upon entering the game, players receive 20 attempts to participate in tournament battles until the end of the day. Using a Knight’s Talisman increases the number of available tournament battles by 12 until midnight and grants +5 Glory or Charm per tournament victory for 2 hours.
Gifts for knights and Knight’s Talismans can be obtained with a chance upon victories on the Island of Initiation or in the Colosseum or purchased in stores: handkerchief and ribbon are available for gold, while Knight’s Talisman is available for Personalized Coins in the Rarity Store. Gloves are available in the Crystal Store. The Knights’ Tournament Pass is also available in the Rarity Store, allowing one additional battle per day.

By winning a tournament, the Knight gets +1 Glory toward the "Most Glorious Knight" ranking, while the Lady gets +1 Charm toward the "Most Enchanting Lady" ranking. Rewards also include generous gifts from normal barrel of ink to magical coin workpieces, as well as points toward the personal "Fighter" ranking.
Ranking results will be announced on March 10th at 5:30 AM.

Elinor Bank congratulates all the lovely Ladies and grants gifts to everyone!
By making a payment before March 9th, for every 500 crystals in a single transaction, you will receive 1 lottery ticket for Draw #9!

And on Tuesday, get ready for the "Heart of the Mines" event!

Happy holiday to all the enchanting warrior women!

notes.title: Wheel of Fortune and More
notes.notes:
The Maslenitsa celebration continues! Until the end of the weekend, you still have time to test your luck by spinning the Wheel of Fortune, purchasing Barrels of Denial, and receiving Maslenitsa bast baskets as a gift for making a payment!  

Until March 2nd, you can enjoy:  
— The Wheel of Fortune, where for a small fee, you can win an extra safe slot, a card box, a metamorphosis for normal runes, a blacksmith’s alchemical stone for transforming ore, and other prizes.  
— Barrels of Denial available in the Crystal Store, which, when used, can pause experience gain for an entire week (except for forced experience gain).  
— A gift from the Elinor Bank! For every 300 crystals spent in a single transaction, you will receive 2 Maslenitsa bast baskets filled with festive ammunition!  

And on Monday, you’ll have the chance to take calligraphy lessons, inscribing symbols that enhance character attributes, as well as complete tasks for brave warriors.  

Wishing you a delicious weekend!

notes.title: Elinor Maslenitsa
notes.notes:
Every technomagical house is filled with the aroma of crepes, pancakes, and cheesecakes! Maslenitsa, the beloved time of Longholm and Khatog residents has arrived!
The city tavern needs your help delivering festive treats to honored residents. You can also take part in the traditional ritual of burning the Maslenitsa effigy as everyone awaits spring.
Quests can be completed until March 2nd, and rewards can be claimed until March 3rd, inclusive.
Important! The reward (Maslenitsa Chest) can only be claimed if you do not already have chests previously received as a reward for this quest.

On Friday, February 28th, near the Maslenitsa effigy, you will find a festive pillar, which you can climb for valuable gifts every 12 hours until March 2nd. You can also climb the pillar by purchasing Sun Tokens in the Crystal Store and using them to lift the restrictions.

No Maslenitsa is complete without a crepe ranking!
Throughout the week, as you bake delicious crepes, you will earn points in the ranking. The rewards for top placements include:
— Maslenitsa Ammunition Sets for the “Farewell to Winter” medal and points toward the “Race Participant” medal line!
To bake crepes, you’ll need to purchase a crepes mix and gather filling ingredients from Elinor’s monsters:
— Spider tenderloin from adult spiders, darkweeds, and arachnids;
— Spooky-mushroom from ancient skeletons, zombies, miners, coalmen, and gravediggers.
You must mix these ingredients with Power Elixir or Elixir of Hardness to create the most delicious crepe filling. Everything needed for the crepes preparation can also be purchased from the Sales Representative near the Colosseum.
Crepes can be used in battles until the end of March, and the ranking results will be announced on March 3rd at 5:30 AM.

Additionally, throughout the week, you can participate in the Observatory Season and the "Technomage Competition" ranking!
Ranking results will also be announced on March 3rd at 5:30 AM, Observatory rounds will conclude on March 3rd at 11:30 PM, and the Base Camp portal will close by the end of March 5th.  

Enjoy the most delicious crepes, pancakes, and cheesecakes!

notes.title: Defender’s Day is Coming
notes.notes:
As the holiday approaches, entertainment events, game promotions, and discounts have appeared in Elinor, along with statues of the First Black Knight and the Bounty Hunter in the squares of Longholm and Khatog.

Upon entering the game, you will be notified about the installation of the statues of the First Black Knight and the Bounty Hunter in the central squares. Until the end of February, you can make offerings of military insignias and receive rewards for showing honor.
By visiting Gaslan or Nadum, you will find festive quests: "Glorious Combat Traditions" and "Stolen Relics." Quest-related items can also be purchased from trade representatives near the Colosseum.
The quests will be available until February 25th, inclusive.

The Servant of Darkness, Sh'aktayn, has taken an interest in your combat abilities and calls upon you to participate in freeing imprisoned souls!
When visiting the Dark Vaults, you need to have shadow dust with you. By emerging victorious in the Dark Vaults, you will receive 1 to 5 souls at the cost of some dust. Each day throughout the event, Sh'aktayn will grant you 3 pieces of dust, and you can purchase an unlimited amount from the Sales Representative on the Island of Initiation.
The soul liberation event will end on March 6th, and rewards can be claimed until the end of March 7th.

Take some time to go on a search for ancient mechanisms! Hilgor and Virkli will offer you one of five quests at random each day. Completing them will earn you Ancient Tokens and Grimbold Coins, which are required for acquiring items in the Supply Center that help unlock various medals. For a certain fee, you can remove the quest timer, with the cost increasing each time but resetting at midnight.
By using the "Notes on the Ancients," you can cancel an unwanted quest and receive a new one under general conditions.
The ancient mechanism search quests will be available until March 2nd inclusive, while rewards and item purchases can be made until the end of March 3rd.

You can find a more detailed description of all the events mentioned in the quest log.

This weekend you can enjoy game promotions and discounts:  
- On February 21st, victories in the Dark Vaults will free twice as many imprisoned souls when shadow dust is used.  
- On February 22nd, your armor will retain its durability upon defeat.  
- On February 23rd, "Paratrooper" will be available without an obsidian fee or an attack order.

Until the end of February 23rd, you’ll get a 30% discount on exchanging and crafting character equipment in the in-game forge. The cost of the first removal of the Ancient quest timer is reduced to 25 Personalized Coins, while each subsequent removal will increase in cost by 25 Personalized Coins.

Brave gifts and the "Festive Grenade" firecracker for courageous defenders can be found at the city florists' stalls!

And, of course, gifts from the Elinor Bank! By replenishing your account before the end of February 27th, for every 300 crystals from a single payment, you will receive one Ancient Chest containing items for the "Ancient Mechanisms" event!

Happy holiday, dear Defenders!

notes.title: Arrival of CatAmour
notes.notes:
Valentine's Day is CatAmour's favorite holiday, and he will joyfully spend this day surrounded by the Elinorins, giving them ruby coins and good vibes.  
Technomages of level 5 and above can expect a series of one-time romantic adventures: “Cursed Love,” “The cares of lovers,” “Gifts for Lovers,” “Stolen Love,” “Mysterious Bouquet,” and “Assisting CatAmour,” as well as the quest “The Missing Groom,” and after completing the “Cursed Love” quest, daily tasks with rewards in ruby coins.

At the Crystal Store, you can find Amour's chests, which contain ruby coins, love potion supplies, Valentine's cards, and more.

To spend your ruby coins, visit CatAmour’s Store, located in the Trading Square (top game menu).  
Quest completion is available until February 20th, and shopping at CatAmour's Store is available until the end of February 21st.

A "Love Week" ranking is coming, where you can show your affection in the form of Valentine's cards.  
Holiday cards can be obtained in several ways:
— Combine 1 magical parchment, 1 scorp’s venom, and 1 heart. The magical parchment can be bought in the city store, scorp’s venom is dropped by scorps, and the heart can be found with a chance among the trophies from any monsters and is guaranteed upon defeating valiant warriors: three hearts in the Dark Vaults, two in the Coliseum, and one in other battle zones.  
— Take the recipe from Iria or Ungor and follow the instructions to prepare a heart-shaped pastry from the culinary mix and selected ingredients, which can be exchanged for Valentine's cards.

The ranking will end, and results will be announced on February 21st at 5:30. Prizes will be awarded under the "Race Participant" medal line.

Bank of Elinor congratulates all lovers! When purchasing crystals before 11:59 PM on February 20th, 2025, you will receive ruby coins equal to the bonus of personalized coins.

Romantic gifts have appeared on the counters of city florists. Hurry and write warm words to your loved ones.

We congratulate all Elinor citizens on the holiday!

notes.title: Yar Marko in Elinor
notes.notes:
The month has flown by, and once again, the Rare Goods Fair is available in the squares of Longholm and Khatog!
This time, Yar Marko offers Magical Scrolls of Luck, Onyx Safes, Pandora’s Chests, Earth and Water Totems, Pro Tools, and much more!  
In honor of the upcoming Valentine’s Day, you can also purchase CatAmur avatars and a Solid Heart granting you the greatest power of love!  

Additionally, until the end of February 13th, everyone has a chance to collect a Medallion of Fortune, which increases the amount of coins earned from victories by 50%, and gives an opportunity to earn iron Grobft's safes from experienced monsters with some chance.

To get a medallion, you need to find its shards among the trophies from experienced monsters, and with a Four-Leaf Clover combine three shards into a whole medallion.

You can obtain Four-Leaf Clovers in the following ways:  
— 1 piece in the City Store and the Clan City Store for Tauri.  
— 1 piece per 100 crystals in a single transaction (the limit is 50 pieces during the event).  

The more Lucky Medallions you assemble, the longer Clover’s power will remain active! The lifespan of each Lucky Medallion is 3 days, however, by collecting all the medallions, you can enjoy the effect for 156 days!

Wishing you great finds and lucky purchases!

notes.title: Technomagic Auction 2025 Has Begun!
notes.notes:
Glorious citizens of Elinor! We declare the annual Rare Items Auction officially open!
To enter the auction, you will need to click on the special icon on the right side of the screen. Only characters of level 7 and above can participate in the bidding, provided they have at least 10% of the planned bid amount in crystals. The auction rules and lot descriptions can be viewed here. 
Bidding on a lot will end once the specified time expires, but not earlier than 10 minutes after the last bid.  
Reminder: You cannot cancel your bid at own will once it has been placed.
Upon receiving a certificate of purchase for a lot, you must top up your character’s account with enough funds to cover the lot no later than February 10th (Moscow time). To claim your lot, contact Messenger on the forum via private message or send an email from your registered account to zakaz@tmgame.ru providing your readiness to pay and recipient details.

In honor of the upcoming auction, Elinor Bank is rewarding all its depositors!
Until February 9th, for every 500 crystals in a single transaction, you will receive a guaranteed lottery ticket for the 8th draw. The grand prize of this draw is an Immortality Rune for Earring, as well as a chest with magic storages, magical boots of speed, pouches with fragments of the damage platum, or 100 personalized coins! The more tickets you collect, the higher your chances of winning a rare prize!

Wishing you successful bidding!

notes.title: Seasonal Events
notes.notes:
The last week of the month in Elinor marks the time for getting precious gem collections and the opening of the portal to the Observatory Camp.  

Throughout the week, you can embark on exciting adventures in the new Observatory season and compete in the "Technomage Tournament" ranking!  
The ranking results will be announced on February 3rd at 5:30 AM. Participation in the Observatory rounds will end on February 2nd at 11:30 PM. Access to the base camp will remain available until February 5th.  

By purchasing crystals until February 29th inclusive, for every 300 crystals from the amount of a single payment, you will receive two purple pouches containing precious gem collection elements.  

Wishing you thrilling adventures!

notes.title: Strengthening Talismans
notes.notes:
Brave warriors and enchanting fighters! Until the weekend ends, you will have an opportunity to collect Magic Storages for strengthening Talismans of Power, test your luck with the Wheel of Fortune, and purchase special items from the Rarity Store.  

Technomages of level 7 and above who have completed the "Talismans of Power" quest can perform daily quests for this event. Completing these will reward you with Magic Storages and chests containing storages of random color, from normal to legendary. Magic Storages are essential for strengthening your Talismans of Power!  
More detailed information about Talismans of Power can be found in the infoportal.  

Try your luck by spinning the Wheel of Fortune to receive one of the types of Magic Storages, an Ancestral Chest, or a chest with Magic Storages.  

Visit the Rarity Store to find artifact skin workpieces and a blue crystal.  

All activities are available until January 19th.  

We wish you the best of luck!

notes.title: Happy Holidays!
notes.notes:
The New Year is a time for magic, joy, and winter wonder. Let every home be filled with happiness and kindness, and may every day of the New Year bring you love and laughter. Best wishes to all, dear Elinorians!

Through January 8, enjoy these festive discounts:
— 75% off renaming your character.
— 30% off reforging, aura changes, item exchanges, and crafting.
— Vault slots at the bank are now more affordable—starting at just 2 crystals or personalized coins, with each additional slot increasing by 1. For example, buying 20 slots means you save 20%!

Holiday Events & Treats:
— December 30: Pick up ice snowflake shards from any Snow Island monster—no special permission needed!
— December 31: Master’s effect boosts medal points for spell kills, passive triggers, or spell use during kills, stacking with other bonuses.
— January 1: Earn 50% extra gold from trophy victories.
— January 2: Your armor stays intact, even in defeat.
— January 3: Choose between Negation and Omniscience effects from your Elder or Headman.
— January 4: Instant-death protection is off for the day.
— January 5: Particles of Eternal Ice await when you defeat skilled monsters and valiant foes.
— January 6: Double achievement points with Hunter’s effect—it stacks, too!
— January 7: With Enchanted Flasks, you’ll receive double Water Substances.
— January 8: Defeating experienced monsters grants a chance to obtain Magnecharges.

Visit Julian for the Assistant’s Competition! Complete 50 tasks by January 10 to earn an exclusive prize: the Ghostly New Year’s Card.

Don’t forget to share your holiday decorations and join our New Year’s Contest!

Wishing you joy, laughter, and the magic of the season!

notes.title: Holiday Tree Magic
notes.notes:
It’s almost here—the New Year is just a week away! It’s time to spread holiday cheer by stringing garlands and decorating beautiful trees. And in technomagical Elinor the holiday magic doubles up—you get to decorate two trees at once!

Every clan island now boasts a festive tree, ready for your special touch. The Chief Architect has prepared tasks that reward red Christmas balls needed to adorn the tree. By decorating the clan tree, you’ll receive golden cones, which can be exchanged at the Winter Spirit’s store on the clan island for various items.

On Snow Island, Elinorians can decorate the holiday tree using blue Christmas balls, which are earned by completing tasks given by the Headman. Decorating this tree will earn you silver cones, which can be exchanged at the Winter Spirit’s stall nearby. Among the new offerings in the exchange is a key to a secret winter vault, granting access to storage slots for your treasures and the ability to teleport to the vault whenever you like.

A gentle reminder: You can only work on one tree task at a time—either “Crystal Spring” or "Great Bonus.” If you’d like to switch, just cancel your current task. Don’t worry—your progress is always saved!

The Winter Spirit’s store now lets you trade junior brilmits for senior ones and power them up with spruce resin — available exclusively in the store. Inlaid gems can also be enhanced with primordial resin.

Ready to show your skills? Sign up for the League Tournament in the Academy’s square! Battle your way through Copper, Silver, Gold, Platinum, and Diamond leagues. Each victory earns you points for leaderboards and a chance at prizes like snowflake shards, elixirs, or extra passes. Ten tournament passes are distributed daily upon login, with additional passes and elixirs available in the Rarities Store.
Players level 5 and up can join rankings like “Tree Decorator,”, "New Year's Decorator" “Loyal Friend,” and “Close Friend.” Results will be announced on January 1 and January 8, 2025, at 5:30 am (Moscow time). Ratings do not count towards the Race Participant medal line. 
Tree decorations with holiday ornaments will be available until January 7. Spending golden and silver cones, as well as exchanging rewards, will be possible until and including January 8, 2025.

In the city store on the Snow Island, there are also new available things for you! The image of a blue or light blue snake with the ability to increase the characteristic “Resourcefulness” and artifact snake venom, by improving which you will reduce the damage absorbed by the enemy's armor. 

In the assortment of florists appeared New Year's gifts, clappers and the symbol of the coming year with cheerful wishes! 

And here’s a little extra holiday magic: When you log in, you’ll have the chance to send a letter to Winter Spirit. Choose three of your most desired gifts and send your letter before the end of 2024. From January 1 through January 8, 2025, a Winter Spirit’s gift bag will appear near the town tree, where you can claim one of the three gifts you selected.

May this New Year bring joy, wonder, and everything you’ve been wishing for!

notes.title: Welcome to the Winter Valley
notes.notes:
The magic of the New Year is in the air, and the Winter Valley has opened the gates to all courageous warriors and charming champions to explore its frosty wonders.

— Help the Snow Spirit bring joy by delivering gifts! This year, Hertha and one of the Guardians of Knowledge - Killian or Borgar - are also on the list for special presents.
— Complete a series of winter quests (if you haven’t done so yet): "The 12 Months," "Mood of the Snow Queen," "Fragments of the Ice Mirror," "Juno’s Disappearance," and the new quest, "Search for the author of the mysterious note."
— After completing "The 12 Months", defeat snowmen in the Winter Valley and Snow Island to gather snowflake shards. Glue them together to make whole snowflakes and trade them for delightful festive treats in the Winter Valley store.
— Visit the Cave of Cold and test your strength against the fearsome snake boss. You might find winter ammunition, eternal ice particles, winter boss cards, and other valuable rewards among its trophies.

Remember, all events and activities will end when the Winter Valley closes its gates in the end of January.

And don’t forget! On December 25, you’ll have the chance to decorate the clan tree and the New Year’s tree. Plus, send a letter to the Winter Spirit, asking for your most-wished-for gift! Full details will be revealed on December 25.

Have a blast this season with frosty adventures and holiday fun!

notes.title: The New Year Is Coming!
notes.notes:
The New Year spirit is spreading all over Elinor! Soon, the squares of Longholm and Khatog will be adorned with lovely, fluffy Christmas trees — radiating joy and cheer for all to enjoy.

The "Colorful Week" has begun! Make a purchase of 70 crystals by 7:55 AM on December 25, and you’ll receive petals of the Magic Flower. Share them with friends, or turn them into beautiful magic seven-petal flowers, vibrant bouquets, and decorative flower baskets. Learn more on the info portal!

This Friday, December 20, at 11:00 AM, a lush green Christmas tree will grace the squares of Longholm and Khatog, along with Grobft’s New Year Safe filled with winter gifts!
For the first three days, enjoy one special gift per day near the tree. Afterward, the tree will continue to share its Grace daily until the end of January.

To open Grobft's New Year Safe located near the tree, you'll need a key bundle, available at the Crystal Store and the Supply Center. Don’t miss the 50% discount on key bundles available until December 19!
With the key bundle, you can claim one of the following prizes daily until the end of January 2025:
— Hero Certificate
— 5000 Crystals
— Solid Opalion (tradable)
— 20 Sunnies
— Heart of the Forest Spirit
— Ancestral Chest
— Hermit's Magic Chest
— 20 Eternal Ice Particles
— 2 Ghostly Crystals
— Card Box
— 20 Personalized Coins
— 2 Normal Cubes of Doubt
— 5 Normal Giants Glace
Want more loot? Grab additional Grobft New Year Safes at the Crystal Store, and crack them open anytime until the end of winter! Even safes from past years will be ready to open once the city tree is in place.
On Monday, gear up for exciting adventures in the Winter Valley, and by Wednesday, dive into decorating your personal and clan trees!

Wishing you joy, warmth, and endless inspiration!

notes.title: Winter Fun is Here!
notes.notes:
The holidays are just around the corner, and the festive cheer is everywhere! To help technomages stay on top of their tasks and enjoy seasonal joy, the Observatory Season and the “Technomagic Competition” ranking have kicked off today. Lucky Tickets and Elixirs of Negation are also waiting for you!

This week, there’s double the excitement with two rankings to join:
— “Technomagic Competition,” where you’ll hunt for gemstone pouches, and build shiny collections from the treasures inside.
— “Pennant Crafting,” where making colorful pennants earns you Hero’s Spirits and progress toward the “Race Participant” medal.

The results for both will be announced on December 23 at 5:30 AM (Moscow time, UTC+03:00) — don’t miss out!
The new Observatory Season offers participants to purchase Bracelet Storage from Hermit-Stargazer’s store. But act fast — you can only grab two per account, and they’ll expire and disappear once the season ends. Inside each case is a winter bracelet, redeemable for Observatory Gold Lenses, but only those matching your character's level or lower.
Rounds in the Observatory will end on December 22 at 11:30 PM (UTC+03:00), and travel to the base camp will be available until December 25 inclusively.
Until December 22, defeating valiant opponents might reward you with a Lucky Ticket filled with prizes. You can also stock up on as many tickets as you like from the Rarity Store using gold coins.
The Crystal Store now offers Enchanted Elixirs of Negation to reduce your experience by 100 points. Normal Elixirs of Negation, which reduce experience by 25 points, can be found by besting valiant warriors.

Enjoy the festivities and good luck on your adventures!

notes.title: Winter Fair
notes.notes:
