Take a break from your winter hustle and drop by the city squares — Yar Marko and his team are there to greet you with open arms! Their stalls are packed with fantastic items, including exclusive festive goods.

What’s waiting for you at the fair: discounted barrels of purification elixirs and alembics, inlaid stones from Yar Marko and a treaty with Yar Marko, items for summoning Elinor bosses and aura translators, Shadow, Light and Pandora boxes, potions of the hunter, wizard, muncher and alchemist, leader and Grimwood chests, encyclopedia of Mine resources, empty valor token and much more. 

Winter special items include: limited-edition winter accounts, ice crystal shards, Santa’s magical staff and gift sack, and new avatars for Technomagic trendsetters. These avatars showcase the upcoming year’s symbol, as well as Eleanor’s very own Santa and Snow Maiden!

Yar Marko is joined by the venerable Torgob, who’s got all the resources you’ll need. And don’t miss Yar Marko’s own offerings: the “Beautiful Soul Gust” and money tree leaves.

Hurry! Until December 15, the Fountain of Fortune awaits you in the squares of Longholm and Khatog. Toss in a gold coin and get one of the prizes listed in the fountain’s description!

Plus, Eleanor’s Bank is extending its spruce twig promotion. Until December 15, get 1 spruce twig for every 100 crystals you purchase in a single transaction!

Shop to your heart’s content, and may your holidays be full of magic and joy!

notes.title: Winter in Elinor
notes.notes:
The warm sun still graces the squares of Longholm and Khatog, but the Snow Spirit has appeared, announcing that Snowy Island is now open. Hurry and set out to explore its winter wonders!

Technomages at level 5 or higher can unlock their first trip to the island by completing the quest "Broken Compass." Meanwhile, experienced adventurers can earn a compass for traveling to the island as a reward for the "Winter is Coming" mission.
Activities Await You on Snowy Island:
Complete "Useful Trinkets," a one-time task from Dylan or Kragor.
Take part in the yearly quest "Snow Conqueror." Collect quest elements by completing daily tasks or purchasing them in the Crystal Store. Finish the quest to earn a Snow Conqueror Chest and achievement.
From level 15, the new achievement "Snow Conqueror IV" grants a +2% bonus to Eternal Ice shard drops from elite monsters.
Daily tasks are available until January 8, 2025. The main quest ends on January 10.
Help the mayor with "Frost Crystals" to earn Frost Regalia with a 30-day duration. Submit the task by January 21, 2025.
Raise your "Hero of Snowy Island" reputation by:
Activating fire runes.
Using special weapons against winter monsters.
Completing daily quests.

High reputation unlocks exclusive items in the island’s store and allows you to craft winter ammo for medal rewards.
Learn ice magic and inscribe spells into your grimoire.
Fight bosses, gather collection of cards, and get a Joker of Snowy Island.

Updates on Snowy Island:
The safe area for Humans and Dwarves has been reduced; bosses Lord of Cold and Antifreeze are now in a danger zone.
The experienced navigator’s compass now includes a new point near the safe zone border.
Some monsters have relocated their lairs.
Certain monsters and bosses have enhanced skills, some abilities now deal damage to the entire team.
The skill "Underground Creature" has been removed from bosses.
The new rule limits boss attacks to 10 players. If the number of players exceeds this limit, 10 will be randomly chosen to fight, and the rest will be moved to nearby tiles.

The loot drops for certain monsters have been updated:
Defeating a Forest Demon will yield mithril ore.
Among the Ice Knight's trophies, you'll find adamantine ore.
The Snow Golem now drops titanium ore.
Victory over a Frost Lizard grants chrome ore.
Besting a Boar will reward you with tungsten ore.
The newly deployed scout squads have reached Snowy Island, driving out the crazed warriors and taking over the frozen lands. On your journey, you may now encounter a fresh foe — the Cryomancer!
You can battle up to 5 Cryomancers daily.  If you’re defeated, you’ll have 2 hours to return and face the experienced warrior again. After this time limit or upon victory, the Cryomancer will only appear the following day.
Defeating the fierce warriors will grant you loot similar to that of other Snowy Island opponents.
To complete the daily “Hot Blood” quest and gather the required elements for the “Snow Conqueror" assignment, you’ll need to secure 3 victories against Cryomancers.

By defeating brave warriors and cryomancers in the Snowy Island territory you have a chance to get one of the cards - Freez, Northerner, Polar explorer, Barbarian and Hyperborean. The full set of cards is assembled into a Normal Cryomancer Joker, which allows you to summon this warrior to battle once every 2 days. Two normal jokers with the help of a card box are collected in the Enchanted Joker, which allows you to call a warrior to battle once a day, and collecting a Legendary Joker you can call a warrior to battle up to 5 times a day. If needed, three identical cards can be exchanged for one random card or acquired through the Cryomancer Ghost Card, which has been added to the Ghost Box.

Special Winter Events:
Every Monday this month introduce a new leaderboard for the "Race Participant" medal series! This week features "The Wisest One" leaderboard, where you’ll compete by winning games in the Sage Box event.
Although New Year’s Day is nearly a month away, the Snow Spirit has already prepared gifts! Until January 8, 2025, receive a Weightless Snowflake daily to trade for bonuses in the Snow Spirit’s shop.
Starting this Wednesday, you can begin building snowmen and decorating festive trees!

Have fun with your winter adventures!

notes.title: The Final Autumn Sale
Purification of the dark ether
notes.notes:
A new week will delight you with the purification of the light-bearing ether and lottery tickets from the Bank of Elinor.
After visiting the town alchemist and herbalist, you will learn how to proceed to purify the ether with aquaionite, which can be obtained in several ways:
- a small amount daily from Valian or Kimihla, with a chance when searching the wells of Soli-Dor and in exchange for universal coins from the Cryptographer;
- defeating skilled monsters of hazardous territories if you have a retort, which is available from the merchant nearby the Colosseum;
- by purchasing them from the Artifact Store.

Purification of the ether is accomplished in several stages, and you can stop at each stage to obtain the specified reward. Purchasing the subsequent dark aether from the Rarity Store will become available after you receive the current progress reward.
Note that once you receive the reward before the end of the event, you will not be able to mine aquaionite until you receive the Aether Purification quest again.
Getting aquaionite is available up to and including November 22, while purifying the ether and selecting an award can be done at any time. 

And once again, there are gifts from the Bank of Elinor waiting for you! For each 1000 crystals from the amount of one payment till the end of November 19 you will receive 1 lottery ticket of draw #6! When you open the ticket, you will get one of the prizes: a set of calligraphic symbols, a casket with strong arBrillmagrams, one of the calligraphic symbols, an enchanted barrel with ink, or 100 crystals!

We wish you a great week!

notes.title: Yar Marco’s Sale
notes.notes:
Elinor’s town squares are bustling with excitement as Yar Marco hosts a spectacular autumn sale on a wide range of goods!
During this festive market week,  discounts from Yar Marco’s assistant and the speculator await you:
- 40% off items categorized as “Ammunition,” “Bonus,” “Weapons,” and “Jewelry.”
- 20–40% off alchemical cauldrons of life, magic, and hate; Ghostly cards of Darkness and Light; cards of magic, desert dweller, shadow-binder and twilight warden cards; ancient human and dwarf skins; small flasks of denial; copying sheets; gladiator standards; ghost boxes, and more.

Additionally, you have a unique opportunity to purchase previously unavailable medals from the lines “Pumpkin Mayhem,” “Egg Champion,” “Farewell to Winter,” and “Love spell datura.”

Please note! Activating the ghost boxes now requires payment in silver hunter coins.

And there’s more! Twilight Warriors (for humans) and Twilight Knights (for dwarves) now offer ongoing challenges in the Dark Vaults. Each player can summon them 5 times per day. Additional combats with Twilight battlers can be purchased once these 5 attempts are used.

Along with regular trophies, victories in the Dark Vaults now yield a chance to obtain one of the cards from a new deck: twilight warden, necromancer, cursed, nightbringer, or renegade. A full set of these cards can be combined into a normal twilight joker, allowing you to summon a warrior every two days. Two normal jokers can be assembled into an enchanted joker, which allows summoning once per day, and a legendary joker allows up to 5 daily summons.
Three identical cards can be exchanged for a random one or obtained from a twilight ghostly card, now added to the ghostly box. Yar Marco’s assistant will happily exchange extra twilight warden cards, and a limited supply of ghostly twilight cards is available from the speculator.

For warriors of level 24 and above: Medals in the “Mighty Giant” line are now available for using legendary giant elixirs. Requirements have increased for the “Mighty Giant II” and “Mighty Giant IV” medals, while the requirement for “Mighty Giant V” has been reduced. Players with existing medals have been credited for any shortfalls to meet the new criteria. 
Medal prices have also been significantly reduced.
The appearance of medals in this and other medal lines with rare ammunition has been updated.

Visit Yar Marco before the discounts end!

notes.title: Autumn Blues
notes.notes:
As autumn sets in, Elinor’s sweethearts, Laura and Miella, have been feeling a bit down. Only your thoughtful attention and summer-inspired gifts can lift their spirits!

Terrus or Terragorcan can help you out to deal with Laura's and Miella's sadness by sharing a secret of what kind of delightful gifts might cheer up those knowledge seekers. 
Preparing a gift requires the following conditions:
- time for making one gift is 4 hours;
- a gift may contain no more than 10 items.
- The total "mood points" in each gift should be at least 100.
After talking with Laura or Miella, you’ll find a list of gift items and how to obtain them in your quest log. You can only give a gift every 12 hours, but you can reset this cooldown for a small fee in personalized coins and by resetting the quest progress, start gathering a new gift.

When the ladies receive a gift, they will reward you with a Happy Autumn Chest. Opening the chest will give you:
- 2–4 Vials with a ray of sun,
- 20 Suns,
- 100 Tauri,
- 5 Gladiator coins.

Vials with the ray of Sun can be exchanged for rewards of your choice:
- 1 vial for 10 Magnecharges (from level 7),
- 10 vials for 10 life-giving ichors or Magical Boots of speed (from level 7),
- 20 vials for 2 Crystal Keys or 5 Technowarrior Chests,
- 50 vials for 3 Leader Chests, a Ghostly Box, or 4 Fragile Horns of Plenty,
- 100 vials for 25 Autumn Surprise Boxes, a Personal Card Box (one-time only), or 250 fragments of the Fractal Matrix  (from level 11),
- 150 vials for 3 Hearts of the Forest Spirit (from level 7, one-time only) or 3 Fullerite Hearts,
- 200 vials for 2000 Legendary Magic Storages or a Sealed Symbol (one-time only).

Concerned for the scholars’ gloomy mood, the Bank of Elinor is also giving gifts to its depositors! Until November 10th, for every 100 crystals from the amount of one payment, you will receive one Swimming circle granting 60 mood points.

You can prepare and send gifts until November 15th, and open chests and exchange Vials with a ray of sun until the end of autumn.

May this help you overcome the autumn blues!

notes.title: New Adventures in the Grimwood
notes.notes:
Valiant technomages! Sheila is waiting for you to share what she discovered in the Grimwood and offer you new adventures!

Upon visiting Sheila, you will learn troubling news about the Grimwood and the need to defend another village neighboring the one where Sheila once lived. 
When you start this quest, this symbol will appear on the right side of your game screen

Clicking on it will open the group formation interface for a Grimwood expedition. All expedition participants will be assigned the same set of characteristics and battle spells. In battle, you can only use a limited selection of ammunition, which needs to be purchased at the Rarity Store. Detailed information about the new Grimwood territories, group formation, and combat parameters can be found on the infoportal. 
We recommend reviewing this information before starting your expedition.

Until the morning technical maintenance on November 6th, you will need only 30 magnecharges to charge the portal. After that, it will require 165. Also, until the end of October, there is a 70% discount on ammunition for Grimwood.

Magnecharges can be earned by completing Sheila’s daily quest or exchanged for a certain amount of light sparks and silver hunter coins in the Rarity Store. The exchange limit is updated weekly. You can also buy magnecharges with crystals (Crystal Store) or personalized coins (Rarity Store).

After completing the "Bad News from Grimwood" quest you will be able to obtain an enchanted Grimwood cloak, exchange the Bloodlust Totem for one of three new totems (Destruction, Accuracy, and Fury), and purchase a Wolf's gem of Will, Blood, or Fear at Herta’s Store in the Grimwood. You can also trade a tuft of wolf hair, a vial of wolf's blood, poisonous thorns, and the Heart of the Forest Spirit for new resources or exchange some new resources for others.

Soon, Sheila will offer to trade your old wolf cloaks and Grimwood stones for the equivalent amount of resources you spent on crafting them. The Grimwood Stone Improvement Scroll can be exchanged back for reward tokens at the Supply Center. The bosses Lorna Ostrobok, Ashley and Run away, and the Forest Spirit around the new village will appear later.

Sparks of light can no longer be obtained. In Groft’s safes, Snow Conqueror’s chests, quest rewards, golden eggs, and rainbow nuts, sparks of light have been replaced with magnecharges. New ways to earn magnecharges will be introduced in the future.

A limited batch of magnecharges and new resources for cloaks, totems, and gems can be purchased in the Halloween Store for Halloween gold coins.

And a small update from the Hermit: a batch of Halloween bracelets is now available in his store. Unfortunately, in his haste to prepare as many as possible, the bracelets are not very durable - they last only 90 days. The bracelet is stored in a special storage, which will remain available until May 31st, 2025. To retrieve a bracelet suitable for your level, you will need to insert the required number of gold lenses in the storage.

We wish you successful expeditions!

notes.title: End of September
notes.notes:
Brave Elinorians! The first month of autumn is coming to an end, and in the coming days, you can look forward to the following events: unbreakable equipment, the search and purchase of Elixirs of Denial, ether purification, and Hermit’s Chests as a gift for purchasing crystals.  
By visiting the city alchemist or the healer, you can begin the ether purification using aquaionite, which can be obtained in the following ways:
— receiving a small amount daily from Valian or Kimihla, gathering it from the wells of Soli-Dor, and exchanging it for universal coins with the Cryptographer;
— if you have a retort, you can find it among the trophies from experienced monsters;
— purchasing it at the Artifact Store.  
Ether purification takes place in several stages, and at each stage, you can stop and receive the specified reward.
Once the purification is complete, you will be able to purchase another dark ether in the Rarity Store for personalized coins.  
The acquisition of aquaionite will stop on September 30th, but you will be able to purify the ether and receive rewards at any time.  
Remember, after receiving the reward for ether purification, the extraction of aquaionite will end, so we recommend claiming your reward at the conclusion of the event. 
Ether extraction will once again become available after purchasing the dark ether.  

Also, until the end of September, you can find enchanted Elixirs of Denial in the Crystal Store!
Using the elixir will reduce your character's current experience on their level by 100 points.
By defeating valiant warriors, you might obtain normal Elixir of Denial, which reduces your character's current experience by 25 points.

💎💎💎The Elinor Bank is giving gifts!
By topping up your character’s account until September 29th inclusive, you will receive 1 magical Hermit's Chest for every 100 crystals in a single payment.💎💎💎

And that’s not all! Until the end of September, your character’s equipment will retain its durability even in defeat.

We wish you a great mood!

notes.title: Dungeon Scouts
notes.notes:
Valiant warriors and fearless fighters! After completing training with the desert scouts, highly skilled warriors of the underground world have come forth.  
Having displaced the previously dwelling Mad Warriors, new scouts - shadow warriors have now appeared in the dungeons and catacombs of Soli-Dor. These warriors are similar to the desert scouts in many ways but possess their own unique abilities.  
Please note that none of your pets or companions will be able to respond to a call for help during a battle with shadow warriors.  
Daily you can defeat up to 5 shadow warriors in each territory. In case of defeat, you have 2 hours to return and face the experienced opponent again. After the time runs out or upon victory, the warrior will return to his base and reappear only the next day.  
By defeating shadow warriors, you will receive all the expected trophies, just as you would for defeating an opponent in the catacombs or dungeons of Soli-Dor.  
In addition to the usual trophies, there is a chance to find cards of the underground inhabitants — shadow binder, cavemen, catacomb dwellers, draconoids, and reptiloids. 
A full set of cards can be combined into a normal shadow binder joker, which allows you to summon such warrior for battle once every 2 days. Two normal jokers can be combined into an enchanted one using a card box, allowing you to summon the warrior once per day, and by collecting a legendary joker, you can summon the warrior up to 5 times a day.  
You can exchange three similar cards for one random card, or obtain it from the ghostly shadow binder card, which has been added to the ghostly box.

Exchange Improvements

The Exchange has gained additional features:
- You can now specify if a request requires a full buyout, meaning it cannot be partially fulfilled, only in full.
- A new filter “available in stock” has been added to the request list, which shows only the requests for which you have at least 1 of the required items available.
- A search icon (magnifying glass) has been added to the bottom right corner of the item's image in a request. Clicking on it will display only the requests that require that particular item.

Starting October 2nd, mk3 and mk4 set weapons will be bound to their respective classes, meaning you will need the appropriate destiny sign to equip them.

We wish you success in your battles!

notes.title: The Fair Train has Arrived
notes.notes:
Valiant technomages and technomagesses! Yar Marko and his assistants have arrived right on time and have already set up their goods, awaiting your visit!

On the stalls of Yar Marko’s assistant and the Speculator, you will find goods to suit every taste: for the masters, there’s the experience of a master craftsman and pro tools, for hunters - the magic scroll of luck, gold tablet, a cage with mice or bloodsuckers, and a limited supply of boss summons, for warriors - diamond dust, elixirs of the gods, ghost boxes, and gladiator standards, and for the adepts of Darkness and Light, discounted packs of myhryutkas and protectresses as well as rare patterns of fate sketches are prepared! 
Hurry up and get the items you need before the fair ends on 18.09.2024 at 08:00!

The Exchange is Ready for Business!

Shopping has now become much more convenient! Instead of constantly monitoring the Auction or shouting in the trading chat, you can now leave a request for the desired item on the Exchange and wait for sellers to supply it!

The Exchange is available in the Auction building in the corresponding tab. The difference between the Exchange and the Auction is that on the Exchange, buyers leave their requests, and sellers fulfill them.

To create a request for the desired item in the New Request section, you can search by name, color, or type of item. You can post no more than 5 requests at a time. For each request, a tax must be paid under the same conditions as sellers on the auction - from 2% to 9% depending on the lifetime of the request, the item's listed price, considering the quantity of the item in the request. Additionally, the necessary amount to cover your entire request will be reserved from your funds. If the request is not fulfilled or partially fulfilled, the corresponding part of the reserved amount will be returned to you via mail. 
Please note that taxes are non-refundable. 
You can post your request anonymously, and for a small amount of gold, you can also raise your request to the top of the pages - all such requests will be sorted by their remaining lifetime. 
A seller may fulfill a request in full or in part, receiving the due payment via mail. In this case, they will also pay a tax of 8% of the deal's value.

On the Exchange, you can leave requests for equipment, resources, collections, cards, and other items. Only tradable items with a gold value are available. Items sold in the shop are mostly excluded from being requested. Over time, all shop items will be excluded from the Exchange.

For certain items, their type has been changed. For instance, ingredients dropped from monsters and bosses are now classified as Resources, while various ring cutters and Kuskodery have been reclassified as Pliers. Additionally, for items classified as Charms and sold in the shop, a type change is planned.

Sellers of equipment on the Exchange should take note that equipment can only be sold if it meets the following requirements:
 • has full maximum durability;
 • current durability equals maximum durability;
 • does not contain charms, stones, runes, or enhancements;
 • is marked as transferable. 
If the equipment does not meet these requirements, it cannot be sold through a request on the Exchange.

We look forward to your feedback and suggestions for improving the Exchange in this thread.

Desert Warriors Changes 
Depletion was not working against desert warriors when players used power scrolls, giant elixirs, and similar ammunition – this issue has been resolved.

An incorrect combat log entry regarding health restoration in desert dwellers when using power scrolls, giant elixirs, and similar ammunition is now fixed.

The chance to apply a debuff using the shadow flail has been reduced from 5% to 4%.

We wish you pleasant gameplay!

notes.title: Hearts of the Mines
notes.notes:
Valiant Elinorians! The Supply Center is in need of crystal hearts, and in return for obtaining them, you will be rewarded with rare and unique stones to enhance your combat abilities!

For nearly three weeks, you have the opportunity to complete special tasks in the event "Hearts of the Mines" and receive Hearts of the Mines, boxes with the hearts of mines, or their shards as rewards. Whole Hearts of the Mines can be exchanged at the Supply Center for the inlay stones you're interested in.

In the quest log, you will find a list of available assignments, their descriptions, and the rewards you can earn! This time, instead of the “Normal at the Tower of Despair” and “Normal at Grimbold's Fortress” quests, there will be new assignments connected to participation in the League Tournament.
For the "Grimwood Hunter" quest, available from level 8, which is completed only once, and the daily quests "Crystal Fever," "A successful investment" (spending crystals), and the one-time "League Tournament Winner," available from level 6, you will receive Hearts of the Mines. 
For the daily quests "Tournament Participant," "A successful investment" (spending gold), "Dungeon Warrior," and "Fearless Hunter," also available from level 6, you will receive a box with the Heart of the Mines. 
For the task "Free Hunter," available from level 6, you will receive shards of Hearts of the Mines.
Attention! When performing "A successful investment" quest, make sure that the expenses are in the list of the quest, or check if the planned expenses will be counted.

Registration for the League Tournament takes place in the book located in the Academy squares. In the tournament, all participants will be divided into special leagues: copper, silver, gold, platinum, diamond.
Players who achieve 1 victory are placed in the copper league. Their opponents may be players from the copper and silver leagues.
Players who achieve 100 victories move up to the silver league. Their opponents may be players from the copper, silver, and gold leagues.
Players who achieve 300 victories move up to the gold league. Their opponents may be players from the silver, gold, and platinum leagues.
Players who achieve 500 victories move up to the platinum league. Their opponents may be players from the gold, platinum, and diamond leagues.
Players who achieve 700 victories move up to the diamond league. Their opponents may be players from the platinum and diamond leagues.
Opponents are first selected from the player's current league, second from a lower league, and third from a higher league.
You can view league participants in the “Rankings” section of the game’s main menu, but no rewards are provided for this ranking. 
Victory will earn you points in the personal "Fighter" rating and the clan "Triumph" rating, along with a shard of the Heart, one of the tournament elixirs, or a pass for the League Tournament. Each day you log in, you will receive 10 passes for the League Tournament. Additional passes and tournament elixirs can be purchased in the Rarity Store.

Hearts of the Mines can also be obtained by extracting them from any stones from Yar Marco using jeweler’s tool kit from the Supply Center, or with a chance by spinning the Lucky Reel. Opening Boxes with a Heart of the Mines might yield whole Hearts or their shards. 100 shards can be assembled into the whole Heart using magic glue or magic superglue.

New epic arBrillmagr stones (healing, weakening, and poisoning) for one- and two-handed weapons are now available, increasing your character’s stats by 7 or 14 base damage and 70 or 140 destruction. You can also exchange durable arBrillmagr for epic ones with an additional cost in Hearts of the Mines.
As previously announced, all types of Adaliant and arAdaliant stones have been removed from the assortment.

You can complete quests until September 25th, and combine shards of the Hearts and spend Hearts of the Mines on rare stones at the Supply Center until September 27th.

We wish you exciting adventures!

notes.title: Back to School
notes.notes:
Very soon we will hear the first bell ringing, marking the start of a new school year. It's time for the children to return to their long-awaited studies! Elinorians can also embark on their educational journey by taking exams in power and intelligence.

Technomages of level 5 and above can start with the preparatory sessions, consisting of "Preparing for School" and "Training materials" quests (if not done previously). After completing these, Technomages of level 6 and above can attempt the "Elinor Knowledge Exam." Exam tickets can be obtained through daily quests, upon daily game login, or purchased in the Crystal Store.

Victory over experienced monsters may yield "grades" (Two, Three, Four, and Five), which can be exchanged for silver coins based on the grade's value.

New avatars for the WMI and AMI Adept (depending on the character's race) are available in the Rarity Store. Owners of the WMI and AMI Listener avatars can upgrade to Adept for free by contacting moders@tmgame.ru for a replacement.
The events are available until September 5th inclusive. 

And of course, there are special offers and discounts during the holidays!
- Armor will retain its durability if defeated until the end of the day.
- On August 31st, defeating experienced monsters and valiant opponents may also yield Suns along with other trophies, redeemable for items in Julian's Store.
- On September 1st, town's headman and the elder will grant you either the effect of Denial or Omniscience.

Additionally, until the end of Sunday, the Elinor Forge offers a 30% discount on equipment exchanges and creations (including creation with exchange), and a 25% discount on account purchases and crystal enhancers for personalized coins in the Artifact Hall.

Happy upcoming Knowledge Day!

notes.title: Certificates with gifts and more
notes.notes:
Valiant Technomages! By purchasing crystals before the end of the month, you'll have the opportunity to receive certificates for generous gifts, as well as lucky tickets and barrels of denial.

Until the end of summer, you can earn certificates for special gifts, but for that you'll need to:
1. Make a one-time payment of at least 50 crystals to receive 30 personalizes coins and one of five certificates at random as a gift. Personalized coins will only be awarded with your first payment during the promotion.
2. Complete the task specified on the certificate to receive a gift and another certificate.
3. If you don't like the certificate you received, you can exchange it for another one for 30 personalized coins and get one of the four remaining certificates.

By fulfilling the event conditions, you can obtain a certificate for the Tech Warrior Chest, the Chest of a famous technomage, the Rich Man's Chest, a Card Set, and a Cage with mice or bloodsuckers with a lifespan of 365 days.

With your first payment under the Card Set certificate, you will receive not only a ghostly box but also a card box or one random Scrubb Card. 
Subsequent payments under the same certificate will bring you either a ghostly box (with a high chance) or a card box or a random Scrubb Card.

Until September 3rd, by defeating valiant opponents, you may find Lucky Tickets among other trophies. Opening these tickets will grant you one of the following prizes: gold nuggets, ghostly signum, valor bonus for a day, a winner's standart bonus, a monster stone with a lifespan of 1 year, or a certificate for a unique bag.
You can purchase Lucky Tickets in unlimited quantities for gold coins in the Rarity Store.

In the Crystal Store, until August 31st, you will find barrels of denial. By using such a barrel, you can pause your experience gain from victories over brave warriors and Elinor monsters for a whole week.

We wish you generous gifts!

notes.title: End of Summer in Elinor
notes.notes:
Without much time to rest, glorious technomages have barely noticed how summer has almost flown by! The season of rankings, juicy berries and fruits left no time for relaxation, and now the last week of August has arrived!

As in previous months, the last week brings a new season of the Observatory and the "Technomagic competition" ranking. 
The Observatory round will end on September 1st at 23:30, and the portal to the base camp, where you can buy and open lens boxes, will close by the end of September 4th. 
The ranking results will be announced on Monday, September 2nd, at 5:30 Moscow time.

But that's not all! Until the end of August 27th, anyone can collect a Medallion of Fortune and earn 50% more coins for victories in battles, and with some chance obtain Iron Groft’s Safes from experienced monsters. 
To assemble the medallion, you will need to find its fragments among the trophies from the experienced monsters and use a four-leaf clover to combine three fragments into a complete medallion.
The more Medallions of Fortune you can combine, the longer the power of clover will stay with you. The lifespan of the Medallion of Fortune is 3 days, and by collecting all the medallions, you can enjoy the effect for 159 days.
You can purchase a four-leaf clover, one each from three different stores: City Store, Clan City Store for Tauri, and the Hermit's Store for Golden Lenses. If you want to extend the medallion's life even further, you can receive one four-leaf clover as a gift for every 100 crystals purchased during the event, but no more than 50 clovers throughout the promotion.

We wish you wealth and a good spirit!

notes.title: Searching for Ancient Mechanisms
notes.notes:
Valiant Elinorians! It’s time to put aside all your tasks and embark on a quest to find ancient mechanisms! For completing assignments, you will receive ancient tokens and Grimbold coins, which you can use to purchase various items to unlock desired medals and achievements for your character!

Visiting Hilgor and Virkly, all technomages of level 5 and above will receive one of five random quests. Only one quest can be completed daily, but for a certain fee you can reset the quest timer and take a random assignment again for an unlimited number of times. The cost of resetting the timer increases each time and resets at midnight. If you don’t like the assigned quest, you can replace it with one of the remaining four using the “Note on the Ancients.”

You can spend the received ancient tokens and Grimbold coins in the Supply Center on items that add points to various medals, as well as the 16th Anniversary Cup, necessary to unlock the achievement of the same name!

The Elinor Bank remembers its depositors! For every 300 crystals from the amount of a single payment, you will receive one Ancient Chest, the contents of which will make it easier to complete the “Mechanisms of the Ancients” quests!

You can receive assignments and Ancient Chests until the end of August 25th, and you must complete the taken quest, spend the tokens and coins by August 27th!

Until August 11th inclusive, by defeating valiant opponents and experienced monsters, you can obtain Grobft's safes. To open a safe, you need to pay a few crystals and you will receive one of the rare gifts, including a certificate for an individual seal!

We wish you successful searches!

notes.title: Become the Fire Conqueror!
notes.notes:
Glorious technomages! The summer heat is in full swing, peace has settled over the sands of the Soli-Dor desert and its dungeons, mines, and pits... But there is no rest for the headman and the elder of the city, they call upon you to compete for the title of the Fire Conqueror.

By completing the "Fire Conqueror" quest, technomages of level 6 and above are required to collect a set of 100 fire attributes: 20 camping flasks, 20 mason's trowels, 20 fire crystals, 20 fire keys, and 20 crowns.
You will receive each of these attributes by completing daily quests for various city residents, which will require you to fight desert dwellers, kill trolls and bosses, use hatred crystals in battles, and repair destroyed parapets.

As a reward for your efforts, you will receive a Fire Conqueror chest, which contains a fragile Fire Conqueror rune, a "The Darling of Fate" account for 1 day, a card box, 5 ghostly desert dweller cards, and 1000 suns. Additionally, opening the chest will grant a separate reward — the "Fire Conqueror" achievement, which permanently increases your "Weakness of Darkness" parameter by 1%.

This quest can be completed until the end of summer, but you must claim your reward before the end of September 1st.
You can also purchase the missing fire attributes in the Crystal Store to receive the reward faster!

And that's not all. The Elinor Bank remembers its depositors and, until July 28th, gifts one 5th draw lottery ticket for every 1000 crystals purchased in a single transaction! Prizes from the ticket include a water or fire magic crystal, a Jewelry casket, a jewelry box, crystal petals, or 100 crystals!

In the Crystal Store, until the end of Sunday, everyone will also find a certificate to change one level or a set of such certificates. This time, enjoy a 10% discount on purchasing one certificate and 30% instead of 20% on purchasing a set of certificates!

We wish you a hot summer!

notes.title: New Scouts from Dwarves and Humans
notes.notes:
Glorious warriors! It is time to face the desert dwellers — scouts of the mysterious squads of dwarves and humans, trained to fight in the Soli-Dor desert and regularly patrolling the approaches to the territories of their race.

Every day upon entering the game, you will have access to 5 scouts of the hostile race, patrolling the surroundings of Soli-Dor, its suburbs, or the approaches to the territories of their race.
In case of a defeat, you will have 2 hours to try again to destroy this scout. After this time, as well as in case of victory over him, the scout will return to his base.

Upon defeating him, you will receive all the due trophies as if you had defeated an opponent in the territory of Soli-Dor.

The desert dwellers have the abilities that none of your pets or helpers will not be able to respond to your call for help.

Among the trophies from these scouts, with some chance you can find cards of desert inhabitants — naga, snakeman, nomad, assassin, and desert dweller. A complete set of cards turns into a normal desert dweller joker, which allows you to summon such a warrior for battle once every 2 days. Two normal jokers can be combined using a card box into an enchanted one, which allows you to summon the warrior once a day, and by collecting a legendary joker, you can summon the warrior for battle up to 5 times a day.
Three identical cards can be exchanged for one random card.

Desert dweller cards can also be obtained from a ghostly card, which has been added to the ghostly box.

Crazed warriors could not withstand the desert dwellers and have permanently left the territory of Soli-Dor.

With time, similar warriors will appear in all dangerous territories.

The abilities of the warriors may be changed. We await your comments and suggestions on this topic.

We wish you successful battles!

notes.title: Berry Fever
notes.notes:
What could be better than ripe berries on a hot summer day? Only a basket of ripe berries, for which you will receive valuable prizes!

For the next two weeks, you will need to: gather fragrant berries, place them in baskets, and consume a whole basket of juicy berries, participating in the "Berry Fever" ranking, unlocking achievements, and receiving gifts for them! 
You can collect berries in the following ways:
—- producing items according to the weaver's recipes to obtain strawberries;
—- defeating valiant opponents in all the Elinor territories, except the Tower of Despair and Grimbold's Fortress, to collect blueberries;
—- opening burglar chests for a chance to get cloudberries;
—- defeating bosses (as per reward conditions) to find blackberries;
—- winning duels in the Tower of Despair and Grimbold's Fortress to get gooseberries.
In the Crystal Store, you can purchase a permission to pick berries, and for an hour, you will have a chance to randomly collect one of the berries needed for the collection when killing Elinor's monsters.

By collecting 100 berry baskets, you will receive a III place cup and the ability to get mining tools of your choice once per day.
For 300 berry baskets, you will receive a II place berry cup and can select one of the effects for 1 hour once per day: negation, omniscience, luck scroll, hunter, master, or alchemist (the alchemist effect can be obtained only once).
And by collecting 500 berry baskets — a I place cup, which, when used, allows you to receive either magic concentrates, life concentrates, or regular cubes of doubt once per day, or try your fortune to win valuable prizes, with the grand prize being the Adamas of Power!

You will also participate in the overall ranking! By reaching the top 50 and above, you will unlock a new achievement line "Berry Fever'' with a reward in crystals (a higher top ranking counts towards a lower one), and for the prize places in the ranking, you will receive card boxes used to upgrade jokers of various card decks.
This ranking is not counted towards the "Race Participant" medal line.
The ranking results will be summed up on July 19th and 26th at 5:30 am Moscow time, and the event will end with the final results.

And a bonus from the Elinor Bank! Until the end of July 17th, for every 100 crystals from a single payment, you will receive 3 chests with a berry collection!

By participating in the Tournament of Equals, you can gather even more ripe berries! 
Register in the journal in the Academy Square to find an opponent and go into a duel with equal parameters and magic.
You will receive 10 tickets daily upon entering the game, and an unlimited number of tickets and concentrates of strength and gems used in the Tournament of Equals can be purchased in the Rarity Store.
By winning, you will earn 1 point in the "Fighter" and "Triumph" rankings and one of the berries: blueberries or gooseberries.
The tournament will end on July 14th at 23:59.

A new joker has appeared in the world of Elinor — the Hive Joker!
By defeating the dreadful Scrubb bosses, you have a chance to get one of the rare cards of this deck. This collection of cards combines into a normal Hive Joker, which allows you to summon one of the Scrubbs once per 30 days. The Hive Joker upgrades to enchanted and magical, reducing the summoning time to 15 or 5 days.
Three cards of one of the Scrubbs can be exchanged for another random card from this deck.
With a small chance, Scrubb cards can be obtained from the ghostly boss cards.

We wish you a delicious time!

notes.title: Summer Fair
notes.notes:
Despite the hot days, Yar Marco arrived in Elinor on time and offers everyone a soul great gusts and various goods at his stalls.

During this fair week, you will be able to purchase: memories of heroes and ghostly tokens, discounted hate charges and solar prisms, alchemical cauldrons of life, magic, hate, and fair bags, as well as boxes of light, shadow and ghosts, leader chests, and much more.

Also, throughout the week, medals from the Power, Hatred, and Scrubb's Tamer lines will be available for purchase.

We wish you useful acquisitions!

notes.title: Time for Talismans of Magic
notes.notes:
Talismans of Magic are once again awaiting their enhancement to boost your stats! 
Until the end of July 8th, by completing the simple daily tasks of the "Talisman magic" event, you will receive magic storages and chests with storages, which contain 20 magic storages of a random color from normal to legendary. You will use magic storages to enhance your talismans and make your character even stronger! 
Read more about power talismans here.

At the game auction, there will be bidding for personal card boxes (10 lots for each race, 1 piece each). For more details on the starting bid, time, and bidding steps, visit the auction.

We wish you a great mood!

notes.title: Trials of Fortune
notes.notes:
On a hot sunny day, it's so tempting to take a break from intense battles and go treasure hunting or try your luck spinning the wheel of fortune!

Anyone wishing to go in search of goblin treasure chests can purchase cobalt picks in small quantities for universal coins in the town store and an unlimited number of picks in the Crystal Store.
Read more about treasure hunting on the infoportal.

Brave warriors wishing to visit the Grimbold's fortress territory will have a chance to find a gold coin among other treasures by defeating prisoners. By paying a coin to Fortune, you can receive: a legendary nimelin, a normal fullerite I, a high-quality fullerite II, or an excellent fullerite III, a fullerite heart, 100 crystals, 10 gold coins, or 10 medium teeth.
The Elinor Bank gifts gold coins in unlimited quantities! When purchasing crystals, you will receive 1 gold coin for every 300 crystals from the amount of a single payment!
Goblin treasure hunting and obtaining gold coins are available until the end of July 7th.

But that's not it!
Throughout the week (until July 11th inclusive), the wheel of Fortune awaits you. By spinning the wheel of Fortune you can win: an additional safe slot, a card box, a metamorphosis of normal runes, a smith's alchemical stone for transforming ore into another, and other prizes.

notes.title: Hot News
notes.notes:
On these sunny days, quenching your thirst with a sip of coconut milk feels great, but only in Technomagic for it you will get additional gifts for your character!

All Elinor citizens level 5 and above can complete daily tasks until July 1st and receive rainbow nuts with gifts as rewards. 
During seven days, you can crack open the nut to get one of the following random useful items: Gladiator Coin, Sun, Tauri, Expedition Badge of Honor, Hunter Silver Coin, Symbols for purchases in the Rarity Store, Gold Coins, Golden Lens of the Observatory, Fullerite Shard, Shimmering Shard, Shard of Special Stone, Elixir of Purification based on your level, Spark of Light, two Rainbow Nuts, Strong Rune of the Barbarian, Engineer, or Knight (the runes are transferable)

Until July 11th, you can take on daily missions from the Commander in the Hive and the Knowledge Keeper, earning reports upon completion. Ten reports of one type can be exchanged for a Technowarrior Chest containing rare ammunition.
Completing tasks in the Hive (Exorcising many-legged, Exorcising Wings, Replenishing Supplies, Destruction of clutches, Following the trail of Grobfts, Elimination of Competitors) earns you a Commander’s Report. Completing tasks in the Ancient Temple (Measuring magfield and Extracting tags) earns you a Keeper’s Report.

You can find limited quantities of rare items in the Crystal Store! From Friday to Sunday at 16:00 Moscow time, new items will be available, five per race:
June 28th: Rune of Immortality;
June 29th: Cage with Faithful Bats or Bloodsuckers;
June 30th: solid stone of desolation spoilage.
Also, until the end of the weekend, you can purchase enchanted elixirs of denial in the Crystal Store! 
Using the elixir will decrease your character's current experience by 100 units. Defeating valiant warriors may drop a normal elixir of denial, reducing your character's current experience by 25 units.

Scrolls of Enchantment "Enemy suppression" are now available for purchase with prize tokens in the Supply Center.

The Elinor Bank is giving gifts again! Until the end of June, for every 1,000 crystals purchased, you will receive a ghostly box as a gift. But that's not it! For the first payment, you are guaranteed to receive a personal card box, and with subsequent payments, you have a chance to receive it again!

We wish you a sunny mood!

notes.title: Elinor floristry
notes.notes:
Summer time in Eleanor is an abundance of delightful flowers and a wonderful time to learn floristry and receive generous prizes as a reward for the work done!

You can devote the next two weeks to creating beautiful bouquets. To do this, it is necessary to extract chrysanthemums, lilies and roses in such ways:
You will get lilies by defeating valiant opponents.
Chrysanthemums are obtained with a chance from any monsters of Elinor's world (except for the initial locations).
The roses are in the trophies of the bosses of dangerous territories corresponding to your character's level. A limited number of roses will be given to you for completing daily tasks (detailed information in the task log), and an unlimited number until the end of the event is given by Elinor's Bank when purchasing crystals for a character — 1 rose for every 100 crystals from the amount of one payment.
To receive a bouquet, you will need a special ribbon, which is sold at a Sales representative near the Colosseum or in a Crystal Shop, as well as vases, which you will also find in a Crystal Shop.

The reward you receive depends on the size of your bouquet!

A simple bouquet — chrysanthemum, lily and rose, tied with a ribbon, are exchanged for a Flower sphere. Re-obtaining the sphere will renew its life span. You can get the sphere only until June 23, inclusive.

A beautiful bouquet — 5 simple bouquets placed in a vase will present a Flower sphere and 5 summoning seals.

You will collect a magnificent bouquet of 15 simple bouquets, and when you receive a reward, you will receive a Flower sphere, 10 summoning seals and 1 ghost box.

A luxurious bouquet is made up of 50 simple bouquets and is rewarded with: A flower sphere, 20 summoning seals, 2 ghost boxes and 7 small boxes with keys.

For a Royal bouquet, you need to collect and put 150 simple bouquets in a vase, and a truly royal reward awaits you: A flower sphere, 30 summoning seals, 3 ghost boxes, 1 large box with keys and 2 golden lilies, which will give you a choice of 500 fragments of nimelin, 500 fragments of the stone of rage, 400 crystals of exhaustion, 4000 legendary magic accumulators, 4000 neutral substances (from level 9), 1000 fragments of the fractal matrix (once for those who gained access to the test chambers), 2000 clusters of battle rage or a scroll of charms "Pacification of the enemy". With this scroll, epic and legendary nimelins are transformed into rare and unique ones with the ability to “Subdue the Enemy”.
You will be able to get flowers until the end of June 23, and buy ribbons and vases until the end of June 30.
Receiving awards from bouquets (except simple ones) is available at any time.

In addition, up to and including 06/23/2024, five golden lilies can be exchanged at the rarity shop for a certificate for an individual seal (once), and three lilies for a durable stone of bloody confrontation. Hurry up! A limited batch of such stones per race is available.

We wish you a blooming mood!

notes.title: Gifts from certificates
notes.notes:
Glorious technomages! In the coming days, you will have the opportunity to obtain lucky tickets and certificates for gifts, which can be received by following the promotion’s terms.

Until the end of June 9th Elinor Bank gives the Certified Gifts. To get them you will need:
1. Make a one-time payment of at least 50 crystals to receive 30 Personalized Coins and one of five random certificates. Personalized Coins are awarded only with the first payment of the promotion.
2. Follow the conditions specified on the certificate to receive a gift and an additional certificate.
3. You can exchange a certificate for another one of the four types available by paying 30 Personalized Coins.
Completing the conditions of the event may grant you one of the following certificates: Cube of doubts, Chest of a famous technomage, Rich Man's Chest, Ghostly box, or Legendary jeweler's purse.

A certificate for the Ghostly box guarantees an additional personal card box with the first payment made with it. For subsequent payments, the personal card box is awarded randomly.

By defeating valiant opponents until June 11th inclusive, you have a chance to obtain lucky tickets among other trophies. Each ticket offers one of the following prizes: Gold Nuggets, Ghostly Signum, Valor Bonus for 24 hours, Winner's Standard Bonus, Monster Stone for 1 year, or Unique bag certificate.

An unlimited number of tickets can also be purchased at the Rarity Store for gold coins.

We wish you generous gifts!

notes.title: End of Spring
notes.notes:
As the last days of spring are upon us, a new season of ranking competitions is just around the corner in Elinor. Starting next week, summer will bring new weekly ranking events, giving you a chance to prepare and participate in the jobs for the courageous.

Until the end of May, headman Zlatovan and elder Koragor are ready to assign you the daily assignment "Jobs for the courageous". The quest is given upon entering the game, and for completing it, you will receive a Sage’s potion, which grants you the effect of Denial or Omniscience for 2 hours.

Additionally, until the end of spring, the Elinor Bank is giving gifts! For every 500 crystals from a single payment, you will receive a lottery ticket for draw №11!
Prizes include a legendary aquamarine, diamond armor coating for 1 year (repeating such an item is prohibited), a metamorphosis for normal runes, a key to the C.H.E.S.T., or a Small crystal chest I. Opening this chest can reward you with 40, 70, or 100 crystals or another Small crystal chest II, which contains even more crystals or another chest. The final chest V will reward you with 1,000, 3,000, or 5,000 crystals!

We wish you the best of luck in winning the grand prize!

notes.title: Malachite Beetles
notes.notes:
The end of spring brings joy to Elinor with the invasion of malachite beetles, which dazzle all residents with their blinding glow and generously reward insect hunters!
Technomages of level 5 and above, wishing to collect components to obtain a malachite beetle, can do so. To craft a malachite beetle, you will need:
- 10 coils of gold wire, which can be obtained with a chance upon defeating an experienced monster;
- 10 golden beads, several of which can be obtained by defeating a valiant opponent;
- Semi-precious malachite, found among the rewards from bosses inhabiting dangerous territories;
- Master's clippers, purchased at the City Stores.
Charming beetles can be exchanged for rewards of your choice, and in addition, you have a chance to receive a rare inlay stone - Adamas of Power!

The Elinor Bank joins the hunt for these beautiful insects! For every 100 crystals from the amount of one payment, you will receive 4 malachite beetles as a gift!

You can collect parts, assemble, and obtain complete malachite beetles until the end of May 26th, and redeem desired rewards until the end of the adorable insects' lifespan.

Until May 24th inclusive, you can purchase barrels of denial at the Crystal Store, the activation of which will allow you to refrain from gaining experience when victorious in various battles.

Wishing you a wonderful mood!

notes.title: Achievements of the Dor-Taund Temple
notes.notes:
Brave technomages! A year ago, the gates of the Dor-Taund Temple opened, and you were able to embark on new adventures in the virtual world with the help of G.L.A.D.I.S.! 
And now, exactly one year later, achievement lines related to trials in the test chambers appeared in Elinor. For unlocking achievements, you will receive items that make it easier to complete the trials. All your successes in previously completed trials are counted in the achievements. 
Elinorians level 11 and above, who have gained access to the test chambers, will once receive a one-time key from the Dor-Taund Temple upon entering the game until the end of May 19th.

On May 18th and 19th collectors will have a chance to receive a random item from one of Elinor's collections when defeating experienced monsters and valiant opponents.

Wishing you a great weekend!

notes.title: Victory Day Fair
notes.notes:
Not missing the opportunity to congratulate the residents of Elinor on Victory Day, Yar Marko arrived right on time. At the fair stalls this month, you'll find: cages with mice and bloodsuckers, packs of Mihrutkas and protectresses, Magic Transformers and auras, ancient skins of humans and dwarves, the Ghost Boxes, artisan experience, and more.

The festive tasks "Great warriors of the past" and "Preparations for Victory Day" can be obtained from the headman or the elder of the city and must be completed not later than the end of May 12th.

Sh'aktayn will require your assistance in rescuing imprisoned souls on the Island of Initiation. For this, he is ready to daily endow you with a small amount of shadow dust, which will be needed to free 1 to 5 souls upon victory in the Dark Vaults. You can purchase an unlimited amount of shadow dust from the sales representative of the Island of Initiation. 
Detailed information about the event can be found in the quest log. 
The liberation of imprisoned souls is available until May 21 inclusive, and you can receive a one-time reward no later than the end of May 22nd.

By defeating valiant warriors and experienced monsters until May 12th inclusive, you may receive Grobft's safes. By opening the safe for a small fee in crystals, you will receive generous gifts, among which the main prize is a certificate for an individual seal!

Until 23:59 on May 12th, 2024, there is a discount in the artifact hall and secretariat for the purchase of skins and crystal amplifiers, and in the Crystal Store, you can purchase skin artifact blanks and a Blue Crystal.

And, of course, festive promotions! 
From the moment of publication of the news until the end of May 8th, each victory in the Dark Vaults will additionally give you a Box of Darkness or Light, depending on your chosen path. On May 9th, you will be greeted with two pleasant bonuses throughout the day! Upon defeat in the dangerous territories of Elinor, your armor will not lose its durability, and also, all victories in the Dark Vaults will give twice as many freed souls if you have the required amount of shadow dust.
On May 10th, by visiting the headman or elder of the city, you can receive the effect of Denial or Omniscience for the whole day.
On May 11th, victory over valiant opponents will bring you twice as many elements of the "Skills" collection.

At the city florists, the stalls have been replenished with thematic gifts for Victory Day.

Congratulations on the upcoming holiday!

notes.title: Elinor Collections
notes.notes:
Prominent residents of Longholm and Khatog invite all technomages to search for Elinor Collections!

Elinor Collections consist of six collections, the elements of which are obtained in different ways. As a reward for the first five collections, you will receive golden symbols, the combination of which constitutes the final collection of Symbols with a reward in the form of Elinor symbols. These symbols can be exchanged for various goods at the Elinor Store located in the Commercial square. 
Detailed information about each collection, ways of obtaining them, and goods from the Elinor Store can be found on the infoportal, and in the quest log you can track your current expenses and acquisition of elements of the "Standards" collection.

Not forgetting about its depositors, Elinor Bank offers: depending on the amount of crystals purchased, you will receive one of the collector's chests as a gift, each containing a different number of collection items. 
For payments from 100 to 449 crystals, you will receive the Enchanted Collector's Chest; for payments from 450 to 899 crystals, you will receive the Magical Chest, and for every 900 crystals from the size of one payment, you will receive one Heroic Collector's Chest.

While collecting collections, everyone automatically becomes a participant in the ranking, the results of which will be summarized twice during the period on Mondays, May 13th and 20th, at 5:30. This ranking is taken into account in the medal line "Race Participant". You can collect collection items and Collector's Chests for payments, combine them to receive rewards until the end of May 19th, and spend Elinor Symbols until the end of May 20th.

We wish you to become the chief collector!

notes.title: The Great Holiday
notes.notes:
In each world, the Great Holiday is celebrated differently, but in Elinor, battles with Evil Goose await you, as well as tasks from the city's residents, the hunt for golden eggs, and more!

Upon entering the game, you'll have access to tasks from Barfos or Ungor for "Atonement of Sins" and daily quests, completing which you can receive Technomagic golden eggs with random rewards.

New ammunition has been added to the list of prizes from the Technomagic golden egg — rotten and armor-piercing eggs. The rotten egg, when used in battle, reduces the enemy's health for each second of their turn, while the armor-piercing egg allows you to deliver a guaranteed armor-piercing blow (ignoring the enemy's armor) equal to 1 damage + damage from medals and weapons. The use of these ammunitions, as well as the painted egg, is required for the new series of medals "Egg Champion."

Upon entering the game, you will receive several feathers of the Evil Goose, using them will summon a formidable monster that has copied your parameters to battle. By defeating the ferocious bird, you will obtain its nest, in which you will find one of the colorful painted eggs, a golden egg, or its shells. Collecting 10 shells with the help of magic glue will give you a whole golden egg. The golden eggs you obtain can be exchanged for festive, rare, and unique ammunition at the Rarity Store. Additionally, you will receive golden eggs for unlocking the achievement "Evil Goose" (if you haven't already) or with a chance from the Technomagic golden egg.

Additional feathers of the Evil Goose can be obtained by killing the Goose (with a low chance) or purchased for universal coins at the Rarity Store.

The holiday quests and events will end on May 5th, but you can spend the golden eggs at the Rarity Store until May 6th inclusive.
The city florists will gladly offer you to purchase beautiful souvenir eggs made of precious stones.

We wish you a great holiday!

notes.title: Preparing for the Spring and Labor Day Celebration
notes.notes:
The weekend is still going strong, but despite that, the residents of Elinor have organized a big clean-up for the upcoming holiday and are awaiting your participation in the upcoming events! 
Visiting the headman Zlatovan or the elder Koragor, you can join in the gathering and giving away the brooms for the Great Cleanup throughout Longholm and Khatog. 
Then, pay a visit to the local farmers to participate in seedling cultivation and receive a pleasant reward for your efforts. 
Task completion is available until the end of May 3rd.

The city florists took care of the holiday in advance and added thematic gifts to their assortment. Don't pass by, purchase lovely gifts for yourself and your friends!

No holiday passes without technomagical promotions! Here's the schedule for the upcoming days:
- Until the end of today, you'll enjoy the Hunter Effect, which doubles the number of achievements triggered for monster kills.
- On April 30th, you'll have a chance to receive normal magic storages by defeating experienced monsters and valiant opponents.
- On May 1st, you will receive 2 water substances when you have enchanted vials from experienced monsters in dangerous territories.

Until April 30th inclusive, everyone interested can spin the wheel of fortune for a small fee and receive various prizes, including jubilee thalers.

By purchasing crystals until the end of May 1st, you'll receive a gift from the Elinor Bank — 30 Standards of Light for every 300 crystals from the amount of one payment! Standards of Light work outside the Dark Vaults, and each one, when victorious over a valiant opponent, will grant you a thread of fate. Getting a thread of fate corresponds to the respective achievement, and a chance to receive one point of Light reputation.

We wish you a great weekend!

notes.title: Spring Promotions
notes.notes:
Until the end of the weekend, rare goods are available for sale in Elinor. Lottery tickets for draw № 1 are given as a gift for purchasing crystals!
At the Crystal Store counters, you can purchase life-giving ichor, a limited batch of conversion signs, and enchanted elixirs of denial!
Applying the elixir will decrease your character's current experience by 100 points.
Upon defeating valiant opponents, you may get a normal elixir of denial, reducing your character's current experience by 25 points.

Elinor Bank is giving out gifts! By replenishing your character's account, for every 1000 crystals from the amount of one payment, you will receive 1 lottery ticket for draw № 1, among the prizes of which you will find a certificate for an additional profession, rare and unique stones, and other useful things.
All events are available until April 28.

We wish you successful purchases!

notes.title: Technomage Competition and Observatory
notes.notes:
The final week of the month is on the calendar, so the portal to the Observatory reopened in Elinor. Collectors can gather pouches of precious stones to earn more prize tokens for participating in the ranking!

Near the dwelling places of the Hermit-stargazer, a portal started shining. By stepping into it, you'll find yourself in the base camp of the Observatory, meaning it's time to head into battles in the snowy valley, where some changes await you:
- The invulnerability time upon entering the Observatory is reduced from 20 seconds to 5.
- This season, receiving rewards from the bosses Guardian of the Dawn Observatory and Guardian of the Sunset Observatory	becomes team-based. Trophies are received by each member of the winning team who has dealt at least 10% damage to the boss' health.
The distribution of trophies occurs as follows:
- Normal and golden lenses are received proportionally to the damage dealt.
- Each participant receives a Star Alchemist's bag and one of the types of rock samples. Each participant also has a chance to receive a scroll of enchantment and a jewelry box.
- The Observatory equipment chest is randomly awarded to one of the team members.

You can read more detailed rules of the Observatory on the infoportal. Participation in the rounds is available until 11:30 PM on April 28, and visiting the base camp, purchasing, and opening lens boxes is available until the end of May 1.
We highly value your opinion on the changes in the reward distribution for defeating the Guardians of Observatory and waiting for it on our forum.

The ranking "Technomagic competition" has not undergone any changes. You can familiarize yourself with the participation rules and ways to receive pouches with precious on the infoportal.
The results will be announced on April 29 at 5:30 AM during morning technical maintenance.

By purchasing crystals until the end of April 24, you will receive 2 violet pouches of precious stones as a gift for every 300 crystals of one payment size.

Wishing you a great mood!

notes.title: The era of a Skilled Jeweler
notes.notes:
Do you know who skilled jewelers are? No? Then it's time for you to receive rewards for completing simple tasks with boxes of resin to improve your inlaid stones!

Until the end of March 31, by completing daily quests of the "Skilled Jeweler" event, you will receive boxes of resin corresponding to the level of your character, which is required to enhance inlaid stones for every technomage.

Wishing you to become even stronger!

notes.title: End of March
notes.notes:
On the calendar, it's the last week of the month, which means it's time for a new season of the Observatory and the "Technomage Competition" ranking in Elinor.

You can read the information about the conditions of the "Technomage Competition" ranking here , and the winners' nicknames will be announced on April 1 at 5:30 a.m. Moscow time during the morning technical maintenance.

The rules of the "Observatory" event are on our infoportal. Participation in battles is available until 23:30 on March 31, and visiting the base camp, purchasing, and opening chests with lenses are available until the end of April 3.
Until the end of March, you can purchase mysterious artifacts at the Hermit-Stargazer’s Store.

Elinor Bank is giving gifts! By purchasing crystals for your character until March 27, you will receive 1 magical Hermit's chest for every 100 crystals from the amount of one payment.

Wishing you an exciting week!

notes.title: Yar Marko's Arrival
notes.notes:
Honoring the folk festivities, Yar Marko has arrived in the midst of Maslenitsa week!
In addition to the regular market goods, you can purchase: hunter's elixir, master's elixir, Projectile thrower elixir, alchemist's elixir, and elixirs of power, protection of the gods, and hate charges with a 20% discount. You can also find copy sheets, cauldrons of life, cauldrons of hate, and fragile stones from Yar Marko, as well as onyx safes and bowls with crushed fangs along with other items. Additionally, you can get miner's tools of your choice once per day from the city Blacksmith for free.

Note that there is a limited batch of alchemist's elixir available.
Until the end of Sunday, the Fountain of Fortune appeared in the squares. By throwing gold coins into it, you will receive various useful items.
During the week, you can also purchase medals from the series: For Skill, Power, and Hatred.

Yar Marko will also delight everyone with a festive Maslenitsa box, available in limited quantities at the stalls near his assistant.

Wishing you successful purchases and a fantastic week!

notes.title: Maslenitsa has arrived!
notes.notes:
It's time for crepes, pancakes, and cheesecakes! In Eleanor, the Maslenitsa week has come with the burning of the effigy and a prize pillar!

By visiting the city tavern, you can help distribute festive treats to the honored citizens of the city. In anticipation of spring, you can also burn the festive effigy and receive special ammunition as a reward, necessary for the new medal line "Farewell to winter." 
The quest completion is available until the end of March 17, and you can claim the reward for the burned effigy until March 18 inclusive.
Important! You can only claim the reward (Maslenitsa box) if you haven't received the boxes earlier as a reward for this quest.
From March 15 to 17 a festive pillar will appear near the Maslenitsa effigy. You will need to climb it for valuable gifts: one attempt every 12 hours and as many attempts as you want at any time for sun tokens, which you can find in the Crystal Store.
And, of course, the crepe ranking! 
Throughout the week, you will need to bake delicious crepes to receive sets of Maslenitsa ammunition for the "Farewell to winter" medals as a reward for prize places. You will also earn points in the "Race Participant" medals!
To bake crepes, you will need crepe mix and exotic fillings from Eleanor's monsters:
- Spider tenderloin from adult spiders, shadowhunters, and arachnids.
- Spooky mushrooms from ancient skeletons, zombies, miners, coalmen, and gravediggers.
Unusual ingredients need to be mixed with elixirs of strength or hardness to create a delicious crepe filling. You can purchase all the necessary ingredients for making crepes from the trader near the Colosseum.
You can taste the crepes in any battles until the end of March. A crepe with meat filling increases the character's base damage, while a crepe with mushroom filling increases the character's armor.
The ranking results will be announced on March 18 at 5:30.

Wishing you a delicious week and easy rewards!

notes.title: The Holiday of Charming Warriors
notes.notes:
The entire Eleanor is eagerly awaiting the day of the charming inhabitants of the universe, but already today the festive events have begun: the Knight Tournament, "Flower Week," and other Technomagic celebrations! Every warrior dreams of dedicating their victories to a lady of his heart, and every lady aims to become the most charming. The best way to achieve this is to participate in the Knight's Tournament!
Upon entering the game, all potential knights will once receive a brooch for their beloved lady. This brooch should be presented to the chosen one with whom you wish to share your victories in the tournament, earning charm points for her.
By reciprocating, ladies can increase the amount of fame for their knight, and charm for themselves by gifting him one of the following items:
- Charming Lady's Handkerchief: doubles the knight's available battles in the current day in the tournament and allows them to gain +1 fame and charm with each victory for 30 minutes. Can be obtained with some chance from experienced monsters in dangerous territories.
- Charming Lady's Ribbon: increases the knight's available battles in the current day in the tournament by 5 and allows them to gain +3 fame and charm with each victory for 1 hour. Can be obtained with some chance from any suitable bosses.
- Charming Lady's Glove: increases the knight's available battles in the current day in the tournament by 20 and allows them to gain +6 fame and charm with each victory for 3 hours. Can be obtained with some chance by defeating opponents on the Island of Initiation and in the Colosseum.
Gifts for the knight of your heart can be found: handkerchief and ribbon for gold, and the knight's talisman for personalized coins in the Rarity Store; gloves are available in the Crystal Store.
Daily, upon entering the game, all warriors will receive 20 attempts for battles in the tournament. By using the knight's talisman, you can get an extra 12 attempts for battles in the tournament until midnight and gain +5 fame or charm with each victory for 2 hours. The knight's talisman is obtained with some chance by defeating valiant opponents on the Island of Initiation and in the Colosseum.
By winning the tournament, the knight will receive +1 to their fame for the "Most Glorious Knight" ranking, and the lady will receive +1 to her charm for the "Most Charming Lady" ranking, along with generous gifts ranging from a normal ink barrel to hearts of mines. Additionally, both will earn points to the personal "Fighter" ranking.
The ranking results will be announced on March 11 at 5:30.

No women's day is complete without flowers!
Collect bouquets of tulips, lilies of the valley, and snowdrops, delight beautiful ladies with them, and participate in the "Flower Week" ranking!
Tulip and lily of the valley bouquets grow on their own by purchasing tulip bulbs or lily of the valley seeds, a pot with magical soil, and a watering can with magical water from the trader near the Colosseum. Snowdrop bouquets are obtained by defeating any monsters in Eleanor and valiant opponents. For each collected bouquet, you will receive 1 point in the "Flower Week" ranking. The prize places will be taken into account in the "Race Participant" medal line. The results will be announced on March 11 at 5:30.

By visiting the Horsefly and Hilgor, you can help in preparing a gift for the beloved lady. Headman Zlatovan and Elder Koragor will tell you that the holiday is approaching and many things need to be done, while friend Martius is curious about the arrival of spring! It is up to you to figure all this out no later than the end of March 10.

Happy holiday to you, dear Eleanor ladies!

notes.title: Hearts of mines
notes.notes:
In the technomagical world, marvelous events are constantly happening! A sinister fog has spread across all underground territories, transforming the hearts of the creatures living there into diamonds. For three weeks, you will need to collect hearts of mines or their shards, which can be combined into whole hearts and exchanged for rare inlay stones at the City Supply Center!

By completing various assignments from the quest log, you can obtain hearts of mines, boxes with hearts of mines, or simply their shards. Opening boxes gives you a chance to acquire whole hearts of mines or several shards. One hundred shards can be assembled into a complete heart using magic glue or magical super glue.
A full list of available quests can be found in the quest log. Below is a brief description of rarer quests and the rewards you can earn!
For the quest "Grimwood Hunter," available from level 8 that can be performed only once, and for the daily quests "Crystal Fever" and "Successful Investment" (spending crystals), available from level 6, you will be awarded hearts of mines.
For the quests "Normal at Grimbold's Fortress," available from level 8, and "Normal at the Tower of Despair," available from level 10, both performed only once, as well as for the daily quests "Successful Investment" (spending gold), "Dungeon Warrior," and "Fearless Hunter," available to characters from level 6, you will receive boxes with a heart of mines.
For the quest "Free Hunter," available from level 6, you will receive shards of hearts of mines.
Attention! When completing the "Successful Investment" quest, make sure that the incurred expenses are listed in the quest or clarify if the planned expenses will be counted.
You also have a chance to obtain boxes with hearts of mines in the Wheel of Fortune or by dismantling any stones from Yar Marko using a jeweler's toolset from the Supply Center.
In the assortment of goods for hearts of mines, high-quality Adamas of Power is now available. It enhances the effect of the Power Scroll by 5%, and the Scroll of Light, increasing the chance of activating the skein of Light. Exchange of normal Adamases of Power for high-quality ones is possible with an additional payment in hearts of mines.
As announced in the previous event, epic nimelin has been replaced by durable nimelin.
All types of Adaliant and arAdaliant stones can be obtained in exchange for hearts of mines for the last time this season. Hurry to purchase the items you need!
Task completion is available until March 23, and combining shards into hearts of mines and purchasing rare stones in the Supply Center is possible until March 25 inclusive.
Wishing you exciting adventures!

notes.title: Calligraphy Lessons
notes.notes:
The world of Elinor is full of entertainment for every taste! In the coming days, calligraphy lessons with technomagical cryptographers await you, as well as the opportunity to win prizes in the Wheel of Fortune and the acquisition of Grobft safes with valuable treasures.

Warriors level 5 and above, by completing the daily quests of the "Calligraphic Symbols" event, will receive normal ink and barrels with ink needed for drawing symbols of characteristics.

By spinning the Wheel of Fortune for a small fee, every Elinorian has a chance to acquire magic storages, chests with various storages, or an Ancestral Chest.

By defeating valiant opponents and experienced monsters, you can obtain safes from the honorable Karl Grobft. By opening safes for a small fee in crystals, you will receive various rare items, including a certificate for an individual seal, and instead of ghostly boss cards, you can now get a ghostly box!

All events will end at the end of February 4, 2024.

Wishing you a cheerful mood!

notes.title: Competition of Technomages and the Observatory
notes.notes:
Brave technomages! The monthly ranking "Competition of Technomages" has begun, and not far from the Hermit-Stargazer's house, the gates to adventures in the Observatory have shone. But that's not all! A bit late, but the Snow Spirit decided to bring holiday gifts with your help to some more respected residents of Elinor.

You can read the rules of the Observatory on the infoportal.
The rounds of the battles will end at 23:30 on January 28, and the portal to the base camp, where you can buy boxes with lenses, will close at the end of January 31.

You can read information about the "Competition of Technomages" ranking here.
The assortment of goods for prize tokens has been expanded, and now in the Supply Center, you can also purchase the Brilberg inlay stone or exchange it for a strengthened one with an additional payment in prize tokens.
The results of the rating and rewards will be summed up on January 29 during the morning technical maintenance at 5:30 Moscow time.
