Despite the end of the holidays, the Snow Spirit decided that no one should be left without a gift! Elinor residents who delivered gifts to the winter months can continue their exciting adventure and deliver gifts to all members of the unions. Upon completing the chain of assignments, technomages who completed the task "Juno's Disappearance" will go to bestow charming Sheila and the Horsefly or Nagor. And finally, players of level 11 and above, who previously completed the task "Introduction to the Goblin-Scout," can bring their green friend a wonderful gift!

We wish you exciting adventures!

notes.title: Strengthening Talismans of Power
notes.notes:
Brave warriors! In the upcoming days exciting adventures await you, where you can acquire magic storages for talismans of power, embark on goblin's treasure hunts, and get image artifacts' workpieces in the Rarity Shop.

Elinorians of level 7 and above who have completed the "Talismans of Power" quest, will receive daily assignments upon entering the game. As a reward for completing them, you will be granted magic storages necessary for strengthening talismans of power.

In the Crystal Store, you will find cobalt pickaxes that, when used, allow you to go on searches for secret chests with treasures. 
Additionally, a small limited batch of pickaxes can be obtained in the City Store for universal coins.
Please note that the reward in the heroic secret chest has been replaced with Brilmit based on the character's level, which opens the chest.
For more details on treasure excavations, you can check the infoportal.

In the Rarity Store, workpieces and the blue crystal, used for creating image artifacts, are available on the store's shelves for personalized coins.

Daily assignments and the purchase of items are available until January 21, 2024.

Wishing you a great mood!

notes.title: Four-leaf clover
notes.notes:
The glorious Eleanorians! It's time to increase your gold reserves with four-leaf clover!

Yar Marko was in such a hurry to deliver a batch of good luck medallions that he did not notice how during the parking the boxes with the medallions were stolen by curious monsters, breaking all the medallions into pieces to feast on the magical energy from them.
You can get such a medallion, capable of increasing the amount of money extracted from the battle by 50% for 3 days, by finding its fragments among the trophies obtained from various experienced monsters, and using a four-leaf clover to collect a whole medallion. In addition to increasing gold production, the luck medallion gives you a chance to get Coffin iron safes in battle with experienced monsters.
To collect the good luck medallion, you will need three pieces of it and one four-leaf clover. His
You can buy one piece each at the city clan store for tauri and at the city store for gold. Elinor's Bank is also ready to give you up to 50 pieces of clover, one for every 100 crystals of the payment amount.
The more luck medallions you can combine, the longer the energy of clover and wealth will arrive with you: each collected medallion prolongs its life time.
Published photo Published photo Published photo

You will be able to get the fragments of the medallion and the four-leaf clover before the end of January 17.

We wish you a good week!

notes.title: Festive Season
notes.notes:
Winter has arrived, and the snow with frost reminds us more than ever of the approaching New Year. While many areas of Eleanor enjoy warm sunshine all year round, all residents are eager to set up festive Christmas trees and decorate them in the best way possible to bring joy to themselves and the children.

To make a festive ikebana you’ll need to go in search of these attributes:
- Glass ball: Obtained from experienced monsters on the Snow Island or crafted using super glue from ball shards, which can be obtained from any monsters in Eleanor except initial locations.
- Magic Light: Earned by defeating valiant opponents. If your victory occurs in a winter territory, there is a chance to get 2 magic lights at once.
- Spruce sprigs: Found in trophies from bosses in dangerous territories of Eleanor. spruce sprigs can also be obtained for every 150 crystals spent. Read the details in the quest log.
- Ribbons and Pots: Used to collect decorated spruce sprigs, available for purchase until December 24 in the Crystal Store. Ribbons can also be found in the city store.
Eleanor's residents, level 5 and above, can collect holiday attributes until December 20 inclusive, and rewards for exchanging Christmas trees can be obtained until the end of their lifespan.

For exchanging Christmas trees, you can receive the following gifts:
- From a spruce sprig: 5 pieces of winter ammunition (normal giant Glace and crystals of taming) and 40 particles of eternal ice.

- From a small Christmas tree: A set of winter ammunition, 10 pieces of all kinds, 90 particles of eternal ice, and 5 summoning seals.

- From a beautiful Christmas tree: 15 pieces of winter ammunition, 140 particles of eternal ice, 10 summoning seals, 6 ghostly cards of Darkness and Light.

- From a lush Christmas tree: 20 pieces of winter ammunition, 200 particles of eternal ice, 15 summoning seals, 18 ghostly cards of Darkness and Light, and 1 set of boss summons.

- The most beautiful, royal Christmas tree, will gift you the most generous presents: 25 pieces of winter ammunition, 300 particles of eternal ice, 20 summoning seals, 30 ghostly cards of Darkness and Light, 2 sets of boss summons, and a December scroll of choice. It contains one of the selectable gifts: 4000 particles of eternal ice, 500 nimelin shards or rage stone, 12 ghostly boss cards, 32 ghostly magic cards, 10 fruitful leaves of the money tree. These gifts can be obtained as many times as you like. Additionally, this scroll can be exchanged once for 4000 prize tokens and 1000 fragments of fractal matrix (exchange is available to those who have access to the test chambers of the Dor-Taund temple). 5 such scrolls can be exchanged once for a certificate for an individual seal.

New decks of cards and jokers of schools and magic skills appeared in Technomagic, allowing you to temporarily weaken your opponent's spells. Cards from the decks of mages and knights are available to humans, and when the effect is applied from the joker of these decks, it weakens the power of spells for dwarves with engineer and warrior skills. Engineer and warrior jokers are available to dwarves and weaken the magic of spells for humans from the school of mages and knights. These cards are obtained with a chance when defeating a valiant opponent on the continent (Soli-Dor, Mines, Hive, Catacombs, Dungeons, the Snow Island).

Wishing you joyful tree decoration!

notes.title: The first day of winter
notes.notes:
Winter has arrived in Eleanor, bringing with it a way to the Snow Island and a lot of fuss. Residents of Longholm and Khatog remembered how much they missed the road to the winter lands and eagerly await a volunteer to carry out simple tasks.

Technomages level 5 and above once again have access to the Snow Island. To move to the frosty lands, you'll need to complete the quest "Broken Compass" if you've never been there before, or "Winter is Coming" to get the navigator's compass.

Every willing soul can become a conqueror of the snow! To do this, you need to complete daily tasks to obtain quest items, or you can purchase everything you need in the Crystal Store. Eleanor's citizens who previously achieved the "Snow Conqueror II" and reached level 12 will be rewarded with a new chest, the opening of which grants the "Snow Conqueror III" achievement. The quest is available until January 8, 2024, and you can complete the quest no later than January 10.

By visiting the mayor on the Snow Island before January 21, 2024, you can receive the quest "Frost Crystals" and acquire frosty regalia with a lifespan of 30 days.

Near the Crystal Store, you'll find the Snow Spirit Store, where until January 8, you can exchange a weightless snowflake, given upon entering the game, for one of the proposed bonuses of your choice.

After obtaining the compass, visit Dylan or Kragor, and a chain of new assignments from various residents of Longholm and Khatog will open for you. Hurry to visit everyone! The quest is completed only once.

Snow Island also offers a multitude of entertainments: winter monsters, daily tasks, the “Hero of the Snow Island” reputation, seasonal ammunition, icy spells studying, maps of the Winter Valley bosses, and more. 
This year, all monsters and bosses of the Snow Island have become stronger, some monsters even changed their look. 
The minimum damage to receive a group drop from bosses has been raised: for Antifreeze up to 3000, for Rider Commander up to 4000, for Naga up to 5000. These bosses also gained a new aura, Ice Death, which immediately destroys any opponent whose level is 4 or more levels lower than the boss.
The mechanics of the Boss aura have changed — instead of 15 moves, this aura will reduce the life of the opponent and destroy all their stones and stones of the opponent every 6 moves.

The Snow Island now has its own library, where recipes for winter ammunition and projectiles from the city library have moved.

Until December 5, inclusive, by defeating valiant warriors and monsters, there is a chance to get normal or heroic personalized chests. Obtaining normal chests from monsters is limited but an unlimited number of heroic chests can be found in the Rarity Store.

And also until December 3, you have a chance to get normal elixirs of denial, which help write off 25 experience points at your current level, and enchanted elixirs of denial, writing off 100 experience points, are placed on the Crystal Store counter.

Wishing you a warm mood!

notes.title: The autumn sale continues
Technomage Competition and the Observatory
notes.notes:
In Eleanor, the "Technomage Competition" rating has started, along with the Observatory season! Participate, earn rewards, and improve your character!

Find useful information about the Observatory rules on our infoportal. Participation in battles in snow-covered areas is available until 23:30 on November 26. Visiting the Base Camp, purchasing and opening boxes with lenses is available until the end of November 29.

You can find the conditions of participation and a list of rewards for the "Technomage Competition" rating on our infoportal. 
Results will be announced, as usual, next Monday during the morning technical maintenance at 5:30 AM Moscow time.

Until the end of November 21, the Bank of Eleanor is giving its depositors purple pouches with gems! By purchasing crystals before that date, for every 300 units from the amount of one payment, you will receive two pouches with a collection of gems.

Wishing you exciting adventures!

notes.title: Preparing for the beginning of Winter
notes.notes:
The headman and the elder of Eleanor announced the preparation for winter and a mass gathering of fabrics, leather, and threads to make warm clothing for the city's residents!
Technomages of level 6 and above can participate in the event until the end of November 26. For delivering frosty garment, you will receive a random reward and progress points for the achievement "The Great Tailor," if the achievement has not been unlocked before.

To sew frosty garments, you will need:
- Special pattern: Sold by a merchant near the Coliseum.
- Tanned fur: Sometimes obtained when defeating bats, bloodsuckers, cavemen, rats, bears, vampires, Kobold, Vugluskr, and Hive goblins.
- Durable leather: There’s a chance to find it as a reward from monsters such as lizards, monitor lizards, dragons, worms, octopuses, Fish-Lizards, blind man, infected goblins, and gravediggers.
- Soft down: Rarely can be obtained from spirits, ghosts, goose, phantoms, Coliseum spirits, stellars, and luminaries.
- Spider silk: Can be found among the remains of arachnids like adult spiders, darkworms, and black arachnids.
- Fabric roll: Found among other resources when opening troll bags.
- Tailor's kit: You need to craft it using 2 iron ores, 10 linen threads, 2 needle sets, and a 
measuring tape obtained from a defeated valiant opponent. The measuring tape is also sold in the Crystal Store.

The Tournament of Equals awaits you again! After getting a special ticket, you need to sign up in the journal at the Academy Square. Once a worthy opponent is found, you will engage in a battle with equal characteristics and magic, where only Power Concentrates and gems can help you. Daily, you will receive 10 tickets upon entering the game until the tournament ends. Additional tickets, as well as ammunition for the tournament, can be purchased in the Rarity Store.
As a reward for winning the tournament, you will receive 1 point each in the "Fighter" and "Triumph" ratings and a chance to get a measuring tape.

For players of level 16 and above: Sh'aktayn is waiting for you on the Island of Initiation, ready to share more secrets of Light, allow strengthening the bracelet of Light to level 20, use magical, heroic, and epic Runes of Light and the Commander’s luminaries stones, as well as transform legendary pennants of Light into components.

The Bank of Eleanor is once again generous with gifts! Until November 19, for every 500 crystals purchased, you will immediately receive 10 boxes of Light and peaceful protectresses!

Get ready for winter in high spirits!

notes.title: Autumn Blues
Weekend Specials
notes.notes:
The upcoming weekend in the world of Elinor brings you special offers, discounts, and various in-game events! 
Until November 6th:
— By completing daily tasks from the "Skilled jeweler" event, you will receive boxes with resin according to your character's level.
— Defeating valiant warriors and experienced monsters gives you a chance to obtain safes with treasures of Grobfts .
— Visiting the headman or the elder of the city daily will grant you a 2-hour effect of Denial or Omniscience.
— The starting price of purchasing cells in the crystal safe has been reduced from 5 to 1 crystal.

City florists stocked up their shelves with festive-themed gifts, and in the wardrobe you can now find the images of Ogg’s and Argh’s equipment sets.

And of course, special offers!
On November 3rd, your items will not lose durability when defeated in dangerous territories.
On November 4th, as a reward for killing experienced monsters, you may find one gold or several silver Halloween coins. When defeating opponents of the hostile race, coins are guaranteed!
On November 5th, the chances of obtaining magic water for growing a giant pumpkin from various monsters are doubled!
On November 6th, each Shadow Dust will free twice as many imprisoned souls, required for Sh'aktayn's task!

Wishing you a great weekend!

notes.title: New Halloween adversities
notes.notes:
In the expanses of Elinor, the spooky holiday unfolds in its own way! The Hermit Stargazer and Sh'aktayn need your help to lift the wretched curses!

The Servant of the Darkness and the Light awaits brave warriors to help rescue imprisoned souls in the Dark Vaults. He is ready to grant 3 shadow dust daily, which is needed to free the souls, and as a reward, he will give you Black Sand and a Sh'aktayn’s Scroll, allowing purchases in his store.
For those eager to free as many souls as possible, an unlimited amount of shadow dust is available at the merchant's store on the Island of Initiation.
In Sh'aktayn's store, scrolls of Light sketches have appeared, from which you can obtain an exclusive sketch of your choice. During each "Rescue of Imprisoned Souls" event, you can purchase only one scroll (set) of Dark or Light sketches.

After visiting the Hermit Stargazer, you'll learn that a dreadful curse of the Halaween spirit has spread throughout the Observatory's territory. After death, local inhabitants, as well as humans and dwarves, unexplainably and randomly return as zombies, driven by a singular desire — to consume all living things!
Help destroy the zombies by delivering death blows with stakes, which can be obtained from the Hermit in exchange for the broken branches of bushes brought to him in the Observatory, and receive Brains as a reward — an ammunition that can be used in battles within Elinor's territories. Using this ammunition will unlock new Zombie Hunter medals. You'll find a limited batch of Brains in the Halloween store.

And there are new gifts from the Bank of Elinor! Until the end of October, with every purchase of crystals for every 500 units, you'll receive 10 Sweet Apples VII!

Wishing you a spooky mood!

notes.title: Halloween Holiday in Elinor
notes.notes:
The final week of the month has arrived, which means it's time for the Observatory season and spooky adventures in the ghostly Elinor!

The spooky season of Halloween has begun! Elinorians of level 5 and above can receive the quest "Very strange things" from the town cryptographers. After completing it, it will be time for "Dark Secrets of the Past" and "Breaking the Shackles", if these quests were not completed in previous years.
In the town, you will meet the Headless Warrior or the Headless Knight, who will reveal the secret of growing a giant pumpkin with various gifts and give you daily tasks to search for pumpkins. As a reward, you will receive pumpkin ammunition for achieving "Pumpkin mayhem".
Those who haven't done it before, can visit the Headman or the elder of the town and, by completing the quest "The Halloween Gift", receive a certificate to change the appearance of the city forge or workshop.

Guests of Ghostly Elinor can remember or learn how to grow ripe apples and receive silver and gold Halloween coins. Silver Halloween coins can be exchanged for gold at a rate of 100 to 1, and with gold coins, you can purchase rare items in the Halloween store or a thematic appearance for your armor in the Wardrobe.
You can obtain ingredients for holiday sweets from monsters in Ghostly Elinor, but remember that the Ghostly Skeleton rewards players at levels 5-10, the Walking Dead at levels 11-15, 	the Shadow Guardian at levels 16-20, and the Slayer of souls at level 21 and above. The Risen Necromancer in the ghostly Coliseum and the Sectarian will share their supplies with anyone who can defeat them in an honest battle.

New achievements have been added to the festive events:
"Trick or treat" — for making sweet apples VII;
"Apple Exchange" — for receiving a reward from sweet apples VII;
"Rich Gardener" — for receiving a reward from a grown giant pumpkin;
"Barmbrack's admirer" — for breaking barmbrack.
And of course, there's the "Halloween Technomage Competition" ranking! Points from various actions during the spooky holiday count towards it: victories over opponents in the ghostly Elinor Coliseum, creating apple seeds, making sweet apples and exchanging them for coins, growing and exchanging pumpkins for gifts, and breaking barmbrack. Achieving prize places before the end of the ranking, which will take place on October 30th during technical maintenance, will earn you prize tokens.
You can visit Ghostly Elinor until the end of  November 1st, use cauldrons and make barmbracks. Growing sweet apples and spending Halloween coins is available until November 5th included.
Already on Wednesday, the Dark Vaults will call brave warriors to free imprisoned souls.

And don't forget, until the end of the week, battles with enemies and monsters await you on the snowy Observatory grounds. The Hermit Stargazer will help you stock up on ammunition and gladly accept the gold lenses you find in the Observatory, in exchange for various useful items. More details about the Observatory can be found on the infoportal.

Wishing you a spooky holiday!

notes.title: Calligraphy Lessons in Eleanor
notes.notes:
The cryptographers of Longholm and Khatog are ready to teach the Technomages the art of calligraphy!

Until October 23rd, players level 5 and above will receive various tasks upon logging in, with rewards for their completion being normal inks and barrels with ink. Read more in the quest log.

This weekend, daily events await you:

On Saturday, October 21st, your armor will maintain its strength even after defeat.
On October 22nd, after defeating valiant warriors, bosses, and experienced monsters, you'll have a chance to obtain the Knowledge guardians's seals.
Players belonging to a clan will have the opportunity to gather triumpharies from experienced trolls on the Island of Initiation, but no more than 50 per day.

And already on Monday, you can look forward to the Observatory, spooky Halloween adventures, and Halloween battles for Technomages!

Wishing you a great weekend!

notes.title: Autumn leaf fall
notes.notes:
The autumn season is enchanting with its falling leaves. Dive into the "Autumn leaf fall" event, collecting herbariums and receiving autumn coins as rewards.
To start collecting sets, visit Iria or Ungor. They will tell you about ways to get autumn leaves, and explain that these collected leaves should be glued into notebooks or albums for the herbarium. You can exchange them for autumn coins, which can be used in a special Autumn Store located at the Commercial square.
You can obtain a notebook for herbarium by completing one of three daily tasks. The completion time and progress of these tasks are refreshed at midnight, and you'll receive a new task when you log in. The notebook with leaves can be exchanged randomly for 5 or 10 autumn coins. You'll find an album for herbarium in the Crystal Store, and in exchange, you'll receive 10 autumn coins guaranteed.
More detailed information can be found in the quest log.

In the Autumn Store, you'll have the opportunity to purchase a bag with fragments of platum weakening and exchange these fragments for different colors. You can also buy a Vizor of magician, Boxes of Light, peaceful Mihrutkas, Tauri, ghostly cards, aquionats, and disposable keys at the Dor-Taund Temple and Gron-Norg. In the wardrobe located in the forge, you'll find autumn appearances for your rings and amulets.

On Monday, October 9th, there will be a rating for collecting autumn sets. For winning places, you can receive autumn coins and points in the "Race Participant" medal line. The results will be counted on October 16th during the morning maintenance.

You can collect autumn leaves until the end of October 17th, and you can glue them and spend autumn coins until October 19th included.

Eleanor Bank is giving autumn gifts to its depositors! Until October 15th, for every 100 crystals purchased in one payment, you'll receive 10 full sets of leaves for the herbarium.

But that's not all! The city florists have prepared wonderful gifts for Teacher's Day, and the headman Zlatovan and the headman Koragor will reward anyone who visits them with a two-hour Denial effect daily until October 8th.

Wishing you successful herbarium collecting!

notes.title: Talisman Magic
notes.notes:
The end of the week heralds an entertaining weekend and the long-awaited visit to Elinor, where adventures await you in the pursuit of magic storing devices!

"Talisman Magic" is now in the game! Complete daily assignments, the details of which you'll find in the Quest log (upon entering the game), acquire  magic storing devices, and strengthen talismans of power.
Elinorians at level 7 and above who have completed the "Talismans of Power" task can participate in the event until the end of October 2nd.

Then, on Wednesday, October 4th, after the morning technical stop of the game, the "Autumn leaf fall" event will begin in Technomagic.

Wishing you a great weekend!

notes.title: The Tournament of Equals and Ether Purification
notes.notes:
Valiant warriors! This weekend, you can expect several adventures at once! "Tournament of Equals" or "Ether Purification" - choose how you want to spend this technomagical weekend. Or perhaps, putting aside all the tasks, is it worth participating in both events?

The Tournament of Equals is a duel for true heroes! With a special ticket, you need to register your participation in the journal on the Academy Square, and as soon as a worthy opponent is found, a duel with equal characteristics and magic will begin, where only Power Concentrates and Gems can help you. You will receive 10 tickets daily upon entering the game until the end of the tournament. Additional tickets and ammunition for the tournament can be purchased in the Rarity store. 
As a reward for winning the tournament, you will receive 1 point in the "Fighter" and "Triumph" ratings, as well as a Fiber of light or a flap randomly. 
By placing 6 Fibers of light in an empty box, you will receive a Box of Light, and by sewing 3 flaps using a Magister's needle, you will get a peaceful protectress. 
The empty box, as well as the Rune of Power, which doubles the receiving of the Light Boxes, are sold in the Rarity store, and the Magister's needles are available at Urdin’s and Barfos' city store. 
Participation in the tournament is available until the end of Sunday, and you can collect fibers into boxes and sew flaps until September 25th.

Ether Purification is a task available from Valian or Chemicle. Visit the alchemy master of your faction and learn more about the ways to mine aquaionite, that is needed for the aether purification process:
- Small portions can be received daily from an alchemist or herbalist, or found in the Soli-Dor wells and exchanged for universal coins from the cryptographer;
- By purchasing retorts from the merchant near the Colosseum, you can mine aquaionite from skilled monsters of dangerous territories;
- Buy it in the Artifact Store.
Depending on the quality of the purified aether, you will receive different rewards, and it's up to you to decide at which stage of purification to stop. 
Receiving a reward for purified aether completes the task, but you can receive it again by purchasing a dark aether in the Rarity Store. 
Obtaining aquaionite (except for purchase) is only available until the end of September 26th, and you can purify the aether and receive a reward from it at any time convenient for you. 
A reminder: after receiving the reward from the aether, all methods of obtaining aquaionite, except for purchase, will be unavailable. We recommend claiming the reward at the end of the event.

We wish you a pleasant weekend!

notes.title: Hearts of the mines
notes.notes:
Early fall brought mysterious events to Elinor! The whole underworld and some of the closed territories were filled with an eerie fog, and many creatures living in those lands had their hearts turned into diamond crystals...
The Technomagic supply center is ready to exchange rare incrustation stones for the hearts of mines you have gathered, which can be earned by completing the various daily quests of the event!

When you complete quests in the quest log, you will be awarded hearts of mines, boxes with hearts of mines, or just shards of hearts. When you open a box, you can get a whole heart of mines or a specific number of shards. The 100 heart shards are assembled into a whole using magic glue or magic superglue.
For the quest " Hunter of Darkwood", available from level 8 and performed once, for the daily quests "Crystal Fever" and "Successful Investment" (crystal spending), available from level 6, you will be awarded kopje hearts.

You will receive boxes with the heart of mines for the quests "Grimbold's fortress regular", available from level 8, and "Tower of despair regular", available from level 10, completed once, as well as for the daily quests "Successful investment" (gold spending), "Dungeon warrior" and "Fearless hunter", available to characters from level 6.
For the " Freewill Hunter" quest, available to characters from level 6, you will receive shards of the heart of mines.
Attention! When completing the "Successful investment" quest, make sure that the expenditure you are making is on the quest list or check if the planned expenses will be counted.
You can read more about available quests and rewards for completing it in the quest log.

There is a chance to get boxes with hearts of mines by trying your luck in the Luck Drum, and you can also disassemble any stones from Yar Marco with the jeweler's toolkit from the Supply center and get several hearts and a huge number of their shards. 

New item has been added to the assortment of stones for the hearts of mines - epic opalion! 
Please note! From the next "Hearts of mines" event, epic nimelin will be sold instead of solid nimelin.

We wish you a successful mining of hearts!

notes.title: Realizing the secrets of the Light
notes.notes:
Sh'aktain is waiting on the Island of Dedication for all those who wish to continue learning about the light side and receive new abilities of the Light!

The learning of the light path continues and new quests have become available in Elinor, where you will be able to transform normal, enchanted, and magical pennants of Light into components, as well as turn components back into pennants. You will be able to upgrade the Bracelet of Light to the Bracelet of Light Wisdom, which has a built-in rune of Light, you can purchase and study in the city library the recipe for a normal rune of Light for skill marks and the scheme of the candle of valor for darkness marks, as well as to insert the rune and the candle into equipment items. 
There are some restrictions that come into effect with the appearance and the reputation of Light:

- forbidden to wear a cloak of Darkness or a cloak with the rune of Darkness, when you are wearing a bracelet of Light, a bracelet with the rune of Light or the pennant of Light is active.
- forbidden to wear a bracelet of Light or a bracelet with the rune of Light, if you are wearing a cloak of Darkness, cloak with the rune of Darkness or active pennant of Darkness.
- forbidden to activate the pennant of Darkness, if you are wearing a bracelet of Light or a bracelet with the rune of Light
- forbidden to activate the pennant of Light, if you are wearing a cloak of Darkness or a cloak with the rune of Darkness. 
Further quests to improve your Bracelet of Light are expected next month. 

Have a good one!

notes.title: School is coming soon
The Observatory and the competition of technomages
notes.notes:
21.08.2023
The Observatory and the competition of technomages
The summer is almost over, and new events have begun in the Elinor: "The Pearl Harvester" and " Competition of technomages" rankings, as well as the next season of the Observatory.

You will need to use the portal near the Hermit Stargazer's lodge. After you move to the base camp, redistribute your magic points to combat spells. After that, you can fight monsters and formidable opponents in the snowy lands to get normal and gold lenses, which you can use to purchase items in the Observatory store.

You can participate in the event season until 23:30 on August the 27th, and purchase lens boxes at the base camp until the end of August the 30th. 
You can read more about the Observatory rules on the infoportal portal. 
https://info.tmgame.ru/library/world/Observatory/

Also, another summer ranking "Pearl Harvester" started today. By fulfilling the conditions specified in the ranking description, you will be able to get an obsidian award and points in the "Race participant" medal line.

Have a good one!

notes.title: Harvesting juicy fruit
notes.notes:
There is nothing more delightful than a juicy apple or a bunch of fragrant grapes to quench your thirst under the searing sun. Finally, it's time for Elinor to harvest delicious fruits, collect it in a basket and receive gifts!
Until the end of August 13, by participating in the Fruit Time event, technomagicians of level 5 and higher can harvest fruit, put it in baskets, and when you fill 20 baskets for a special quest, receive one of the rewards you choose: 
1) 150 ghostly crystals;
2) 2 fragile horns of plenty, 15 life-giving ichor, 3 leader chests and randomly one of the crystal fruit inlay stones or a gardener's rune.

You will be able to get fruits in the following ways: 
Apples - by defeating level-appropriate bosses, including the Gloomwood.
Pears - by defeating valiant opponents in equal combat.
Grapes - with a chance at destroying skilled monsters.
Plums - with a chance at opening any C.H.E.S.T.s.
It is quite difficult to fill the basket to the top with fruits, because getting apples, pears and grapes is limited and you can get 2 fruits of each kind per day, and you can resume getting fruits by removing a special alarm clock. And only plums you can find in an unlimited amount in C.H.E.S.T.s. 
After receiving the reward, the "Fruit Time" quest will be considered completed, but you can repeat the fruit picking if you wish - for this you will need to buy a harvesting permit from the Rarity store. You can complete the quest an unlimited number of times.

The Bank of Elinor is giving fruit baskets to technomagicians! By purchasing crystals before the end of August 6, you will receive one fruit basket for every 100 crystals of a one payment! Don't forget to purchase a harvesting permit for your quest rewards!

Have a good one!

notes.title: Hot weekend
notes.notes:
You glorious warriors! This coming weekend you'll find limited shipments of rare items in the Crystal store, a gift from the Bank of Elinor, and reports from the Expedition Commander and Knowledge Keeper! 

Until August 11, by completing daily quests of the commander in the Hive and the Knowledge Keeper, you will receive documents from them confirming the fact of completing the quests. 10 reports of one type are exchanged for a technowarrior's chest with rare ammunition. 
You can get the Commander's report for completing quests in the Hive (Exorcising many-legged, Exorcising Wings, Replenishing supplies, Destroying clutches, Following the trail of Grobfts, Eliminating competitors), and the Keeper's report for quests in the Temple of the Ancients (Measuring magfield and Extracting tags).

Limited quantities of rare items await you daily at 20:00 throughout the weekend on the Crystal store counters: 
28.07 - 3 cages per each faction with loyal bats and bloodsuckers
29.07 - 6 durable stones of bloody confrontation for the whole world
30.07 - 6 strong stones of devastating spoils for the whole world

Gift from the Bank of Elinor! For every 500 crystals of your payment amount by the end of July 30th you will receive 1 ghostly card, also for the first 500 crystals you guaranteed to receive a card box, and for all further 500 crystals of your payment amount you get a chance for additional card boxes.

Have a great weekend!

notes.title: Light's reputation. The Beginning.
notes.notes:
Glorious technomagicians! It has happened! Very soon the reputation of Light will be available!

The introduction of the Light reputation will happen in three stages.
Stage 1 is already available - it is the "Weaving of Light" quest, which will be brought to you by Sh'aktain. The quest is available for players of level 6 and higher who have reached the first level of Darkness Reputation (300 points). As a reward for the quest, you will receive a sketch of a light pattern of Fate and 4 points of Light reputation. It is not possible to study the sketch yet.
In Stage 2, you will receive the sketch and Light reputation points in the same way as you do for Darkness reputation. You will have to make products based on sketches of light patterns, get sketches of light pennants and learn it. You will learn detailed information about light pennants from the relevant news. This stage will be introduced tentatively next week.

And on the last, stage 3, new quests from Sh'aktayn will become available, the reward for which will be the improvement of the Bracelet of Light, the ability to separate light pennants into components, to learn the recipes for the runes of Light (for the bracelet) and the schemes for the lightstones (stones in the regalia), and to insert these into matching items. The tentative completion date for this phase is August-September 2023.

The wheel of fortune is available to the lover of fortune until the end of July 27. By spinning the wheel for gold and crystals, you can win a technowarrior chest or a berry collection chest, threads of fate, a gladiator coin, a crystal key, a regular cube of doubts or some gold coins.

The beta version of the game became the main version today. This means that the client will be updated to this version as well. In the mobile application, the current version will gradually be replaced by the beta version as well. The beta label next to the version number will no longer exist.

Have a nice day!

notes.title: Tournament of Equals and more
notes.notes:
Valiant technomagicians! This upcoming weekend is open for entries for the Tournament of Equals. Please proceed to the Academy Square and sign in the journal there! 

Until the end of the tournament on July 23, all Elinorians of level 6 and higher with a tournament ticket will be able to leave an entry in the participation journal and test their strength among warriors of equal stats and magic. You will only need a couple of concentrates, which can be purchased at the Rarity Store, as well as tournament tickets, in addition to the 10 pieces you will receive daily when you log in to the game until the tournament ends. 
By winning the tournament battles, you will be rewarded with 1 point each in the "Fighter" and "Triumph" rankings and a "Gooseberry", which is necessary for collecting in the "Berry Time" event. 
The tournament will last until 23:59 on July 23.

During the weekend, you'll find barrels of negation on the counters of the Crystal Store. If you activate such a keg, you will be able to gain experience by winning various fights for a whole week.

The Bank of Elinor did not leave its depositors without gifts this weekend! For every 500 crystals from the amount of one payment until the end of July 23 you will receive one lottery ticket of draw #8. By opening the lottery tickets, you can get a rune of immortality or other valuable prizes!

Have a great weekend!

notes.title: The time of berries
notes.notes:
Summer is the season of harvesting! Close to the middle of the season ripe berries, which can be used to make delicious jam or wonderful morsels. That is why it is time to put your swords and axes aside and, equipped with a special basket, go to pick ripe berries and exchange berry collections for gifts!
Until the end of July 27, you can get berries in the following ways:
- make products according to the weaver's recipes to obtain strawberries
- defeat valiant enemies in all Elinor territories except the Tower of Despair and Grimbold Fortress to get blueberries.
- open burglar's chests to get a chance to get cloudberries
- defeat evil bosses ( according to the conditions of getting a reward when you win) to find blackberries.
- win in fights on the territory of the Tower of Despair and the Grimbold Fortress to get gooseberries.

If you want to harvest as many berries as possible, you can purchase a permit from the Crystal store, which allows you to get a chance to harvest a random type of berry when defeating any monsters (except for the initial locations and bosses). 
Stacking different types of berries in baskets will earn you a certain reward (please note! the rewards have been changed), and for the total number of baskets that you collect, you will receive additional berry cups!

For 100 berry baskets, you will receive a 3rd place trophy, which will give you the opportunity to receive a choice of miner's tools once a day.
After harvesting 300 berry baskets, you will receive a 2nd place trophy and the opportunity to choose once a day one of the effects for 1 hour: negation, scroll of fortune, hunter or master.
And if you harvest 500 berry baskets, you will receive a 1st place trophy, which you can use once a day to receive concentrates of magic, concentrates of life or normal cubes of doubt or try your luck and get valuable prizes, including the main prize - Adamas of power and 5000 of personalized coins. 
When the event is over, the faction that has harvested the most delicious berries in their baskets will receive 10% more money when they win for 30 days!

The bank of the Elinor presents gifts! Up to July 18 inclusively for every 100 crystals from the amount of one payment you will receive 3 chests with berry collection!

You will find new items among the rewards in the Berry Season event: 
- Legendary jeweler's purse - can be received for a complete berry collection. The purse contains rare inlay stones of your choice.
- sealed symbol - can be obtained by "Trying the Fortune" of the Berry Cup for 1st place. With 100 ink of the matching color, you can get one of the damage, strength, and weakening symbols of your choice. 
- Blacksmith's sack - you can get the "Trying Fortune" of the Berry Cup for 1st place. Contains 1 piece of random blacksmith ore.

Have a great harvesting!

notes.title: Yar Marco's arrival
notes.notes:
The summer month has passed and in the squares of Elinor you can once again hear the clamors, which means that fair week is coming up.

You can find: Hero memories and copy sheets, fair bags and transformers of candles or lamps, alchemical cauldrons and distillation cubes, onyx safes, solar prisms, fragile inlay stones and much more, as well as discounts on hatred spells and boxes of pain storages. 
For Elinorian fashionistas, a new item has been imported this month - Forest demoness avatar!

Additionally, during the week medals that you can only get in the winter became available for purchase! You will be able to purchase: The Art of Defense, Weapon of Cold, New Year's mood.

Hurry up to purchase the goods you desire!

notes.title: Tournament of Equals
notes.notes:
Brave warriors! It's time to test your strength in equal battles, without any advantages! 
The Academy Square awaits all brave warriors from level 6  to test their warrior skills on a level playing field! You will need to buy a ticket to the tournament and, leaving an entry in the logbook and waiting for your opponent, get into a 1 on 1 duel with the same parameters and magic to participate. 
Until the end of the tournament, you will receive 10 tickets each day when you enter the game, and you can purchase unlimited tickets and concentrates of power and gems used in the Tournament of Equals from the Rarity Store if you need it. 
For each victory in the tournament you will receive such rewards: 1 point each to the "Fighter" and "Triumph" rankings and a chance to receive a delicate lily to create charming bouquets. 
This tournament will finish at 23:59 on June 21th.

Have a good mood!

notes.title: The Summer Fair
notes.notes:
There is once again a cheerful shouting in the squares of Elinor, inviting technomagicians not to pass by to purchase the various goods available only during the week since the arrival of Yar Marco and his assistants. 

On this visit, the foreign merchant has decided to delight Elinorians with bundles of lock picks, keys and locks, discounted water totems and earth totems, magic scrolls of fortune and pro toolkits, Grobft treasure maps and harpies, elixirs of purification, resource encyclopedias, and much more. 
And there's also a new forest demon avatar waiting for fashionistas of Elinor, and for those who like to try their luck, a fountain of luck has been placed on the city squares!

By the end of Sunday, when you dip a gold coin into the fountain, you will receive one of the gifts at random: 10 Pearl Emulsion, 1 Ghost Crystal, 1 Common Doubt Cube or 1 Aqua-ionite, 2 Diamond Shards, 2 Weakening Chain Links, Quality or Superior Essence, Lump of Silver , gold or platinum clay, anabestos, one of the rare gifts, 10 blade shards, grains of life or grains of hatred.

And of course, have a good mood throughout the week!

notes.title: Floral season
notes.notes:
Summer is the most beautiful time in Elinor, characterized by the blossoming of different flowers and the desire to collect the most beautiful bouquets in the world. We would like to inform you that the next two weeks are all about floristry, so there are generous prizes and fun to be had picking bouquets of different sizes!
You need to get chrysanthemums, lilies and roses in the following ways to make bouquets: 
You are guaranteed to get elegant lilies if you defeat a valiant opponent.
Colorful chrysanthemums with a chance can be obtained as a reward from any monsters of the world of Elinor (except the initial locations).
And lovely roses will be yours if you defeat the bosses of dangerous territories corresponding to the level of your character. A limited number of roses you get for completing daily quests for the spending of personalized coins and gold (details in the quest log), and unlimited number will give you Elinor Bank when you add to your character account - 1 rose for every 100 crystals of the single payment. 
To assemble charming flowers into a bouquet you'll need a ribbon for a simple bouquet, which can be found on the stalls of the Merchant near the Colosseum or in the Crystal store.

The bouquet that you gather depends on the magnificence and splendor of the bouquet you receive! 
A simple bouquet - a chrysanthemum, a lily, and a rose tied with a simple ribbon - is exchanged for a flower sphere. Receiving the sphere again will renew its lifetime.
A beautiful bouquet - 5 simple bouquets placed in a vase give a flower sphere and 5 seals of invocation. 
A lush bouquet you will assemble from 15 simple bouquets, and you will receive a flower sphere, 10 seals of call and 2 hero's spirits as a reward. 
A luxurious bouquet is composed of 50 simple bouquets and is awarded with a flower sphere, 20 seals of invocation, 4 Hero's Spirits, and 6 money tree fruiting leaves. 
A royal bouquet requires 150 simple bouquets to be placed in a vase, and gives you a royal reward: a flower sphere, 30 seals of invocation, 6 hero's spirits, 8 money tree fruiting leaves and 2 golden lotus flowers, which gives you one of seven rewards to choose from! 
Players from level 6 and will be able to get the flowers until and including June the 22nd, 2023.
Ribbons and vases can be purchased until 23:59 on June 29th.
You can exchange bouquets (except simple ones) for rewards at any time you like.

And that's not all! There are extra bonuses waiting for you during the holiday weekend:
All Elinorians will receive 50% more gold for winning duels as of today's news release.
On June 10th, it's time for great achievements! When you enter the game, you will receive a hunter effect that doubles the amount of points in achievements for killing the monster types specified in them (except bosses), stacked with similar effects.
On June 11th, your armor will not lose strength when you're defeated, and on June 12th, Zlatovan and Koragor will be ready to give you the effect of negation or omniscience for the rest of the day!

In the Crystal store you will find charmed elixirs of negation that allow you to remove 100 units of experience at your current character level. For players from level 6 there is a chance to find the usual 25 experience negative elixirs in trophies taken from opponents of a hostile faction. These elixirs can be purchased and received until the end of June 12th.

From the beginning of the new week the summer ranking season will begin! You'll win prizes in competitions and earn points in the " Race Participant" medal line.

Have a flower mood!

notes.title: The first day of summer
notes.notes:
It's summer in Elinor and that also means Children's Day, the long-awaited vacation season and time for extra calligraphy lessons for everyone!
The headman Zlatovan and the elder Koragor are waiting for you to join the children's party by the end of June 4. Town florists have prepared not only thematic gifts, but also bright elements of the season.
There are various daily assignments that will get you normal ink and ink barrels for completing it for technomagicians who need calligraphy lessons!
When you collect 100 inks of one of different colors, you can randomly draw a symbol and, if none is available, learn how to write it, while upgrading your characteristics. You can exchange the symbols that you know for the missing higher color or replace one color of ink with another, which is more necessary, in the cryptographer's store.
You can complete quests and receive symbols until the end of June 4. 

Little update! Starting from this moment, 75 kills of players of the opposite faction will be required to open the portal to Gron-Norg. 

Enjoy the summer mood!

notes.title: Malachite beetles in Elinor
notes.notes:
Rays of warm sunshine sparkle on the shells of malachite beetles, reminding us that spring is over and it's time to hunt the cute insects. 
Brave Elinorians of level 5 and higher can go on the hunt for items that gather in the malachite beetles. 
The adorable beetles are exchanged at your choice for valuable rewards. You have a chance to get a rare incrustation stone, the Adamas of power!
You can assemble the malachite beetles from these parts: 
- 10 coils of gold wire, is obtained with a chance when you defeat an experienced monster;
- 10 gold beads, you can get several pieces at once, when you defeat a valiant enemy;
- craftsmanship malachite is available among the rewards from the bosses that live in dangerous territories;
- the master cutters can be purchased in the city stores.

Elinor Bank is giving its depositors malachite beetles that have already been assembled! For every 100 crystals of payment amount, you'll get 4 beetles at once! 

You can get pieces, assemble and receive whole malachite beetles until the end of May 28. Exchanging beetles for desirable rewards is available until the cute insects' time of life expires.

Have a great mood and have fun!

notes.title: The Observatory and the Technomagic contest
notes.notes:
The last week of the month has begun, that means the portal to the snowy lands of the Observatory is now available and you can go to gather collection gems to participate in the Technomagic contest rankings. 
Close to the Hermit Stargazer hut a portal to the Observatory base camp has been activated. There you will meet fierce monsters and tough enemies, which you can defeat to obtain normal or gold lenses and other useful items from the lands of the Observatory. 
You can participate in the new season of the event until 11:30 on May 28, and you can buy or open lens boxes at the base camp until the end of May 31. 
You can read more information about the Observatory here.
https://info.tmgame.ru/library/world/Observatory/

You have to get and open bags of gems and combine collections of those to get ranking points for the " Technomagic contest". 
You can find the event description on the information portal. 
https://info.tmgame.ru/library/world/rating/stone_rep/ 
Ranking results will be announced on May 29 at 05:30.

We have a gift from Elinor Bank! For every 300 crystals of one payment you will receive 2 purple bags of gems until and including May 23! 

Have a great weekend!

notes.title: The temple of Dor-Tound
notes.notes:
Glorious warriors! The sequel to the story of the Dark Lord and the exploration of the main Temple of Gron-Norg, standing in the central square, is available.

Gates of the Temple open after completing Shaktayn's quests, available to players of level 11 and higher who have completed the quest "The Dark Lord's trail". They tell about the new tricks and goals of the Dark Lord, and there will be an introduction to G.L.A.D.Y.S., ex-assistant of the evil one, who will follow all those who wish to visit its virtual worlds.

Test Chambers of G.L.E.D.Y.S. ((virtual worlds) is a single-player adventure, representing the passing of various tests in a series of rooms. Battles with monsters, dimensional puzzles, and logic quests await the test subject.

You can enter the Temple of Dor-Tound from the central square of Gron-Norg by opening the gate with the Silver Key. Only 2 keys are available per week.Those who like to trick the restrictions will be helped by the rare Gold Key, giving 1 extra pass per week and the ability to move into the Temple whenever and wherever you want. In the Hall of the Temple you will find a storage room, where you can get food and tools to facilitate the passing of the test chambers, as well as exchange looted fragments of the fractal matrix and the fractal matrix itself for useful items.

Until the end of May:
1) The 100 kill limit on daily entry into Gron Norg for level 11+ players is removed.
2) Players who received the ability to pass tests in the test chambers, will receive a daily one-time key for the current day when entering the game, which allows them to move directly to the temple and pass the test of G.L.E.D.Y.S. This key will not count the usage of silver or golden keys. 
The entrance to Gron-Norg and the entrance to the Temple of Dor-Tound will return to regular mode starting June 1.

Elinor's Ministry of Health is warning you:
The temple of Dor-Tound is an incredibly difficult and dangerous place, it will only be conquered by very careful and strong-minded Elinorians.

More information is available on the information portal. https://info.tmgame.ru/library/world/instances/Temple_Dor-Town/

Good luck with your challenges.

notes.title: Fair week
notes.notes:
There is once again noise and loud cheering in the city squares. Without a moment's rest from the festivities, Jar Marco and his company of helpers have arrived in Elinor! 
In addition to regular items, this month you can buy: gods' elixirs, gold tablets, bat or bloodsucker cages, ghost boxes, magic and aura changers, gladiator standards, fair candles or lampstands, and other things.
Among the rare items you'll find items to call the bosses of Elinor in limited quantities, and technomagic fashionistas will be able to purchase an antique image of their faction. 
There will also be tools of the miner available for purchase, and once a day throughout the week you can get tools for free from the town blacksmith. 

Have a good shopping experience!

notes.title: Freeing the souls of great warriors!
notes.notes:
This last spring month is being remembered by everyone for its long weekends. After a couple days have gone by and there's almost a whole week of vacation! The Headman and Elder of the towns are waiting for you to receive the "Great warriors of the past" holiday quest. After completing it, you will be asked for help for ""Victory Day Preparations"". Quests are available until the end of May 9. 
Sh'actain is waiting for you to visit on an equally important cause. After all, no one can handle the freeing of imprisoned souls better than you! 

He is ready to assist you daily in this difficult quest and will give you a small amount of the shadow dust that is necessary to free the souls when you meet him. An unlimited amount of shadow dust can be purchased from the Merchant of Dedication Island. After obtaining shadow dust, go into the Dark Vaults to meet danger and complete the quest. You'll get 1 to 5 freed souls randomly for each victory. If there is no warrior of the opposite faction, you will meet with the most insane warrior!

You can free the souls by improving the progress of the quests until the end of May 18, and receiving a reward for the quest ( note that the award is given only once during the event) is available until May 21. 
Flower counters in the town are decorated with themed gifts and festive fireworks, which will remind you of Victory Day and add to a good mood! You'll be able to purchase a bloody confrontation stone in the Crystal store in the evening with a big discount! Six stones will be available with a 40% discount starting at 20:00, and if you purchase the entire batch before 11:00 on May 6, you'll be able to re-sell another batch of stones starting at that time with a 30% discount! Stone sales will end on May 7 or with the last stone in the batch being sold.

And, of course, holiday promotions! 
From the moment of publication of this news until the end of May 5, your armor will not lose its strength when you lose in the dangerous territories of Elinor. 
On May 6, wins in the Dark Vaults in the presence of shadow dust will release twice as many imprisoned souls for the Sh'aktayn quest.
On May 7, when you visit the Headman or Elder, you will be able to choose a Denial or Omniscience effect for the day. 
On May 8, by winning battles against valiant opponents, you will receive double the number of items in the "Skills" collection. 
On May 9, when you enter the game, you will receive a master effect that doubles all points in your medal for killing an enemy with a spell, using a spell, or triggering a passive effect when killing an enemy. 

We wish you a great weekend!

notes.title: The Elinor collection
notes.notes:
Valiant Technomages! The anniversary celebration is over but we don't stop celebrating and hasten to tell you that it's time to take up the most enormous collection - The Elinor collection!

The Elinor Collection items are available to you when you gather other collections, which are gathered in the following ways.
Etalons: at spending of different types of currency: for every 100 crystals spent, 100 personalized coins, 50 skill marks, 10 gold coins, 10 medium teeth.
Tools: when making products according to recipes of the corresponding profession.
Monsters: as a reward for defeating any monster of Elinor.
Skills: in battles against matching levels of opponents of a hostile faction.
Patrons: as a reward for defeating any boss of Elinor.
Symbols: by gathering Etalons, Tools, Monsters, Skills, and Patrons collections.

You can also get collection items from the collector's chests, which will be given to you as a gift when you add more crystals to your account.
For every payment from 100 to 449 crystals you will receive an Enchanted collector's chest, for a payment from 450 to 899 crystals you will receive a Magic chest, and for every 900 crystals from the size of the payment you will receive one Heroic collector's chest. All chests contain items of various collection types, and the amount of items you receive depends on the chest type.

For gathering collections you will receive various prizes and items of "Etalons" collection, and if you gather the main collection you will get the Symbols of Elinor and items which can be found in the Festive store. This year, the collection rewards have been partially updated.

By gathering collections you will become a participant of the ranking and have the chance to win prizes twice during the event! Results will be calculated on May 10 and 17 at 8:00 during the technical works. Winning places, you will get valuable gifts and points in the medal line "Race participant".
You can get collection items and collector's chests for payments until May 17, and exchange collections and make purchases for Elinor characters no later than the end of May 21.
You can read more about the Elinor collections on a special page.

The Festive store has a wide selection of items and new items! A limited edition batch of water substances and an emerald seahorse, and by purchasing the Book of Thunder you'll be able to add a water element medal, but only if you've previously learned the spell you've chosen.

Until the end of May 7, when you win fights against skilled monsters and valiant opponents, you have a chance to get the famous Grobft family's safes. The reward in the Grobfts Iron safe has been temporarily changed - instead of the heroic finder, you get a chest with collections.

We wish you a successful extraction of collections!

notes.title: In anticipation of May 1st
notes.notes:
The Labor Day and Big Cleaning Day are coming up in Elinor soon.You can begin preparation work today, enjoying game promotions and getting everyone around you to feel good! 
The headman Zlatovan and elder Koragor are waiting for your help in gathering and presenting brooms to the citizens on the Big Cleanup. After that, you'll have to take charge in growing seedlings for Labor Day for the lovely farmers Dylan and Kragor! 
You can complete tasks until May 2 inclusive.

While helping to clean up, the town's florists decorated the counters with themed gifts that will remind you of yourself and of the holiday!

If you want to try your luck and win a gift of thalers and other items required in the amusement park, you can spin the Wheel of Fortune for a small charge in personalized coins and you will probably be the one to win one of the most valuable prizes!

Throughout the holiday weekend there are different daily promotions waiting for you: 
From the moment of publication of this news and until the end of the day you will be excited about the "Luck hour", which means that getting gold coins in loot from duels will increase to 50%! 
On April 29, defeating skilled monsters and valiant warriors, you have a chance to get regular magical storages!
On April 30, by winning in amusement park attractions, you'll get twice as many anniversary thalers! 
On May 1, using time seals, you'll get 2x the amount of signums!

We also want to inform you that the "amusement park" will be active until the end of May 1, but not as previously announced until 05:30 on 01.05.23.

notes.title: Technomagic contest and Observatory season
notes.notes:
It's the last week of April! Pretty soon headmen will be asking for help with the big clean-up, and this week you can devote to the new Observatory season and collecting gems for the Technomagic Contest! 
To participate in the Technomagic Contest ranking, you will need to get bags of gems, open it, and combine it into collections to get points for the ranking. 
You can read more about the rankings on the information portal.
https://info.tmgame.ru/library/world/rating/stone_rep/ 

For a visit to the snowy lands of the Observatory, you must find a portal near the cabin of the Hermit Stargazer. When you pass through its gate, you'll find yourself at base camp, where you can redistribute your combat spells and go to face fearsome monsters and powerful foes. Defeating enemies will earn you regular or gold lenses, ranking points, and other useful items for participating in the Observatory event.

Observatory season fights will continue until 11:30 on April 30, and the portal to base camp will be available until the end of May 3 for helping you purchase or open lens boxes. You will also receive a 40% discount on all Observatory ammo purchased with gold coins in this season.
You can read more about the Observatory here.
https://info.tmgame.ru/library/world/Observatory/ 
This season the rules of the Observatory have been changed.
https://forum.tmgame.ru/index.php?showtopic=98356 

If you purchase crystals until April 25, you'll receive a gift from Elinor Bank - one magical Hermit's chest for every 100 crystals from the payment amount! 

Have a great mood!

notes.title: Water elemental spells
notes.notes:
Brave warriors! Masters of the Order and the water guild are ready to accept their adepts and reveal the secrets of water elemental spells.
Humans can learn new spells of the water magic school from level 9. Dwarves can learn the skills of water magic. Masters Aquia and Agvator will share these spells with you.

You must have a personal grimoire to learn spells, which the Cryptographer will help you to make. If you already have a grimoire, the Cryptographer will tell you that you should put the grimoire together with a magician's fountain pen in the magic library. This will make it easy and simple to use, to write new spells into it and add to the magic belt.

Once the grimoire is in the magic library, the masters will share with you the details of learning water elemental spells. After that, those who previously studied ice spells will be able to use it in any area.
Attention: Now the ice spells you learned are only available in the Grimoire of elemental magic. Ice spells will also be studied only in the grimoire in the magic library.

One of the spells available to learn from the school of water magic is the "Blind Luck" spell, also available to water magic crystal owners. Therefore, sturdy crystals of water and fire magic can be exchanged at any time for the water substance that you need to learn water magic spells.

You'll also be able to purchase rare items until April 20: 
- In the Crystal store you will find cobalt pickaxes ( you can get a small amount in the trading store in exchange for universal coins) and the life-giving ichor. 
- You can buy artifact blanks and blue crystals in the Rarity store.

Enjoy a successful learning of your new spells!

notes.title: Amusement park
notes.notes:
Warriors! Our celebration is still going on and we're excited to announce the opening of the amusement park! 
You'll have to talk to Marcus, who will tell you about the rules of earning anniversary thalers and will give you a small daily pack of tokens to participate in the games of the amusement park. You can also get tokens for completing quests or purchase an unlimited amount for personalized coins in the shop of the park with other elixirs to accelerate you passing through the rides.

The following games will be available at the amusement park:

Puzzle by the Blind Largus is an intriguing battle on a 10x10 stone field. 
Cost of participation is 1 token.
Reward is 1-2 tokens. 

Classical duel is a fight with combat magic and all different kinds of ammunition against the Jumping clown. His powers will increase when you win, and this Jumping clown returns to his original state at midnight. 
Participation cost is 1 token.
Reward - from 1 to 10 wins per day - 1 thaler, 
11-20 wins per day - 2 thalers, 
21 to 30 wins per day - 3 thalers, 
31 to 40 victories per day - 4 thalers 
41 wins per day - 5 thalers. 
Celebration tournament is a duel with equal parameters and magic for all.
Participation cost is 1 token.
Reward is 4 thalers.

While entertaining in the games you become a ranking participant, which will be held in two rounds with summarizing on April 24 and May 1 at 5:30 and receiving rare items for prizes, but not included in the " Race Participant" medal line.

You can earn the amusement park regular achievement and be rewarded with anniversary thalers. 
You can participate in amusement rides until 5:30 on May 1 and spend your anniversary thalers in the prizes store by the end of May 2.

You'll find a new item in the assortment, the magician's mask, which will give you a bonus to gathering each color of gems and skulls on the field.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41575789/2921ab8422b453e3c19014d85a7acc81bade7650.png[/img]
Elinor Bank will give a present! When you add funds to your character's account on April 17 and 18, you will receive one Rune of allowance for every 500 crystals of one payment! When you open a rune, you have a chance to get a stone of weakening or 5000 crystals.

Have a fun time!

notes.title: It's our 15th birthday!!!
notes.notes:
Glorious Elinorians! It seems that only a few days have passed, but in fact the world of Techno magic is 15 years old already!
 
We invite you to share the great mood with us and continue to unlock the "Holiday mood", " Celebration of anniversary" and " Celebratory fireworks" achievements line. That last one got an opportunity to get the achievement "II" this year. To unlock the achievements, join in the effort of town decorating, use festive projectiles, and present your collectible coin prints of the fifteenth anniversary to the town's jeweler. You can get festive projectiles in the Reward box and Celebration chest XV.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41575789/b33d13e2f9488a523ba135cf9671e716156df1c8.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41575789/64590983cc7e3942e96ae687bd1bc6bc91df0de0.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41575789/db40b532fd98eaae41732ada26d2059800c8db9a.png[/img]
If you visit Zlatovan or Koragor, you'll get a birthday chest and the opportunity to run the "Honor and respect" and "Holiday troubles" quests. Iria and Koragor are waiting for you to assist in baking the best cake ever, which no birthday can be imagined without! 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41575789/907e8d9308262b08db397f6eca86e38f34c3250d.png[/img]
If you defeat experienced monsters, you can get 15c, 15s and 15g collectible coins up to April 20th.
You can get a birthday chest, complete the "Honor and respect" and ""Holiday troubles" quests and take the "Best cake" quest until the end of April, and you can bake and get a piece of cake by June 30th.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41575789/e0b5dd11ce46b6133288a6f93a7d8041deebeab4.png[/img] [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41575789/de7ddd1e1ef8b575c787c66b61032ec0f273867e.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41575789/1b4ba6255b458c9f75f7a738d14ef248fb6bbae9.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41575789/6ba19cae0635bd14ca87fcc64a32fda1eadc0d65.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41575789/b5d911be4437d4e9af49240fc4c1ea6d978d887f.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41575789/0f4d7001ab22186a59561eec4addc16b61c91191.png[/img]
In the rush to prepare Elinor for the birthday celebrations, the citizens of Longholm and Khatog have lost some holiday attributes in different places around the world. Whoever finds all the holiday attributes that were lost on the current day will get a small gift.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41575789/da2831e1772652f9709cd6b0e89d47b2a43bcf2e.gif[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41575789/da2831e1772652f9709cd6b0e89d47b2a43bcf2e.gif[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41575789/da2831e1772652f9709cd6b0e89d47b2a43bcf2e.gif[/img]
As it happens, the date of the anniversary celebration coincided with an equally great holiday. We invite all technomagicians to visit Barfos or Nagor and join in the " Sins atonement" and simple daily quests until April 16th, and you will receive golden Technomagic eggs with pleasant gifts!
You may use colored painted eggs and Power eggs in combat until the end of May. Eggs are obtained by successfully combining a set of colored painted eggs and a scroll of power.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41575789/2d9cf6c33431ad6bd9d8567ffaba9b82ee78dcae.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41575789/cdadab545c5a78d4b29557f65f63c9c06b33d099.png[/img]
During the week, you'll find daily specials on a different kind of items and services! Log into the game each day to find out about the discounts for that day, and today you'll get a 20% off on ingredients and tools in the towns' stores. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41575789/da2831e1772652f9709cd6b0e89d47b2a43bcf2e.gif[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41575789/da2831e1772652f9709cd6b0e89d47b2a43bcf2e.gif[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41575789/da2831e1772652f9709cd6b0e89d47b2a43bcf2e.gif[/img]
And, of course, holiday specials! 
From the moment this news was published until the end of the day in all rewards you will receive 50% more gold coins. 
On April 15th, your armor will not lose strength when hit in dangerous territories. 
And on April 16th you'll get the effect of Denial, which allows you to get no experience for duels, or Omniscience, which triples the experience for fights.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41575789/da2831e1772652f9709cd6b0e89d47b2a43bcf2e.gif[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41575789/da2831e1772652f9709cd6b0e89d47b2a43bcf2e.gif[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41575789/da2831e1772652f9709cd6b0e89d47b2a43bcf2e.gif[/img]
Florists in town will offer gifts and clappers for celebrations and more. The Crystal store offers the Barrels of Denial. If you use a Barrel of Denial, your character will be denied experience in all fights for one week. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41575789/b21ae1a9d6bd7f0d32111cb577ae0fa747d010ab.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41575789/c21329a1c057159649eeb46ddd269bb25c6e4d67.gif[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41575789/56a728948778a69069dc0117d0965bc323e0c3a4.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41575789/69711a0dcc6e9c7280e8573a2388bd69f1c5dfbc.gif[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41575789/60bc509cdeff57146c65dfafb8d7aecc470faab8.png[/img]
The Amusement park will open its doors for new adventures on Monday!

Enjoy the festive spirit!

notes.title: The arrival of Yar Marco or again in the sky!
notes.notes:
It's April 12th on the calendar! This day we remember the heroes of Elinor who conquered the skies for the first time! On hearing of this, Jar Marco decided not to delay his visit and arrived on time!
After visiting Torador or Donovan, all technomages from level 5 can listen to stories about old times and go to find parts for the restoration of an ancient flying machine. Only after you've completed this quest you may go to find the Talker Bird! Tasks are available until the end of Sunday.

You can buy original holiday gifts on town florists' counters. And near Yar Marco you can see an equally noble trader called Torgob!

In addition "Beautiful soul impulse" Yar Marco is happy to offer you money tree leaves, crystal and gold money pots, boxes of darkness and light and Pandora, leader chests, a variety of monster avatars of the technomagic world, jewelry of hostility and much more!

Some of your purchases will bring you profits this week! During Fair Week, each personalized coin that you spend will earn a 10% bonus on your spending. Personalized coins will be sent to you on April 19th morning.

We wish you a lucky conquest of the skies!

notes.title: Monday News
notes.notes:
Valiant technomagicians! It's a new week in Elinor, and there are only a few days remaining until the Anniversary of the technomagic world. We invite you to spend this time in gladiatorial fights, reporting for the techno-warrior's chests and earning bonuses from the Elinor Bank!

During the week you will have to fight valiant opponents or furious spirits in the Colosseum. If you defeat them you will be rewarded with gladiator coins and participate in the ranking. In this ranking you will receive points in the "Race Participant" medal line in addition to the prizes. 
The results will be posted at 5:30 on April 17th.

The Hive Expedition Commanders and the Guardians of Knowledge are waiting for your reports on the completion of their daily quests until April 24th. If you collect 10 reports of the same type, you can get a techno-warrior's chest with rare ammunition. 

The Hive Expedition Commanders and the Guardians of Knowledge are waiting for your reports on the completion of their daily quests until April 24th. If you collect 10 reports of the same type, you can get a techno-warrior's chest with rare ammunition. 
For completing quests in the Hive (Banishment of many-legged, Disposal of winged, Supply replenishment, Destruction of clutches, Following in Grobfts footsteps, Elimination of competitors) you can get a Commander's Report. In the Temple of the Ancients (Measuring the magfield and Tag extraction) - Guardian report.
Elinor Bank is waiting for your deposits and provides gifts until the end of April 12th! For every 500 crystals of one payment you will receive 1 lottery ticket of draw #7!
By opening the ticket you can get: a hero's certificate, a special locked chest (wood, bone, copper, bronze, steel, obsidian, cobalt), hero's spirit or 100 crystals!

Have a great day!

notes.title: Talisman magic and more
notes.notes:
Glorious technomages! In the coming days you will receive an increase of magical powers. That means it's time to enhance your talismans with storages of magic! 

Till the end of April 8th there will be available assignments, for the completion of which you will be rewarded with normal storages of magic and chests with 20 storages of a random color from normal to legendary. This will be available to technomages who have reached level 7 or higher and have completed the "Talismans of Power" quest.
Read more about the "Magic talismans" event on the information portal.
If you defeat a valiant opponent, you have a chance to win a lucky ticket until April 11. You can open your tickets and receive one of the prizes: gold nuggets, ghostly signum, bonus to your valor for 24 hours, winner's standard bonus, monster stone for one year, or a certificate for a unique bag. There are also an unlimited quantity of tickets for sale in the Rarity store for gold coins.
Gold nuggets are used to assemble one of the statuettes of the golden swan.The Golden Swan statuette will give you a random 5%, 10%, or 15% increase in one of your pairs of characteristics once every 24 hours for 30 days.
You will find the "Conversion signs" for getting different quality resin from Yar Marco's stones on the Crystal store counters. The signs are available in limited quantities until the end of April 5.

Enjoy it! Have fun!

notes.title: April Fool's Day
notes.notes:
Since long ago, the citizens of Elinor have been known not only for their courage and bravery, but also for their ability to make great jokes on old friends! 
The best time to do it is April 1st, the day set aside for jokes! 
Visit the citizens and face the consequences of an Evil Joke, grow Miracle Flower and Spring Vegetables, and find out what the price of Forever Friendship is!
Holiday quests are available until the end of April 6th.
You will be treated to the splendor of a festive carnival, where you can get elegant masks of different colors and get Smiling coins for its collection, which you can spend in the Rarity store! 
You can get masks in the following ways:
You can get the black mask from the burglar's chest with a chance.
A gold mask is available by winning the game ""Sage box"" (the number of masks depends on the level of the box).
A purple mask with a chance can be received by defeating any monsters of dangerous territories.
You can find the Blue Mask in trophies from valiant opponents. 
Gathering the mask collection involves participation in a ranking, for which prizes are awarded Smiling coins and points in the " Race Participant" medal line. 
Rankings will be summed up on April 5 at 8:00, and mask obtaining, collecting, and spending Smiling coins will be available until the end of April 6th.
Fans of fair fights will enjoy the Tournament of equals! 
If you have a ticket and a suitable opponent, you'll be invited to join the tournament. If you have a ticket and a suitable opponent, you will have a fair fight! You can get 10 tickets to the tournament every day at the entrance to the game or you can buy it along with concentrates of power and gems in the Rarity store. 
Wins in fights will bring you points to your "Fighter" ranking and blue jester's masks.
The tournament is open until 23:59 on April 2nd.

Town florists offer fun gifts for friends to suit all tastes! 
On the Crystal store counters you will find: diamond spinel shards, malachite and sodalite powders in limited quantities, and certificates for changing levels and sets of certificates with a small discount in unlimited quantities.

[i]Have a fun weekend![/i]

notes.title: Technomagic contest and Observatory season
notes.notes:
Glorious warriors! The upcoming week will open the portal to the snowy places of the Observatory and bring the opportunity to participate in gathering precious collections for the Technomagic Contest!
You can find the portal to the base camp near The hermit stargazer's home, and elinorians of level 6 and higher can pass through its gates. On the territory of Observatory you will have exciting duels with creepy monsters and fierce opponents, as a reward you will receive various lenses necessary to buy items in the tent and the hermit's store.You can visit the Observatory area until 23:30 on April 2nd, and use the portal to the base camp to purchase or open lens boxes until the end of April 5th. 
Read about the Observatory rules [url=https://info.tmgame.ru/library/world/Observatory/]here[/url].

Technomagicians who want to participate in the competition need to go to gather pouches of gemstones. 
You can get the bags in the following ways:
