Gray Bags are scattered all over the world in secret chests and at midnight their location will change. But if you've found all the chests and you want to search for more, buy a special map at the Crystal store and go on your way!
Green pouches can be obtained by defeating the bosses of safe territories (Quartz valley, Shion forest, wild islands, etc.).
Blue pouches can be obtained from the trophies of distraught warriors. 
Orange pouches - you can get them as a reward from the bosses of dangerous territories.
Red pouches - obtained with a chance by opening C.H.E.S.T.s.
Opening the pouches, getting gems and combining them into collections you will receive points in the Technomagic contest ranking (does not count in the medal line "Race participant") and a gladiator's coin. You'll receive prize tokens when the rating results are tallied on April 3rd at 5:30. 
Spend your tokens in the Supply Center on rare items.
For more information on the race rules, click [url=https://info.tmgame.ru/library/world/rating/stone_rep/ ]here[/url].

[i]Have a good one![/i]

notes.title: News of Elinor
notes.notes:
New week has begun, and that means it's time to go on new quests and battle the fierce boss Caretaker, whose trophies have been changed.
All Elinorians of level 8 and higher are invited to sign contracts for covert assignments! You can see the available contracts on the notice board, which is located near the central city square. All contracts are one-time and available from different levels: 
[list]
[*] from level 8 you can get a contract from Kimihla or Valian.
[*] from level 9 you can take a contract from Melchor or Zales
[*] from level 10 you can take a contract from Dharon or Gordon.
[*] from level 12 you can take a contract from Nagor or Barfos. 
[/list]
All contracts are secret and disclosure of its purposes is forbidden!

Some changes have been made to the Caretaker boss.
You need a horn plate to get the phase transition generator, this resource is extracted from the monster named Bonehead .
Boss trophies are now shared between team members and the player who dealt the most damage. Each team member will receive trophies in accordance with the proportion of damage dealt: gold, all kinds of beads, normal signums of the Ancients, petrified gold tablets. Also, each player may receive a fullerite heart with a chance.  Each player who deals the most damage is guaranteed to receive a fullerite heart, epic purification elixirs, and with a chance one of the fortune scrolls.


We have added the ability to purchase fullerite frames for personalized coins or in exchange for fullerite hearts to the Supply center. 

[i]Have a productive week![/i]

notes.title: Hearts of the mines
notes.notes:
Glorious warriors of Elinor! Welcome to a new adventure of mining the hearts of the mines and its shards, and exchanging these hearts for rare inlaid stones to enhance your equipment!
You can complete various quests throughout the event, and receiving a hearts of the mines as a reward, boxes with these hearts, or shards of it:

You will receive hearts of the mines for the "Hunter of Darkwood" quest, available from level 8 which is completed once, for the daily quests "Crystal Fever" and " Fortunate Investment" (spending crystals), available from level 6.
For the quests " Grimbold's fortress regular", available from level 8, and " Tower of Despair regular", available from level 10 which is completed once, as well as for the daily quests " Fortunate investment " (spending gold), " Dungeon warrior" and "Fearless hunter", available to characters from level 6, you will receive boxes with the hearts of the mines.
You will receive Heart of the mines shards for the " Wild hunter " quest, available from level 6.
Attention! When you complete the Quest " Fortunate investment " make sure that the costs are in the list of quests, or check whether the planned costs will be counted. 
You can read more about the available quests and rewards for completing those quests in the quest journal.

When you open the boxes with hearts, you get a whole heart of the mines or some quantity of its shards. With magic glue or magic superglue, every 100 pieces of hearts of the mines are assembled into a whole heart.
You additionally have a chance to get the heart of the mines boxes by trying your fortune in the Wheel of fortune.
Now you can use the jeweler's toolkit from the Supply center to disassemble any stones from Yar Marco and get several hearts and a huge quantity of its shards.

You can exchange the hearts of the mines for inlaid stones in the Supply center. The assortment has been slightly changed this season. 
The following stones have been removed from the counters: master and hunter adamas, arZebirmite, Zetheriz and arZermite.

The stones such as adamas of darkness, adamas of abundance, and adamas of fortune have been changed to qualitative stones with the same name and enhanced! When any of these stones are inlaid, the equipment item becomes non transferable!

Qualitative adamas of darkness will increase the chance of any patron-mihrytka being triggered by 7%, instead of 5%.
Qualitative adamas of abundance will increase the chance of dropping resources from monsters by 70% instead of 50%. 
Qualitative adamas of fortune will permanently increase the amount of money earned in a fight by 6%, instead of 5%. 
Normal adamas of darkness, abundance and fortune can be exchanged for qualitative adamas with a payment in the hearts of the mines.

Quest completion is available until 25.03.2023. You can collect shards in the hearts of еру mines and purchase stones until the end of March. 

[i]Have a good time![/i]

notes.title: It is spring in Elinor
notes.notes:
The first day of spring is on the calendar! Elinorian healer and alchemist have decided to celebrate the day by resuming lessons in ether purification. Those technomagicians who prefer valiant combat and successful hunting are rewarded with individual chests, while the young residents who don't want to grow older now have elixirs of negation. And it's all available until the end of the week!

When you visit Valian and Kimihla, you will learn how to purify the ether necessary for the undiscovered recipe for immortality, and therefore for each portion of the luminous substance you will be rewarded generously!

In purifying ether, aqua-ionite will be needed, which can be obtained:
[list]
[*] by small daily portions from the alchemist or healer, as well as by finding it in the Soli-Dor wells and exchanging it for universal coins from the cryptographer;
[*] If the retort is in the inventory from experienced monsters of dangerous territories. You can buy a retort from a merchant near the Colosseum;
[*] in unlimited quantities at the Artifact store.
[/list]
After purification, you can begin purifying the dark ether again by purchasing it at the Rarity store for personalized coins.

After purification, you can begin purifying the dark ether again by purchasing it in the Rarity store for personalized coins.

You can complete quests, get aqua-ionite, and purchase dark ether until the end of March 5, and you can receive a reward or continue your ether purification experiment at any time.

While fighting valiant warriors and creepy monsters you have a chance to get additional reward - regular or heroic personal chests! There is a limited number of chests from inexperienced monsters, and any number from experienced monsters. Also, there are unlimited quantities of heroic chests for sale in the Rarity store.

No special efforts are required to open a trophy and get the treasure! Normal personal chests can be opened with a simple click, but for a heroic chest, you need to spend some personalized coins to open it and then you'll have a chance to get a certificate to change your character level or get an individual seal!

The Crystal store is also stocked with enchanted elixirs of negation! This elixir will reduce your character's current experience by 100 units. Moreover, if you defeat valiant opponents, you can also get a normal elixir of negation, which will reduce your character's experience by 25 units.

[i]Congratulations on the spring![/i]

notes.title: Defender of Elinor's Day
notes.notes:
Glorious Technomagicians! The Motherland Defender's Day is coming and the Elinor world is ready for festive quests, promotions, and other fun activities!
Ghaslan and Nadum are waiting for helpers to increase their equipment collection. They will ask you to go to the "Glorious combat traditions" quest.
After completing it, the next quest "Stolen relics" will become available, and its completion will unlock the "'Protector" achievement, a line of which is extended this year as well! 
You can purchase the attributes necessary to complete the quests from the merchants near the Colosseum. 
Hurry and complete your quests and earn the "Protector V" achievement before the end of the year on February 26.
As it happens, Sh'aktain, the servant of darkness, is thinking of freeing himself from the spell of the Dark Lord during the pre-holiday season and encourages everyone to participate in the "Saved souls" event! 
To participate in the liberation of souls, you must have shadow dust, which can be obtained three pieces daily for the duration of the event from Sh'aktain or in unlimited quantities from the merchant on the Island of initiation. Next, you will need to visit the Dark Vaults and take wins there, earning 1 to 5 souls for each win with the removal of shadow dust for each win. 
You can read more about the quest in your journal. You can free the imprisoned souls until the end of March 7, and receive your reward no later than the end of March 10.
But that's not all! Hilgor and Virkley have decided to get your attention by resuming their search for ancient mechanisms! Antiquities connoisseurs will offer you 1 of 5 randomly chosen quests, which you will be able to cancel with " Notes on the Ancients ", after which you will have access to the quest on common terms again. Also, for a charge, you can remove the quest timer, the cost of removal increases each time, but is reset at midnight.For completing quests you will receive Ancient tokens and Grimbold's coins, which you can spend in the Supply center on items that can be used to unlock various medals and achievements. The "Shadow Warrior" and " Servant of the Ancients" medal lines were recently updated, and you can purchase the " Memories of Heroes" item to unlock these.
The "Mechanisms of the Ancients" event quests are available until March 3, and the completion of the quests and purchase of items in the Supply center are available until the end of March 5.

The world of Elinor is decorated for the holidays!
The city florists are happy to offer gifts for brave defenders, including the clapper "Holiday Grenade"! You can see themed rocks on the field in the fights, and among the smiles are tanks and more!

There will be daily promotions throughout Elinor during the holidays:
[list]
[*] On February 23, everyone will be able to visit the "Landing" without an obsidian pay or an order to attack.
[*] On February 24, all day long, your armor will not lose strength when you are defeated.
[*] On February 25, all victories in the Dark Vaults with shadow dust will bring twice as many freed souls to the mission.
[*] February 26 all day you will not leave the effect of the master's potion, which gives double the points received in combat medals ( effect is issued at logging into the game, summed with other similar effects).
[/list]
More gifts from Elinor Bank! If you purchase crystals before the end of February 26, for every 300 units of the amount of one payment you will receive one chest of the ancients, which contains items to simplify the completion of the quest "Mechanisms of the Ancients"!

And finally about the new thing! Technomagic world has an opportunity to get and strengthen the images of the "Black Knight" and "Bounty Hunter"! 
You can get the image only after reaching level 9 and in exchange for a complete set of similar armor and weapons from the Hermit stargazer, or buy gold lenses of the Observatory in his store. When you exchange the sets of  runes and stones in the items will be removed with no return! 
By strengthening your image with the gold lenses of the Observatory, you will increase your "Armor" and "Base Damage" characteristics!

[i]Congratulations to you, Defenders![/i]

notes.title: It's Maslenitsa!
notes.notes:
Maslenitsa is a time of celebration for cooking! A whole week of cooking crepes with different toppings, and at the end of the celebration - mass scarecrow burning and climbing the pillar for prizes! 
Maslenitsa beginning always heralds a tasty ranking! You'll have to get involved in making crepes, and the most eager cooks will be rewarded with a keg or flasks of denial! 
You'll need mix and toppings to bake the crepes, which are sourced from the monsters in all of the lands in Elinor:
- spider cuttings from adult spiders, dark spider, and arachnids, 
- creepy mushrooms from ancient skeletons, zombies, miners, coal miners and gravediggers.
Obtained ingredients need to be mixed with elixirs of strength or hardness and the crepe topping is ready! 
All ingredients for making crepes are also sold by the Merchant near the Colosseum.
By eating the crepe with a meat topping you will increase the base damage, and with a mushroom topping you will increase your character's armor.
Anyone wishing to receive the Maslenitsa box will have to build and burn a scarecrow themselves in anticipation of spring, the base for a scarecrow being located near Dylan's farm and at the Khatog gate in the Quartz valley! 
You will need: 
[list]
[*] straw is contained in the rewards from monsters of all Elinor;
[*] fabric scraps can be obtained by defeating skilled bosses and valiant enemies;
[*] colored strips can be purchased from merchant near the Colosseum;
[*] fuel is made from various elixirs. Canisters are sold by the Colosseum merchant;
[*] matches are obtained from monsters of the underground places of Elinor. 
[/list]
When you have collected everything you need, you can go to the end of the ritual!
From February the 24th, near the Maslenitsa Scarecrow stand you will find a pillar, if you climb it you can get one of the prizes: a box with jewelry and 50 ancient tokens, holiday gifts in character info, glittering shards, gladiator coins, crepes, fortune token, combat boots, fruit leaf of money tree, 500 crystals pouch. 
You may try your luck every 12 hours or whenever you have a sun token from the crystal store, which is required for each try.
You are always very welcome in the city taverns and they want to ask for your help in delivering the festive meal to the honorable townsfolk. 

[i]Happy Maslenitsa![/i]

notes.title: Brand new medals in Elinor
notes.notes:
Glorious warriors! Since ancient times there have been weapons and amulets available only on the Island of Initiation, as well as the Medals of the Shadow Warrior and the Servant of Ancients. But a special time has come and these medals have evolved into a medal line.
The Shadow warrior and Servant of ancients medals have been changed! 
The existing Shadow warrior medal has been split into two lines and the 20 Initiative points earned have been replaced with 2 points of basic damage.

Characters of level 20 and higher will win with a sword or shadow hammer on the Island of Dedication with a multiplier of 3 in the "Shadow warrior" medal line. "Shadow sword", "Shadow hammer" and "Ancient amulet" equipment items are divided into two level categories: for level 6-10 (junior weapon and amulet) and for level 11 and higher. Weapon and amulet parameters are increased, their effectiveness corresponds to the effectiveness of similar items of the corresponding level. 
From today, players of level 11 and higher on the Island of Initiation will receive enhanced items of equipment.
During the weekend, the Tournament of equals is waiting for you! 
Tournament of equals is a no-advantage fight for everyone of level 6 and higher, with equal characteristics, without regard to faction, medals, equipment and levels! To participate in the tournament you need to leave your application in the logbook in the Academy square and if you have a special ticket wait for an opponent to appear, with which you will try your hand! 

You will receive 10 tickets each day when you enter the game to participate in the Tournament of equals, and additional tickets and ammunition that you need for fights can be found in the Rarities store. 
If you win you will be rewarded with 2 to 4 ruby hearts and 1 point to your personal Fighter ranking. 
The tournament will run until the end of February 19th. 

[i]Have a great weekend![/i]

notes.title: CatAmour visiting the Elinorians
notes.notes:
Reminding the Elinor citizens that Valentine's Day is coming, CatAmour came and indulged in memories. He decided to remind everyone where it all began...
Juno's quests become available for technomagicians of level 5 and higher, who have not previously completed the quest chain "Cursed Love", where you will learn about the mystery of Romerio and Juletine, and that for true love there are no obstacles and prohibitions in the world! Also available are "Lovers' Cares" "Gifts for Lovers," " Stolen Love" if those haven't been done before, and Bruno's new quest "The Mysterious Bouquet". 
You will be greeted in the town square by CatAmour after completing the "Cursed Love" quest, and he will offer you daily quests, which he will give you ruby coins to buy rare items in his store. 
Oh, and, of course, there's a "Love Week" ranking waiting for you!
To participate in the ranking you need to send love signs in the form of Valentine's cards to the opposite player! How to get Valentine's cards?
The first way to get Valentine's cards is to combine one magic parchment, one scorp poison and one heart. Magic parchment is sold in the city store, scorp's poison is obtained from scorps, and the heart can be found in trophies from any monsters with a chance and is guaranteed when you defeat valiant warriors: three hearts in the Dark Vaults, two in the Coliseum and one in the other battle areas. 
The second way is to take a recipe from Iria or Ungor, and, following the instructions, prepare from the culinary mixture and selected ingredients a heart cake, which is exchanged for valentines.

Ranking participation is available until 5:30 on February 20th, 2023 and will be counted in the "Race participant" medal line. 
Quest completion is available until 23:59 on February 19, 2023.
You may purchase items in CatAmour's store until the end of February 21, 2023.

Elinor Bank congratulates everyone on Valentine's Day and gives presents! Until the end of February 19th, by purchasing crystals you'll receive ruby coins equivalent to the bonus of personalized coins. 

City florists remembered to decorate their counters with themed gifts that will be enjoyed by even the most sophisticated connoisseurs of love!

Elinor Bank congratulates everyone on Valentine's Day and gives presents! Until the end of February 19th, by purchasing crystals you'll receive ruby coins equivalent to the bonus of personalized coins. 

City florists remembered to decorate their counters with themed gifts that will be enjoyed by even the most sophisticated connoisseurs of love!

You may find the Thunder Book among the items in CatAmour's store, where the spell pages "Ice Arrow II" and "White Blade II" have been added, which are available to those who have begun to learn these spells to earn points in the " Ice power" medal line. 

[i]Fall in love and be loved![/i]

notes.title: Yar Marco's arrival
notes.notes:
The noise in the squares of Elinor reminded of the arrival of Yar Marco and his entourage. During the week you will be able to purchase outlandish goods from overseas merchant and enjoy it!
This month's fair offers: elixirs of purification and small vials of negation, discounted water and earth totems, storage boxes, boxes of pandora, hero spirit and gloves of darkwood, Grobft treasure maps, gladiator's standard, discounted elemental weapons and stones to improve it, harpies and avatars of snowmen.
Until the end of the fair, you can buy the achievements of the path of shadows and the path of a light-bearer or an anti-dark fighter. 

[i]We wish you a great shopping experience![/i]

notes.title: Calligraphy lessons
notes.notes:
Glorious technomages! Cryptographers of the city have set time in their schedule to teach everyone calligraphy lessons, and predatory monsters have stolen a batch of Grobft safes, and now skilled hunters can try to find safes and find a useful reward!

Until the end of February 5th, technomages of level 5 or higher will receive various quests when they enter the game and will be rewarded with normal ink and ink barrels! 
With 100 inks of one color, skilled hands will draw one random symbol that increases a player's characteristics. Each symbol can only be applied once. You can exchange an already known symbol for a missing one of a higher color, or replace one color of ink with another, more necessary one, in the cryptographer's store.

Skilled hunters and brave warriors await Grobft safes that have mysteriously ended up in a monster's clutches and in the hands of a hostile faction. Fight experienced monsters and valiant enemies, search carefully for trophies from them and, if you're lucky, you'll be the owner of an iron, gold or onyx safe containing a variety of treasures. Safes can be found until the end of this week.
[i]
We wish you successful lessons and great prizes![/i]

notes.title: Talismans of Magic and the Tournament of Equals
notes.notes:
Brave warriors have no time to rest! Until the end of the week, new entertainment awaits you and the opportunity to receive useful items to strengthen yourself.
All techno-mages who complete the Talismans of Power quest will be able to receive and complete quests that will reward them with regular Magic Tanks and chests. Each chest can drop 20 Magic Tanks of a random color from Normal to Legendary.
In addition to completing tasks, items to enhance the talismans of magic can be obtained by launching the Wheel of Fortune. For a small fee, you will be rewarded with magic accumulators, chests with various accumulators, and more.
The “Magic of Talismans” event will last until the end of January 22, and you will find more detailed information about it on the information portal.

Until January 22, inclusive, Eleanors can take part in the Equals tournament to measure their strength with other warriors and receive particles of eternal ice as a reward. The conditions for participation in the tournament are as follows:
1) It is necessary to sign up in a special magazine on the Academy Square.
2) For each fight, you must have at least one ticket with you. 10 can be obtained daily when you log into the game, and an unlimited amount is sold for nominal coins in the rarity shop along with other useful tournament ammo.
3) All fights are held on equal terms, with equal parameters and spells.
4) Having won, you will receive a reward: 1-3 particles of eternal ice and 1 point in the personal rating “Fighter”.

notes.notes:

notes.title: Happy New Year and Merry Christmas!
notes.notes:
Glorious technomagicians! There's not much time left until the end of the year, and surely everyone is already busy preparing special dishes and creating a new year atmosphere in anticipation of the holiday. Now it's time for us to go home to celebrate the holidays with our family and friends. 
We wish you happy upcoming holidays! We wish the new year brought a sea of new achievements, love, health, wealth and smiles on the faces of your families and friends. Of course, we wish you a lot of drops of loot, valiant victories and new achievements! 

For the Holiday season, you'll find daily discounts on various items, which you can find out about directly in the game by moving your mouse cursor over the promo icon on the right side of the game window, and daily promotions:

notes.title: The last round of the Observatory and the Technomagic Contest of the year
notes.notes:
Brave Elinorians! The month has passed quickly and the next season of the Observatory and the Technomagic Contest ranking has started! To join the Technomagic Contest, you must get pouches with colored gems and combine them into collections to earn ranking points. The reward is prize tokens.
You can get pouches in the following ways:
The gray ones are found in secret chests all over the world. Regardless of your process, the location of the chests changes at midnight. If you have found all the chests and you want to resume your search, you must purchase a special card from the crystal store.
Green pouches can be found by defeating the bosses of safe areas (Quartz valley, Shion forest, Wild islands, etc.).
Blue pouches can be found by defeating mad warriors, and orange pouches can be found by defeating bosses in dangerous lands.
Red pouches can be found by opening С.H.E.S.T.s.

You will be rewarded for your collection of gems: points toward the Technomagic contest ranking (not counted toward the Race participant medal) and a gladiator coin. After scoring the rankings on December 26 at 5:30 you will receive prize tokens that you can spend on rare items in the Supply center.
You can read more about the Technomagic contest on the information portal.

You must reach at least level 6 to participate in the Observatory season and use the portal near the Hermit house to move to the base camp of the snow world, where you will dive into intriguing duels for taking possession and delivering the Sphere to your territory.
For defeating formidable monsters and brave enemies, you will be rewarded with gold lenses, which can be spent at the Hermit Stargazer's store.

The season of the Observatory runs until 23:30 on December 25, and until the end of December 28, you can move to base camp where you can buy and open lens boxes.

Joining the "Technomagic Contest", Elinor Bank is offering a gift! Until December 21 inclusive, for every 300 crystals of the one payment amount you will get 2 purple pouches with gems.

[i]Good luck in the contest![/i]

notes.title: The Tournament of Equals and new medals
notes.notes:
Till December 18th all technomagicians of level 5 and higher can participate in the Tournament of Equals, and will receive a reward for winning 1-3 particles of eternal ice and points in the personal ranking "Triumph". 
There is rules of participation:
[olist]
[*] You must register in the journal in the Academy Square to participate in the tournament.
[*] Each participation in the match requires one ticket. Every day at the entrance to the game there will be 10 tickets available, an unlimited number can be purchased for coins in the Rarity store.
[*] Fights are held under equal conditions - all participants get equal parameters and the same spells.
[*] Only power concentrates and gems that can be found in the Rarity store can be used as ammunition in the battle.
[*] In case of victory you get from 1 to 3 particles of eternal ice and one point in the personal ranking "Fighter".
[/olist]
Several new medals have been added. The line of medals for the use of spells "Confrontation II" and "Explosion II" was extended. Medals of this line can be purchased in a special character section. Levels that are required for activation: 18, 21 и 24.

For those who like to test their fortune in the wheel of Fortune a line of medals "Irredeemable gambler" is now available. The necessary requirements for obtaining medals are rotation of the wheel of fortune for crystals and fortune tokens. Rotations for daily fortune tokens ( handed out when you enter the game once a day) count towards the rotation of the wheel of fortune for tokens. The daily fortune token is deleted at midnight. Medals of this line cannot be purchased.
For adepts of ice magic there is a line of medals " Ice power", which can be obtained for the use in combat spells "Ice cloak II" in humans and "Ice igloo II" in dwarves. Medals of this line cannot be purchased at this time.
The effects of "Ice cloak" and " Ice igloo" spells have been greatly enhanced. 

[u]Note: On Monday, December 19th, the next season of the Observatory and the Technomagician contest will begin.[/u]

[i]Have a great weekend![/i]

notes.title: New Year's Eve Fair
notes.notes:
The square, as always these days, is full of people waiting for the arrival of an overseas merchant with useful and rare goods, especially on the New Year' s eve!
Among Yar Marco's goods you'll find barrels of purification elixirs of all levels, lockpicks, keys and locks, hunter, wizard,projectile thrower and alchemist potions, various auras relayers  at discount prices, fair candles and lamps, and that's not all!
You'll also be able to find items designed for this time of year: avatars of snowmen and a mysterious animal, staff and bag of Santa Claus, shards of ice crystal, and much more!
Available among the rare items are a limited number of Elinor boss summonses and an empty valiant token!
During the week, the smith is ready to give you daily miner's tools of your choice, and unlimited tools are available at the fairgrounds counters.
And that's not all! Hurry up and take advantage of Yar Marco's great investment offer and buy the leaves of the money tree, bearing fruit with personalized coins once in a month.
Besides all the abundance of goods, you will see the Fountain of fortune in the squares of Longholm and Khatog before the end of Sunday. Throw a gold coin into it and you will receive one of the following rewards: 2 diamond shards, 2 weakening chain links, quality or superior essence, lump of silver, gold or platinum clay, anabest, diamond barrier by level, gold plate, death totem, one of the pennant components by level, one of the rare gifts, 10 blade shards, life or hatred fragments.
You can buy "New Year's mood", "Weapon of cold" and "Art of protection" with a 20% discount in the "Medals" section.

[i]Have a nice shopping trip![/i]

notes.title: Approaching the New Year
notes.notes:
With the onset of winter, we begin to feel the approach of the time of magic, gifts and, of course, a beautifully decorated Christmas tree. All of us, and not only children, but also adults, are looking forward to the New Year. So let's not delay and start decorating fluffy Christmas trees right now!

To create beautiful Christmas trees, you need to get festive attributes:
[list]

notes.title: Black Friday continues
Class skin news
notes.notes:
Life in Elinor is full of adventures. Preparations for winter, the Observatory season, and technomagic contests keep even the wealthiest citizens busy. In the midst of the hustle and bustle of life it's easy not to notice how the artifacts of the class images shine even brighter, urging warriors to hurry to enhance it! 

Let's start with the changes in the metaphysical environment. The quest to obtain an artifact was called "Power of eternity", and the artifact itself took the form of a stone, and you will now need crystal shards to enhance it. 
For all technomagicians of the dwarves "Artifact pollen" has been replaced by "Artifact stone" and "Crystal pollen" by "Crystal shard", also the quest "Power of magic" has been replaced by "Power of eternity" with progress saved, and the quest "Ancient Kumyar Artifacts" the artifact of metaphysicians has been replaced by " Mountains heart".
Artifacts of class skins got basic effects and the possibility of its strengthening, getting unique abilities! 
Warrior skin artifact while putting it on will increase the valor gained when defeating an opponent by 10%, and when strengthening with crystal shards will increase armor strength, which increases the absorption of damage of your opponent's armor. 
Barbarian skin artifact while putting on it doubles the points gained in a medal for killing an opponent with a spell, using a spell or triggering a passive effect when killing an opponent, and when strengthening with crystal horns will increase the power of armor, increasing the chance of it being triggered.
Hunter skin artifact if you put it on doubles the points you get in achievements on monster slaying, and if strengthened with crystal feathers increases the power of the defect that reduces damage from the opponent's counterattack. 
Druid and metaphysical image artifacts, when worn, increase resource extraction chance by 10%, and when strengthened with crystal leaves or shards, increase the power of a defect that reduces furious enemy damage. 
Finally, magician and engineer skin artifacts, when put on, double the points received in the medal for triggering projectiles and runes, and when reinforced with crystal pollen or scraps, increase the strength of the defect that reduces the chance of stun or luck on the enemy.
Artifact effects are summed with other similar effects. For example, the effect of a Hunter skin artifact summarizes with the effect of a Hunter potion.

Let's see an example of how the new artifact parameters work.
[b]Example 1[/b]. Your armor absorbs 30% of enemy damage. The strength of the armor on the artifact is 10%. Your armor would absorb 30%*(1+10%) = 33% damage if the artifact with this parameter is on.
[b]Example 2[/b]. Your armor-piercing hit has a 10% chance. The armor-piercing power of the artifact is 10%. If an artifact with this parameter is putted on the artifact, you have a 10%*(1+10%) = 11% chance to get the armor-piercing blow.
[b]Example 3[/b]. Your opponent has a 5% chance to stun or luck. The stun or luck defect on the artifact is 10%. The chance of stun or luck on an opponent is 5%*(1-10%)=4.5% if an artifact with this parameter is put on.
In the future personal and clan standard artifacts will also have its own effects and unique parameters.
Gift from the Bank of Elinor! Until the end of November 24, for every 100 crystals of one payment, you will receive 5 ghostly crystals needed to strengthen the skins and its artifacts. 

[i]Hurry to improve your skin artifacts and sleep stronger![/i]

notes.title: Элинорские карты
notes.notes:
Have you ever imagined a deck of cards made of technomagic monsters? No? Then it's time to search for boss cards of different Elinor territories, collect the necessary number of them to get the Joker and call the desired boss yourself, without searching for its location in the lands of Elinor. 

So, a deck of cards has become available in the world of Elinor! It consists solely of bosses of different locations, and your task is not an easy one: to collect all the boss cards of each territory of Elinor world. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41575789/fc4710e34c51fa15470745db82d161d568d053d3.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41575789/58489fc879cba91311b3ab0ffcf111df13035883.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41575789/9414a26a978ce8beb1aab35f14096b5805c376d9.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41575789/a4aa7d366296d13ebc489d52e0c846a941e53622.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41575789/8841c98dcdb77267d18c22bf865567df594180c4.png[/img]

Cards can be obtained by defeating exclusively the boss of the same name or randomly by opening a Ghost card. Ghost cards are available in limited quantities from the speculator during fair week.

As an example, let's look at how to get the Magic Joker of Soli-Dor. 
First you will need to get cards from each boss in the area. Then the Uuh Tuum Card, the Aukh Toun Card, the Steel Turtle Card, the Black Dragon Card, and the Emerald Dragon Card merge into the normal joker of Soli-Dor, which allows you to call upon one of the bosses whose cards you've merged once every 30 days. 

But that's not all! Once you get a normal joker, the cards won't stop dropping. Once you've got one more joker of Soli-Dor, you can use a card box to upgrade to the enchanted joker and reduce the call-up time to 15 days. And if you collect 3 enchanted jokers, you can get the magical joker of Soli-Dor and reduce the calling time of the boss to 5 days. 
[b]You can find the card box among other rewards in the Keymaker's stashes. [/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41575789/704437e9a6e56d0f85c3da927332314fb1fbc577.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41575789/71c8c569ef56aab8d726aa2c449ae433ff8ef788.png[/img]

There are six types of jokers:
[olist]
[*] Joker of the Soli-Dor - Card of Ukh Tuum, Card of Auh-Toun, Card of the Steel turtle, Card of the Black dragon, and Card of the Emerald dragon
[*] Joker of the Catacombs - Card of the Underground giant, Card of the Dungeon master, Card of the Ghostly warrior, and Card of the Gadzog
[*] Joker of the Dungeons - Card of the Queen of Guuds, Card of the Lord of Guuds, Card of the Ancient horror, Card of the Underground hunter, and Card of the Mechanical monster
[*] Joker of the Grooves - Card of the Argzgul, Card of the Mother of Guuds, Card of the Kapatuk, and card of the Model T-1 v.1.13.
[*] Joker of the Coast - card of the Wave Queen, card of Torsia, card of the Profundal Lizardfish, and card of the Outcast
[*] Joker of the Mines - card of Hapur, card of Blinding Krum, card of Iron Ripper, and card of Gryzhorm
[/olist]
If you have more than one joker in the same area, you can only use one to call bosses. The next use of a joker will become available only after the joker's alarm clock expires. 

For example: 
[olist]
[*] You have a normal and an enchanted joker of the Soli-Dor. You used a normal joker and got an alarm clock for 30 days. You will be able to use the enchanted one only when the alarm clock runs out.
[*] You have a normal joker of the Grooves and an enchanted joker of the Soli-Dor. You use Joker of the Grooves and get an alarm for 30 days. But you can also use a joker of the Soli-Dor, getting another alarm for 15 days.
[/olist]
So you can use 6 jokers of different territories at the same time.

To make collecting cards easier, an exchange of extra cards and jokers is available:
[olist]

Note: As a reward for this achievement, the Pumpkin medallion has been replaced by a new skin item, which you can upgrade with a gold seed and increase your characteristics. Upgrading the skin will give human characters a bonus to the "Fortitude" characteristic, and dwarven characters a bonus to the " Evil eye" characteristic. 
Previously obtained Pumpkin medallion is exchanged for this skin in the Halloween store. 

Besides completing a variety of quests in Ghostly Elinor, you'll learn how to grow ripe apples and be rewarded with silver and gold Halloween coins. 
Ingredients for making festive sweets are obtained depending on the level:
[list]
[*] skeleton ghost gives rewards to players of levels 5-10
[*] walking dead gives players of levels 11-15
[*] dark guard - for players of levels 16-20
[*] soul killer - for players of level 21+
[/list]
Silver Halloween coins can be exchanged for gold coins at a rate of 100 to 1, and gold coins can be spent in the Halloween store before the event is over. 
Among the new items you'll find: decorations for the town forge or workshop, a certificate to change the appearance of your personal Halloween outfit, gold seeds needed to enhance your pumpkin skin, and more. 
Making festive actions during the week you will take part in the rating, the reward for high places - reward tokens. The ranking includes growing a pumpkin and receiving gifts from it, creating and receiving rewards from the sweetest apples, producing apple seeds in the cauldron, victories in the ghostly Coliseum over opponents of an enemy faction and other theme actions in the territory of Ghostly Elinor. 

Note that participation in the ranking does not count towards the "Participant in the race" medal line. 
The results of the ranking will be summarized on November 2 at 8:00. 
[b]Completion of holiday quests is available until the end of November 4. [/b]
You can use the candy you've created, exchange Halloween silver coins and spend gold ones in the Halloween store no later than the end of November 6. 

Of course, you'll also find themed gifts at the town florists.


[b]The Elinor Bank is joining in the celebration: until October 30 inclusive[/b], it is presenting its depositors with the ripest apples! 
For each 500 crystals of the amount of one payment you get the 10 biggest, ripe apples, with 30 gold Helloween coins inside! 
Have a scary but fun holiday!

notes.title: The season of the Observatory has begun!
notes.notes:
[b]Citizens of Elinor! The entrance to the snow valley of monthly adventures is now open! Get ready for thrilling duels, exciting rewards, and a full week of awesome rounds on the territory of the Observatory! [/b]

Technomagicians of level 6 and higher who wish to join the new season of the Observatory, using the portal near the house of the Hermit, will move to the base camp of the Frost Valley and plunge into battles for the Sphere and the gold lenses that are needed to exchange for rare items in the Hermit the Stargazer store. The items among which this time there is a mysterious artifact (its purchase is available up to October 30 inclusive). 
More details on the Observatory rules can be found [url=https://info.tmgame.ru/library/world/Observatory/]here[/url]. 
[b]The current season[/b] of snow adventures will [b]run up to 23:30 on October 30[/b], and you can [b]visit the base camp[/b], purchase and open the lens boxes [b]up to November 2 inclusive[/b].  
If you purchase crystals before the end of October 25, you'll receive a gift - a magical hermit's chest for every 100 crystals of the one payment amount. 

Gem collectors are having a bit of a vacation this month! Instead of a technomagicians contest, the Halloween contest will begin on Wednesday, and the Ghostly Elinor will be available along with it! 

[i]We wish you an exciting adventure![/i]

notes.title: Eleanor shares
notes.notes:
Warriors! Collectors of autumn leaves will have good news for the coming days, and lovers of treasure hunting will be able to buy cobalt picks and go to the dark mines in search of valuable treasures! 

Until the end of [b]October 18[/b], all collectors of the autumn herbarium are waiting for a double loss of collectible leaves! Hurry up to collect golden leaves, paste them into notebooks or albums and get autumn coins for which you can buy rare goods in a special store. 

On the shelves of the [i]Crystal Shop until the end of October 19[/i], you will find cobalt picks and will be able to go in search of goblin treasures! A limited number of picks are exchanged for universal coins in the city shop. Among the rewards in the treasure chests you will find: elixirs of denial or scrolls of peace, calls of bosses by character level, ghost crystal, Adamas from Yar Marko and the main treasure — a Durable stone of Devastating damage! 
You can read more about the treasure hunt [url=https://info.tmgame.ru/action/raskopki/]here[/url]. 

[i]We wish you a good week![/i]

notes.title: Autumn leaf fall
notes.notes:
Autumn is in full swing and there are two weeks of beautiful fall foliage, herbarium collection and exchange for autumn coins! 
You can find out about the fall collection from Iria and Ungor, as before. They will be glad to tell elinorians of level 6 and higher about all the details of collecting and sticking beautiful leaves in a notebook or a diary for a herbarium and exchange it for autumn coins to purchase rare items in the Autumn store. 
Briefly remind you of the ways to get leaves - when defeating experienced monsters and/or valiant opponents:
[list]
[*] oak - in Soli-Dor, catacombs, dungeons and mines beneath it;
[*] birch trees - on the Dedication Island;
[*] rowan - in the Hive and the Temple of the Ancients;
[*] willow trees - in safe territory.
[/list]
Maple leaves are in chests, which Iria and Ungor will tell you the location of once a day. If you decide to repeat the Maple Leaf gathering, you can update the location of the chests on the world map for 100 personalized coins, which the friendly autumn event coordinators will be more than happy to tell you. 
Herbarium notebooks can be received by completing a daily quest, but remember - at midnight the progress of the quest will be reset, and a new assignment will be given when you sign in to the game. Herbarium albums are sold in the crystal store. 
Sticking a collection of leaves in a notebook will give you 5 autumn coins, and sticking a collection of leaves in an album will give you 10 autumn coins. 
There are some new items among the regulars in the Autumn store this year as well:
[olist]
[*] Barrels with elixirs of purification of different levels; 
[*] pouch with fragments of the accuracy platums and its exchange for a higher level color; 
[*] visor of silence and sorrow; 
[*] crystal compounds needed to enhance class characters; 
[*] boxes of simple and valor earrings. 
[/olist]
You can get leaves from the collection until and including [b]October 19[/b], [b]and you can stick in notebooks or albums and spend your autumn coins up to the end of October 23[/b].
Early in the morning of [b]October 10[/b] you will [b]begin the ranking for the fall collection[/b], participants will receive prizes and points in the line of medals "Participant of the race". [b]The results[/b] of the ranking will be summed up on [b]October 17[/b] during the morning technical works. 

Elinor Bank isn't left out of the fall foliage and is presenting gifts! [b]Until the end of October 16, you will receive 10 sets of leaves for every 100 crystals of the one purchase! [/b]

Now you have the ability to enhance a hyddenite inlay stone by using a resin that matches the color and level of the stone. 

Also in the world of Elinor there are new lines of valor earrings, which you can get from the box with the appropriate name or by exchanging fragments of one of the colors for the earring you need in the Jeweler's store. 

You can exchange the earrings of blind faith, lost soul and north wind for the boxes of valiant earrings and make an exchange of the lower colors of fragments for the higher ones there. 

And with a special ring cutter you can disassemble valor earrings into fragments, getting an average of 80% fragments taking into account the strength of the item. 

[i]Collect your herbariums and stay in good spirits![/i]

notes.title: Technomagic Release!
notes.notes:
Dear friends! The development team is pleased to present the Technomagic project on Steam. This year is the 14th anniversary of Technomagic, it continues to evolve. It is launching on different platforms and is also translated into English. English-speaking audience of the project is just beginning to form, and if you have any questions about the game, we suggest leaving those in the community of Technomagic on Steam or on [url=https://www.facebook.com/TechnoMagic]Facebook [/url], as well as on the game's [url=https://forum.tmgame.ru/]forum[/url]. And Russian-speaking players can ask all their questions on the game's [url=https://forum.tmgame.ru/]forum[/url] or in the [url=https://vk.com/technomagic]VK group[/url] .
